paper.title: SpikeOPD: Stable On-Policy Distillation for Autoregressive Spiking Language Models
paper.abstract: Spiking neural networks (SNNs) offer a path to energy-efficient language modeling through sparse encoding and event-driven computation, but training capable spiking language models from scratch remains difficult. A practical alternative is ANN-to-SNN migration through knowledge distillation (KD), where a pretrained artificial neural network (ANN) teacher supervises an SNN student. Existing migration approaches distill on fixed corpus prefixes, whereas autoregressive inference conditions on self-

summary.core_problem: 如何解决将预训练的自回归人工神经网络 (ANN) 语言模型蒸馏为脉冲神经网络 (SNN) 时，由于自生成前缀导致的策略不匹配和内部脉冲动态漂移问题？
summary.importance: 针对 SNN 语言模型训练困难的问题，提出了一种稳定的 On-Policy 蒸馏方法，有助于推动低功耗 SNN 在语言建模中的应用。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 SpikeOPD (Stable On-Policy Distillation) 框架。首先，发现 Vanilla OPD (仅使用教师模型的全 KL 散度) 在自生成前缀上继续教师监督时，可能会遭受延迟的 rollout-feedback 崩溃。为解决此问题，SpikeOPD 引入了基于教师的混合采样策略，以稳定 rollout 轨迹，并结合了基于学生模型的截断 KL 散度，以减轻对次优教师预测的过度拟合。
summary.experiments: 在语言建模任务上进行了受控压力测试，验证了 SpikeOPD 相比 Vanilla OPD 的稳定性，并展示了其在缓解策略不匹配和脉冲动态漂移方面的有效性。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自香港中文大学、A*STAR、南洋理工大学、北京大学等机构，包含知名学者 Yang You。

summary_en.core_problem: How to address the policy mismatch and internal spiking-dynamics drift caused by self-generated prefixes when distilling a pretrained autoregressive Artificial Neural Network (ANN) language model into a Spiking Neural Network (SNN)?
summary_en.importance: Addresses the difficulty of training SNN language models by proposing a stable On-Policy distillation method, advancing the application of low-power SNNs in language modeling.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes the SpikeOPD (Stable On-Policy Distillation) framework. First, it identifies that Vanilla OPD (teacher-only full-KL) may suffer from delayed rollout-feedback collapse when continuing teacher supervision on self-generated prefixes. To solve this, SpikeOPD introduces a teacher-based mixed sampling strategy to stabilize rollout trajectories and incorporates a student-based truncated KL divergence to mitigate overfitting to suboptimal teacher predictions.
summary_en.experiments: Conducted controlled stress tests on language modeling tasks, validating the stability of SpikeOPD compared to Vanilla OPD and demonstrating its effectiveness in mitigating policy mismatch and spiking-dynamics drift.
summary_en.authors_note: Authors are from CUHK, A*STAR, NTU, Peking University, etc., including notable scholar Yang You.

recommendation.zh: 关注 SNN 语言模型的蒸馏，虽然 SNN 目前非主流基座，但其解决自回归生成中 exposure bias 的 on-policy 蒸馏思路（混合采样+截断 KL）对 LLM 蒸馏有一定启发。
recommendation.en: Focuses on distilling SNN language models. While SNNs are not mainstream foundation models, its on-policy distillation approach (mixed sampling + truncated KL) to address exposure bias in AR generation offers insights for LLM distillation.

institutions: The Chinese University of Hong Kong
Agency for Science, Technology and Research (A*STAR)

paper.title: Mitigating Strong-Modality Collapse in Multimodal Learning via Inverted Asymmetric Fusion
paper.abstract: Fusing multiple modalities is expected to improve model performance. However, on the MultiHuSE dataset, early, late, and symmetric attention fusion often fail to outperform the best unimodal baseline (text). Pathway isolation of a symmetric attention fusion model reveals that the text-pathway accuracy drops from 74.9% to 56.4% after fusion in one such setting, indicating that the dominant modality can be degraded during integration. We term this strong-modality collapse and argue that it helps e

summary.core_problem: 多模态融合时，强模态（如文本）在融合后反而性能下降，导致多模态模型不如最佳单模态。
summary.importance: 提出并命名“强模态塌缩（strong-modality collapse）”这一失败模式，并给出一种偏工程但可复用的融合设计，提醒做统一多模态预训练时要显式保护强模态路径。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Inverted Asymmetric Fusion (IAF)：不做对称的互相注意力融合；让强模态表示在融合处“原样直通”，弱模态以强模态为上下文锚点做单向注意力；融合前用 Modality-Aware Knowledge Distillation 先增强弱模态表征，减少融合时对强模态的干扰。
summary.experiments: 在 MultiHuSE 等三个具有不同“模态强弱层级”的基准上比较 early/late/symmetric attention fusion 与 IAF；并用 pathway isolation 诊断：某设置下文本路径准确率从 74.9% 掉到 56.4%，用以佐证强模态在融合中被破坏这一现象。（摘要未给出完整表格与显著性信息）

summary_en.core_problem: In multimodal fusion, the dominant modality (e.g., text) can degrade after fusion, making multimodal models underperform the best unimodal baseline.
summary_en.importance: Names and diagnoses a concrete failure mode (“strong-modality collapse”) and proposes a practical fusion design that explicitly preserves the dominant pathway—useful as a cautionary pattern for unified multimodal pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes Inverted Asymmetric Fusion (IAF): avoid symmetric mutual attention; pass the dominant modality through fusion unchanged, while weaker modalities attend to it as a contextual anchor. Before fusion, strengthen weaker modalities via Modality-Aware Knowledge Distillation to reduce interference.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluates on three benchmarks with different modality hierarchies (including MultiHuSE), comparing early/late/symmetric attention fusion vs IAF; uses pathway isolation to show a case where text-path accuracy drops from 74.9% to 56.4% after fusion. (Full ablations/significance not in the abstract.)

recommendation.zh: 把“融合后强模态变差”讲清楚了，但更像融合结构经验总结；只需看诊断数字与 IAF 结构，别期待对大规模 VLM 预训练有硬结论。
recommendation.en: Good articulation of “dominant modality gets worse after fusion,” but it reads like fusion-architecture heuristics; skim the diagnostic drop and IAF design, don’t overgeneralize to large-scale VLM pretraining.

paper.title: Preserving General Capabilities during Domain Specialization with Uncertainty-Calibrated MOPD
paper.abstract: Specializing large language models to vertical domains improves domain-specific behavior but often degrades general capabilities such as reasoning, coding, instruction following, and creative writing. We study this domain--general trade-off in Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation (MOPD), where a specialized student is supervised on its own sampled trajectories by domain and general teachers. Standard MOPD faces two limitations: ordinary on-policy sampling rarely exposes tokens with large positiv

summary.core_problem: 论文处理的是领域专门化后的通用能力回收问题：学生模型已经偏向垂直领域，如何借助一个领域教师和一个通用教师做 on-policy distillation，同时减少对大规模通用训练数据和手工混合比例的依赖。
summary.importance: 对基座研究的启发主要在两个点。第一，它把能力保持问题从“混数据继续训”转成“用教师分布重新校准学生的 on-policy 轨迹”，更接近 continual pretrain / domain adaptation 中会遇到的真实约束。第二，它指出 distillation advantage 的符号并不等同于可靠训练信号。这个观察有价值：token-level KL 或 advantage 更新看似局部正确，但如果不看教师自身对 token 的绝对认可度，可能会压低本来合理的 token，造成能力回收过程中的扰动。
summary.technical_approach: 方法围绕 Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation 展开。学生从领域模型初始化，领域教师通常是该领域模型的冻结副本，通用教师是原始开放通用模型。学生在领域提示和通用提示上生成 rollout，对应教师在相同 prefix 下给每个 token 打分。核心量是 distillation advantage：教师 logprob 减学生 logprob。正 advantage 会提高该 token 概率，负 advantage 会降低该 token 概率。论文认为标准 MOPD 有两个问题：普通采样来自学生分布，容易采到学生已高置信的 token，因此大正 advantage 很少；只用 advantage 符号决定更新方向也不稳，因为教师可能同样认可某个 token，只是学生概率略高，此时简单压低 token 会破坏已对齐行为。为此提出 uncertainty-calibrated MOPD。其一，用 dual-temperature sampling 扩大候选轨迹池，让采样覆盖更多学生低估、教师更认可的 token。其二，用 positive-advantage-density 过滤轨迹，优先保留含有较多“大正收益”token 的样本。其三，用教师 endorsement 或不确定性校准 token 更新方向：当 advantage 要求增强 token 时，需要教师本身也足够支持；当 advantage 要求抑制 token 时，需要教师本身支持较弱。这样把“教师相对学生更喜欢什么”和“教师自己是否确信”分开处理。
summary.experiments: 给出的正文片段主要覆盖问题定义和方法动机，未包含完整实验表格与具体数值。可确认的实验关注点应是领域能力与通用能力的 trade-off：在领域专门化模型基础上，用通用教师恢复 reasoning、coding、instruction following、open-ended writing 等能力，同时保持领域能力。关键消融应包括普通 MOPD、dual-temperature sampling、positive-advantage-density filtering、uncertainty/endorsement calibration 的逐项贡献。阅读时需要特别检查实验是否区分了领域提示和通用提示，是否报告了通用能力恢复之外的领域能力回退，以及过滤策略是否只是提升了样本难度而牺牲了覆盖度。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 20–30 分钟。重点看 Introduction 中对 advantage 符号不可靠的分析和 Figure 1；再看方法部分里 dual-temperature sampling、positive-advantage-density filtering、teacher endorsement calibration 的定义。实验部分优先看通用能力恢复与领域能力保持的双轴结果，以及 ablation。若只关心预训练方向，可把它当作 continual specialization 中“无原始通用数据时如何做能力蒸馏”的案例，而不是通用的预训练 recipe。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies capability recovery after domain specialization. A student model has already been shifted toward a vertical domain, and the goal is to use a domain teacher and a general teacher for on-policy distillation without relying on a carefully constructed mixture of domain and general data.
summary_en.importance: The useful signal for pretraining research is the treatment of capability retention as a distribution-level calibration problem rather than as another round of data mixing. The paper also makes a concrete point about token-level distillation: the sign of a teacher-student advantage is not always a reliable update direction. A token can be endorsed by the teacher and still have a slightly negative advantage if the student is even more confident. Penalizing such tokens can disturb already aligned behavior.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method builds on Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation. The student is initialized from the domain-specialized model. A frozen copy of that model serves as the domain teacher, while the original open general model serves as the general teacher. The student samples trajectories on domain and general prompts, and the corresponding teacher evaluates each sampled token under the same prefix. The key quantity is the distillation advantage, defined as teacher log probability minus student log probability. Positive advantage increases the sampled token probability; negative advantage decreases it. The paper argues that standard MOPD suffers from two issues. First, ordinary on-policy sampling rarely exposes tokens with large positive teacher-student gaps, because samples come from the student distribution. Second, the advantage sign alone does not tell whether the update is safe. The proposed uncertainty-calibrated MOPD addresses these issues with dual-temperature sampling to broaden candidate trajectories, positive-advantage-density filtering to keep rollouts rich in high-gain tokens, and teacher-endorsement calibration to validate whether reinforcement or suppression is supported by the teacher’s own distribution.
summary_en.experiments: The provided text covers the motivation and method setup but does not include full experimental tables or exact numerical gains. The intended evaluation axis is clear: restore general abilities such as reasoning, coding, instruction following, and open-ended generation while preserving the specialized domain behavior. The most important ablations to inspect are standard MOPD versus dual-temperature sampling, positive-advantage-density filtering, and uncertainty or endorsement calibration. It is also important to check whether the method improves general capability without eroding the domain teacher’s behavior.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in 20–30 minutes. Start with the Introduction and Figure 1, where the paper explains why advantage signs can be misleading. Then read the method definitions for dual-temperature sampling, positive-advantage-density filtering, and teacher-endorsement calibration. In the experiments, focus on the domain-general trade-off table and the component ablations. For pretraining work, the main value is as a case study in continual specialization and capability distillation when the original general training data are unavailable.

recommendation.zh: 改进了多教师蒸馏方法以缓解领域微调时的通用能力遗忘，其对蒸馏数据采样的改进（双温度采样+不确定性过滤）对做 SFT/RL 数据合成的同学有启发。
recommendation.en: Improves multi-teacher distillation to mitigate catastrophic forgetting during domain fine-tuning; its improvements on distillation data sampling (dual-temperature sampling + uncertainty filtering) are insightful for SFT/RL data synthesis.

paper.title: Consolidating RLVR Capabilities Across Domains: A Deep Dive into Fusion Paradigms
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) improves specific capabilities of large language models, but covering multiple capabilities often involves training separate domain experts and subsequently consolidating them. We organize three fusion paradigms by the artefacts they reuse: Merge combines expert task vectors, Mix RL pools their datasets, and multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD) uses both. Because they have largely been studied in isolation, how they compare and how to

summary.core_problem: 在具有可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）中，如何最有效地将多个特定领域的专家模型能力整合到一个模型中？
summary.importance: 系统性比较了三种模型融合范式（Merge、Mix RL、MOPD）在跨领域 RLVR 任务中的表现，揭示了不同方法的训练动态和性能瓶颈，为多能力模型的后训练提供了实证指导。
summary.technical_approach: 将融合范式分为三类：Merge（合并专家任务向量）、Mix RL（混合专家数据集进行联合训练）和 MOPD（多教师在线策略蒸馏）。在统一的模型规模和多领域基准测试套件下，使用共享的专家模型和数据对这三种方法进行比较，并分析其训练动态和任务向量几何特征。
summary.experiments: 在多个模型规模和多领域基准测试上进行实验。结果表明，三种方法的平均性能差异最多为 1.4 分，但在单个基准测试上差距可达 8.6 分。Mix RL 依赖于领域混合比例，MOPD 受限于教师模型，而 Merge 会压缩任务向量。

summary_en.core_problem: How to most effectively consolidate multiple domain-specific expert capabilities into a single model in Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR)?
summary_en.importance: Systematically compares three model fusion paradigms (Merge, Mix RL, MOPD) in cross-domain RLVR tasks, revealing the training dynamics and performance bottlenecks of different methods, providing empirical guidance for the post-training of multi-capability models.
summary_en.technical_approach: Categorizes fusion paradigms into three types: Merge (combining expert task vectors), Mix RL (pooling expert datasets for joint training), and MOPD (multi-teacher on-policy distillation). Compares these three methods using shared experts and data across model scales and a multi-domain benchmark suite, analyzing their training dynamics and task-vector geometry.
summary_en.experiments: Conducted experiments across multiple model scales and a multi-domain benchmark suite. Results show that the average performance difference among the three methods is at most 1.4 points, but the gap reaches 8.6 points on a single benchmark. Mix RL depends on domain mixture proportions, MOPD remains bounded by its teachers, and Merge compresses task vectors.

recommendation.zh: 对 RLVR 多领域融合的系统性比较，揭示了不同融合范式的 trade-off，对做 post-training 和模型合并的研究员有直接参考价值，重点看不同方法的训练动态分析。
recommendation.en: A systematic comparison of multi-domain fusion in RLVR, revealing the trade-offs of different fusion paradigms. Highly relevant for post-training and model merging researchers; focus on the analysis of training dynamics.

paper.title: SelFusion: Self-distillation for Diffusion Language Models
paper.abstract: Diffusion language models (DLMs) alleviate the inherent latency bottleneck of autoregressive (AR) large language models (LLMs), but their degraded generation quality limits practical applicability. Although knowledge distillation (KD) can be a promising direction for improving performance, we empirically find that naively applying conventional KD yields only marginal gains, or even degrades generation quality. Based on these observations, we propose a novel self-distillation framework for DLMs,

summary.core_problem: 扩散语言模型（DLM）推理快但质量弱。论文聚焦一个很具体的问题：为什么把常规知识蒸馏（logit-level / sequence-level）直接搬到 DLM 上，经常只有小幅收益甚至掉点；以及如何在没有高质量 DLM teacher、且 AR→NAR 分布不匹配的情况下，让蒸馏真正起作用。
summary.importance: 对“非 AR 语言建模范式”的训练 recipe 有直接启发：蒸馏不一定要依赖外部 teacher，也不一定要固定 teacher→student 的单向关系。更重要的是，论文把 AR teacher 分布过尖（spiky）与 DLM 在高 mask ratio 下分布更平（flat）的 mismatch 讲清楚，并给出一个可落地的替代：利用 DLM 自身噪声/掩码强度构造不同难度视角做自蒸馏。对后续做 diffusion/any-order LM 的训练稳定性与质量提升，属于“可复用的训练技巧”级别贡献。
summary.technical_approach:
SelFusion 的核心是把同一个 DLM 变成两个“模式”来互相蒸馏：
1) easy mode vs hard mode：对同一训练样本做两次 forward，但掩码率不同。hard mode 用原始较高 masking；easy mode 用更低 masking，让模型看到更多上下文，通常能给出更可靠的 token 分布。
2) 关键问题：easy mode 不总是更对，而且低 masking 会让分布更尖、更自信；这种“错得很自信”会把 hard mode 带偏。
3) bidirectional KD（逐 token 决策蒸馏方向）：不是固定 easy→hard，而是根据 token-level correctness/置信度在两者间动态选 teacher。
- 两者都对：选对当前预测 token 给更高概率的一方作为 teacher。
- 两者都错：选对 ground-truth token 给更高概率的一方作为 teacher（避免跟着错误 top-1 走）。
- 一对一错：用正确的一方当 teacher。
4) 论文动机里强调“student-friendly teacher”：easy mode 的分布形态更接近 hard mode（同架构同参数），比 AR teacher 的极尖分布更可蒸馏；同时又通过逐 token 方向选择抑制 easy mode 的过度自信副作用。
整体上，这是把 DLM 的 noising/masking 机制当作“内生的课程学习 + 自蒸馏信号生成器”，而不是额外引入一个外部强 teacher。
summary.experiments:
全文给出的关键信息点主要是现象与机制证据：
- AR→DLM logit KD 的 mismatch：AR teacher 往往 top-1 概率接近 100%，而 DLM 在约 50% masking 时 top-1 概率约 60% 左右，导致分布匹配困难。
- easy mode 相对 hard mode：训练过程中 easy mode 对正确 token 的概率平均高约 10%（论文用来支撑“更适合作 teacher”）。
- easy mode 的风险：低 masking 会让分布更 peaked，且在错误 token 上也会过度自信；论文提到“两者都预测错”的情况约占 40%（因此需要在 both-wrong 情况下用 ground-truth 概率来选方向）。
- 任务层面：在多个 instruction-following benchmark 上，SelFusion 系统性优于依赖外部 teacher 的常规 KD；并报告“甚至超过 teacher（包括 DLM 与 LLM teacher）”。（你给的全文片段未包含具体 benchmark 名称与数值表格；若需要精确数字，需要对照论文实验表/附录。）
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 25–35 分钟）：
- 先看 Figure 1：常规 KD 在 DLM 上为何不 work（结论导向）。
- 再看 Method 的三段：easy/hard 构造、为什么 easy 不总更好、以及 token-level 双向蒸馏规则（公式与三种 case）。
- 重点翻 Figure 3（masking ratio vs 分布尖锐度）和关于“both wrong 占比”的统计：这是方法成立的关键证据。
- 如果时间够，再看作者对 AR-DLM 分布 mismatch 的分析小节（文中提到 Section 4.3.5）：这部分决定你是否能把思路迁移到别的 any-order / masked / diffusion 目标上。

summary_en.core_problem: Diffusion language models decode in parallel but lag behind AR LLMs in generation quality. The paper targets a practical training question: why conventional knowledge distillation (logit-level or sequence-level) often yields marginal gains or even hurts DLMs, and how to make distillation effective when (1) AR→DLM distributions are mismatched and (2) strong DLM teachers are unavailable.
summary_en.importance: The main value is a reusable recipe for non-AR language modeling: distillation can be internal (no external teacher) and can be bidirectional rather than a fixed teacher→student pipeline. The paper also provides a concrete diagnosis of AR-to-DLM logit mismatch (overly peaky AR distributions vs flatter DLM distributions under masking), which is useful when designing training objectives for diffusion/any-order LMs.
summary_en.technical_approach:
SelFusion turns a single DLM into two “views” via different masking ratios and performs self-distillation between them.
- Two-mode forward: an easy mode with lower masking (more context) and a hard mode with higher masking (standard DLM setting).
- Naive easy→hard distillation is unsafe because low masking produces sharper, overconfident distributions, including on wrong tokens.
- Bidirectional, token-wise distillation: for each token, choose the distillation direction based on correctness and confidence.
  * both correct: distill from the mode assigning higher probability to the predicted token.
  * both wrong: distill from the mode assigning higher probability to the ground-truth token.
  * one correct: distill from the correct mode.
This design keeps the “teacher” distribution close to the student (same model family) while avoiding the failure mode where the easy view is confidently wrong.
summary_en.experiments:
Key evidence and reported outcomes include:
- Distribution mismatch: AR teachers often put ~100% mass on top-1, while DLMs at ~50% masking show ~60% top-1 probability, making logit matching ineffective.
- Easy vs hard: the easy mode assigns ~10% higher probability to the correct token on average during training.
- Failure mode prevalence: cases where both modes are wrong occur in ~40% of tokens, motivating the special handling in the bidirectional rule.
- On multiple instruction-following benchmarks, SelFusion consistently beats standard KD baselines that rely on external teachers, and is reported to even surpass the teacher models (both DLM and LLM teachers). (The provided full-text excerpt does not include the exact benchmark tables/numbers.)
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (25–35 minutes):
- Start with Figure 1 to understand the empirical failure of standard KD on DLMs.
- Read the method section focusing on (1) easy/hard construction and (2) the token-wise bidirectional decision rule.
- Check Figure 3 (masking ratio vs distribution sharpness) and the statistics on how often both modes are wrong—these justify why direction selection matters.
- If you want to transfer the idea, read the AR–DLM mismatch analysis section referenced in the text (e.g., Section 4.3.5).

recommendation.zh: 如果你在看 DLM，这篇值得读的点不是“又一个蒸馏技巧”，而是它明确说明 easy-view 并不天然是 teacher；先看失败案例和蒸馏方向判定，别急着抄 recipe。
recommendation.en: Worth reading for the negative result more than the trick itself: in DLMs, the easier view is not a reliable teacher; read the failure cases and distillation-direction logic before copying the recipe.

paper.title: Think with Structured Grounding: Perceptual Reinforcement Learning for Chart and Visual-Tabular Understanding
paper.abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) capable of thinking with images often rely on external tools for fine-grained perception. However, this reliance introduces significant inference latency and fails to effectively resolve the spatial-structural gap-a fundamental challenge in text-dense and structurally relational visuals (e.g., charts and visual tables) where strict relative spatial arrangements bind textual elements. Without external tools, standard MLLMs struggle with such fine-grained v

summary.core_problem: 多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在处理图表等结构化视觉数据时，依赖外部工具（如动态裁剪）进行细粒度感知会导致推理延迟高、token 爆炸，且自然语言难以精准锚定密集空间布局，容易产生“空间幻觉”。
summary.importance: 提出了一种将外部工具调用能力内化到模型参数中的新范式，避免了推理阶段的工具依赖，显著降低了延迟，并为复杂视觉推理任务提供了一种基于过程奖励的强化学习优化方法。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Think with Structured Grounding (TwSG) 框架。首先，利用教师模型和外部工具生成包含多轮“思考-观察”的结构化轨迹（iMCoT）。然后，通过数据蒸馏将这些轨迹内化到学生模型中，使其能在单次前向传播中完成推理。最后，引入 TL-GRPO 强化学习算法，采用标签级重要性采样（TL-IS）解决不同功能标签长度差异导致的梯度偏差问题，并结合裁剪组采样（CGS）和交错可验证奖励机制稳定训练。
summary.experiments: 在图表和视觉表格问答任务上，TwSG 相比依赖外部工具的 SOTA 方法，在显著降低推理延迟的同时，提升了推理准确性和鲁棒性。TL-GRPO 有效缓解了长度引起的梯度偏差，促进了多步推理能力的涌现。
summary.reading_guide: 重点关注 TwSG 框架的四个阶段，特别是结构化 iMCoT 轨迹的生成方式。深入理解 TL-GRPO 算法中标签级重要性采样（TL-IS）的设计动机和实现细节，这对于解决长序列强化学习中的梯度偏差问题有启发意义。

summary_en.core_problem: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) relying on external tools for fine-grained perception in structured visual data (e.g., charts) suffer from high inference latency, token explosion, and 'spatial hallucinations' due to the difficulty of anchoring natural language to dense spatial layouts.
summary_en.importance: Introduces a novel paradigm that internalizes external tool capabilities into model parameters, eliminating tool dependency during inference, significantly reducing latency, and providing a process-reward-driven reinforcement learning approach for complex visual reasoning.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes the Think with Structured Grounding (TwSG) framework. It first uses a teacher model and tools to generate structured trajectories (iMCoT) containing multi-turn 'think-observe' steps. These trajectories are distilled into a student model for single-pass reasoning. Finally, it introduces the TL-GRPO reinforcement learning algorithm, utilizing Tag-level Importance Sampling (TL-IS) to address gradient bias caused by varying tag lengths, combined with Clipped Group Sampling (CGS) and an interleaved verifiable reward mechanism to stabilize training.
summary_en.experiments: On chart and visual-tabular QA tasks, TwSG significantly improves reasoning accuracy and robustness while drastically reducing inference latency compared to tool-dependent SOTA methods. TL-GRPO effectively mitigates length-induced gradient bias and encourages multi-step reasoning capabilities.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the four stages of the TwSG framework, especially the generation of structured iMCoT trajectories. Deeply understand the motivation and implementation of Tag-level Importance Sampling (TL-IS) in the TL-GRPO algorithm, which is insightful for addressing gradient bias in long-sequence reinforcement learning.

recommendation.zh: 将视觉 tool-use（如 crop）能力蒸馏进 VLM 单次前向传播的思路很有趣，关注其 RL 构造 grounding 数据的具体 recipe。
recommendation.en: The idea of distilling visual tool-use (e.g., cropping) into a single VLM forward pass is interesting; pay attention to the specific RL recipe for constructing grounding data.

paper.title: ForeTime-VLA: Causal Future-Token Distillation from a World Action Model for Conveyor-Belt Manipulation
paper.abstract: Manipulating moving objects requires a policy to anticipate contact events, yet vision-language-action (VLA) policies are commonly fine-tuned from the current observation alone. World action models (WAMs) learn predictive dynamics, but running a video-scale teacher or explicitly imagining future frames at deployment is costly. We introduce ForeTime-VLA, a dense pi0.5 policy that distills a future-aware, action-equivalent representation from a frozen Fast-WAM-derived teacher while remaining causa

summary.core_problem: 在动态物体抓取（如传送带）任务中，VLA 策略需要预测未来状态（如接触时机和姿态），但直接在推理时运行世界模型（WAM）或生成未来视频帧的计算成本过高。
summary.importance: 展示了如何将世界模型（WAM）中的未来预测能力蒸馏到一个轻量级的因果历史编码器中，实现“离线利用未来信息，在线仅用历史信息”的高效部署，对 VLA 模型的端侧部署和表征学习有启发。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 ForeTime-VLA。离线阶段：利用冻结的视频 VAE（来自 Fast-WAM/Wan）提取当前和未来帧的视觉特征，训练一个非坍缩的适配器（Adapter），将这些特征压缩为 64 维的“教师表示”（Teacher Code），该表示与动作等效且包含未来信息。在线阶段：训练一个轻量级的因果历史编码器（输入过去 8 帧状态），预测上述教师表示、操作阶段和归一化的过渡时间。预测的教师表示作为条件输入到 π0.5 策略的 VLM 和动作专家模块中。
summary.experiments: 在真实机器人的传送带抓取任务（静止、运动、高压速度）中进行了评估。结果表明，包含未来感知监督的 ForeTime-VLA 减少了因时机过晚或接触姿态错误导致的失败，性能优于仅依赖当前观测的基线。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议：重点看 Figure 1 了解整体的 Teacher-Student 蒸馏架构，以及 Method 中关于如何构建和预测 Teacher Code 的部分。预计阅读时间 15 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: In dynamic manipulation tasks (e.g., conveyor belts), VLA policies must anticipate future states (e.g., contact timing and pose), but running a world action model (WAM) or generating future video frames during inference is computationally prohibitive.
summary_en.importance: Demonstrates how to distill the predictive capabilities of a WAM into a lightweight causal history encoder, enabling efficient deployment by leveraging future information offline while relying only on historical observations online. Offers insights for VLA deployment and representation learning.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes ForeTime-VLA. Offline phase: Uses a frozen video VAE (from Fast-WAM/Wan) to extract visual features from current and future frames. Trains a non-collapsed adapter to compress these features into a 64-D action-equivalent 'teacher code' containing future information. Online phase: Trains a lightweight causal history encoder (taking 8 past frames) to predict this teacher code, manipulation phase, and normalized time-to-transition. The predicted teacher code conditions both the VLM and action expert of a π0.5 policy.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on real-robot conveyor-belt pick-and-place tasks under stationary, moving, and speed-stress conditions. Results show that future-aware supervision reduces failures caused by late timing or incorrect contact poses, outperforming baselines relying solely on current observations.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim guide: Focus on Figure 1 to grasp the overall Teacher-Student distillation architecture, and the Method section detailing the construction and prediction of the Teacher Code. Estimated reading time: 15 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 将 World Model 的未来预测能力蒸馏到 VLA 策略中，且保持推理时的因果性（causal），这种跨模态特征对齐和蒸馏思路值得关注具身多模态的研究员扫读。
recommendation.en: Distills future-predictive capabilities from a World Model into a VLA policy while maintaining causal inference. The cross-modal feature alignment and distillation approach is worth skimming for embodied multimodal researchers.

paper.title: Every Coin Has Two Sides: On the Dual Nature of Generalization in On-Policy Distillation of Large Language Models
paper.abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) transfers teacher capabilities by supervising trajectories sampled from the student's own policy, yet its generalization behavior remains poorly understood, as most studies evaluate OPD on a single domain and on benchmarks close to the training data. We present a controlled study that varies one generalization factor at a time, from in-domain distribution shifts to cross-domain transfer and the multi-teacher setting. We find that OPD transfers a teacher's reasoning b

summary.core_problem: 这项工作研究 on-policy distillation 的泛化行为：学生在自己的轨迹上接受教师监督后，学到的是训练题目的答案、局部任务策略，还是更宽的推理行为。
summary.importance: 这篇论文对后训练与预训练研究都有参考价值。它把 OPD 的作用从“提高某个任务分数”拆成语言迁移、推理长度迁移、跨领域迁移、同源/异源教师差异和多教师干扰几个因素。一个重要结论是，OPD 传递的不是单个问题的答案，而更像是教师的推理行为分布；但这种迁移强烈依赖 teacher 和 student 是否来自同一基座。对训练 recipe 的含义很直接：多教师蒸馏不能假设 prompt routing 会把不同教师的影响限制在各自领域内，混合比例会带来能力跷跷板。
summary.technical_approach:
方法上使用标准 OPD 设置。给定 prompt x，学生策略先生成自己的 on-policy response y，训练信号来自教师在学生实际访问到的上下文 h_t=(x,y_<t) 上的 token 分布。目标可写成 teacher 与 student 之间的 reverse KL。实际训练采用 sampled-token k1 近似，也就是 PG-style OPD：如果教师给学生采样出的 token 更高概率，该 token 被强化；如果教师概率低于学生，该 token 被压制。

实验设计不是提出新蒸馏算法，而是控制变量分析 OPD 泛化。RQ1 固定数学领域，分别改变训练题难度、评测语言和推理长度，观察英文短程数学训练能否迁移到中文数学和长程组合数学。RQ2 研究跨领域迁移，例如数学提示是否改善代码和科学，其他领域提示是否反向改善数学，并把 teacher-student 关系分成 same-origin 和 cross-origin。same-origin 指教师和学生来自同一 base model 系列，常见形式是学生为 SFT checkpoint，教师是在同一 checkpoint 上经 RL 得到的模型；cross-origin 指二者来自不同基座。RQ3 扩展到 multi-teacher OPD，考察按领域路由 prompt 是否真的能隔离各专家影响。

核心观察是：训练题的表面难度影响很小，甚至教师从未解出的题也能作为有用训练提示。这说明监督信号主要来自教师对学生轨迹中局部行为的偏好，而不是完整解答是否正确。same-origin 教师能把学生在语言、推理长度和其他领域上拉近教师水平；cross-origin 教师更多改善训练分布本身，迁移弱得多，有时不如较弱的 same-origin 教师。
summary.experiments:
提供内容中没有完整表格和具体分数，但实验覆盖多组教师和学生，包括 Qwen3-32B、Light-R1-14B、Polaris-7B/4B、OpenMath-Nemotron-1.5B/7B、JustRL-DeepSeek-1.5B 等。主要结果包括四点。

第一，在数学域内，训练题难度不是主要因素。按教师 pass rate 或学生 pass rate 划分训练题后，OPD 的迁移效果差异很小；教师解不出的题也能产生有效监督。第二，训练只使用英文短程数学，仍能改善中文数学和长程组合数学，说明 OPD 的效果不局限于训练 prompt 的表面分布。第三，跨领域迁移存在，但强依赖模型来源关系。same-origin pair 可以在多个领域把学生拉近教师，而 cross-origin pair 往往主要提升训练域，在其他域迁移有限。第四，在 MOPD 中，领域路由不能完全隔离教师效果。每个教师都会影响非目标领域，多个教师合并后出现与 mixture 相关的能力跷跷板，而不是简单叠加各领域专家能力。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 30 到 40 分钟。先看 preliminaries 中 OPD 与 PG-style sampled-token k1 近似，确认训练信号到底是什么。然后直接看三个 RQ 的实验图表：训练难度分桶、语言/长度迁移、same-origin versus cross-origin、以及 multi-teacher mixture。最值得细看的点是同源关系的定义和实验控制，因为这决定了结论能否迁移到自己的后训练管线。MOPD 部分适合和多专家数据配比、RL teacher 选择、持续后训练的能力遗忘问题一起读。
summary.authors_note: 机构和作者名单未在给定内容中出现。

summary_en.core_problem: The work studies what on-policy distillation actually generalizes: task answers, local fitting to the training distribution, or broader reasoning behavior transferred from the teacher.
summary_en.importance: The main value is a controlled account of OPD as a post-training mechanism. It separates several factors that are often confounded: problem difficulty, language shift, reasoning-horizon shift, cross-domain transfer, model-origin relationship, and multi-teacher routing. The central finding is that OPD transfers teacher behavior more broadly than the training prompts suggest, but the breadth of transfer depends strongly on whether teacher and student share the same base-model lineage. This has direct implications for recipe design: multi-teacher OPD cannot be treated as independent domain-wise skill injection, because each teacher affects capabilities outside its routed domain.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The setup follows standard OPD. For a prompt x, the student samples an on-policy trajectory y. At each context h_t=(x,y_<t), the teacher provides token-level supervision. The ideal objective is a reverse KL between student and teacher policies. In practice, the paper uses the sampled-token k1 approximation, leading to a policy-gradient style OPD objective: a sampled token is reinforced when the teacher assigns it higher probability than the student, and suppressed otherwise.

The contribution is an experimental decomposition rather than a new distillation algorithm. RQ1 keeps the domain fixed to math and varies training difficulty, evaluation language, and reasoning horizon. RQ2 examines cross-domain transfer between math, code, and science, while distinguishing same-origin teacher-student pairs from cross-origin pairs. Same-origin means the teacher and student come from the same base-model lineage, for example an SFT checkpoint and an RL-trained teacher derived from it. Cross-origin means they come from different bases. RQ3 studies multi-teacher OPD, where prompts are routed to domain-specific teachers, and tests whether routing isolates teacher effects.

The key mechanism-level result is that OPD does not require the teacher to solve the training problem. Even prompts on which the teacher never succeeds can still be useful, because the supervision is applied to the student’s visited states and encodes local teacher preferences over continuations. Same-origin teachers transfer more globally across languages, horizons, and domains. Cross-origin teachers tend to improve the trained distribution more narrowly and may transfer less than a weaker same-origin teacher.
summary_en.experiments:
The provided content does not include the full numeric tables, but it lists a diverse set of teacher models, including Qwen3-32B, Light-R1-14B, Polaris-7B/4B, OpenMath-Nemotron-1.5B/7B, and JustRL-DeepSeek-1.5B.

The reported findings are consistent across the controlled settings. First, in-domain math transfer is largely insensitive to training-problem difficulty. Bucketing problems by teacher or student pass rate does not materially change the usefulness of OPD, and unsolved problems remain useful. Second, English short-horizon math OPD improves evaluation on Chinese math and longer-horizon composed math problems, indicating that the transfer is not just surface-distribution matching. Third, cross-domain transfer exists in both directions, but the origin relationship dominates: same-origin teachers move the student closer to the teacher across domains, while cross-origin teachers mostly help the trained distribution. Fourth, in multi-teacher OPD, domain routing does not isolate influence. Mixture choices create a capability seesaw because each teacher affects other domains as well as its assigned one.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 30 to 40 minutes. Read the OPD preliminaries first, especially the reverse-KL formulation and the PG-style k1 sampled-token approximation. Then focus on the figures or tables for the three research questions: difficulty buckets, language and horizon shifts, same-origin versus cross-origin transfer, and multi-teacher mixture effects. The most important details are the definition of model origin and the controls used to vary one generalization factor at a time. The multi-teacher section is particularly relevant for teams using domain experts, RL teachers, or continued post-training mixtures.
summary_en.authors_note: The provided content does not identify the institutions or author list.

recommendation.zh: 师生同源性决定 OPD 跨域迁移边界这一结论直接影响蒸馏数据与教师选择策略，重点读 §3 同源 vs 异源对比实验。
recommendation.en: The finding that teacher-student origin dominates OPD cross-domain transfer directly informs distillation data and teacher selection; focus on §3 same- vs cross-origin comparisons.

institutions: University of Science and Technology of China

paper.title: REOPD: Reliability-Adaptive Reward Extrapolation for On-Policy Distillation
paper.abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains a student on its own trajectories under dense token-level supervision from a teacher. Reward-extrapolation methods such as ExOPD amplify the teacher-reference log-likelihood ratio to move beyond direct imitation, but apply a single global coefficient $λ$ to every token. This can drive the student to fit extreme peaks in the implicit reward, causing reward hacking and unstable training, and the optimal $λ$ varies across domains, requiring costly sweeps. We prop

summary.core_problem: On-policy distillation 中，ExOPD 用单一全局 λ 放大 teacher–reference 对数比这一隐式奖励，对所有 token 一视同仁，容易被极端峰值主导，导致 reward hacking 和训练不稳，且 λ 需要按域反复调参。
summary.importance: 属于 post-training 方向，但触及 pretrain–posttrain 接口上一个有普遍意义的问题：如何在不引入外部验证器的前提下，对稠密 token 级监督信号做自适应加权。其把 teacher–reference 残差与 student–teacher 对齐项解耦控制的思路，对在线蒸馏、RLAIF、以及把推理能力回灌到基座的持续训练都有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: REOPD 保留标准 OPD 的 student–teacher 对齐代价 a_t，只对额外的 teacher–reference 残差 r_t 做自适应缩放。有效系数由两部分相乘：token 级兼容性权重 q_{b,i,t}∈(0,1]，衡量该 token 上 student 与 teacher 的局部兼容程度；以及跨 data-parallel rank 同步得到的 micro-batch 共享预算 γ_b∈[0,γ_max]，控制整批外推强度。控制器路径只 all-reduce 已 detach 的统计量，不引入额外前向。该构造是 ExOPD 的严格推广：γ_b=0 退化为 OPD，q=1 且 γ_b=λ−1 退化为固定 λ 的 ExOPD。不需要 verifier、reward model、value model 或额外 rollout。
summary.experiments: 在数学推理、代码生成、以及多教师混合域蒸馏上对比 OPD 与固定 λ 扫描。重复实验下，REOPD 在单教师数学和多教师数学/代码设置上优于 G-OPD，单教师代码上与 G-OPD 持平；关键收益是无需为每个域单独扫 λ 即可获得有竞争力的表现，缓解了极端隐式奖励峰值造成的不稳定。论文未披露具体模型规模与绝对分数，消融主要集中在 q 与 γ 设计的对比上。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读 20 分钟左右。重点读 Introduction 后半段关于“对齐与外推应分开控制”的观察，以及方法部分对 token cost 公式的拆解；Figure 1(b) 的 token path / controller path 分离是核心设计。若关心实现，可留意 γ_b 的 all-reduce 统计量如何在不破坏 on-policy 性质的前提下计算。

summary_en.core_problem: In on-policy distillation, ExOPD uses a single global λ to amplify the teacher–reference log-ratio (an implicit reward) uniformly across tokens, allowing extreme peaks to dominate updates and causing reward hacking and instability, while λ also requires per-domain sweeps.
summary_en.importance: This is a post-training paper, but it bears on a general issue at the pretrain–posttrain interface: how to adaptively weight dense token-level supervision without external verifiers. The idea of controlling the teacher–reference residual separately from the student–teacher alignment term is relevant to online distillation, RLAIF-style training, and continued pretraining that injects reasoning behavior back into the base model.
summary_en.technical_approach: REOPD keeps the standard OPD student–teacher alignment cost a_t and only adapts the additional teacher–reference residual r_t. The effective coefficient is the product of a token-level compatibility weight q_{b,i,t}∈(0,1], which captures local student–teacher agreement, and a micro-batch shared budget γ_b∈[0,γ_max] obtained by all-reducing detached statistics across data-parallel ranks. The controller path only communicates detached sufficient statistics and adds no extra forward passes. The construction strictly generalizes ExOPD: γ_b=0 recovers OPD, and q=1 with γ_b=λ−1 recovers fixed-λ ExOPD. No verifier, reward model, value model, or additional rollout is needed.
summary_en.experiments: Compared against OPD and a fixed-λ sweep on mathematical reasoning, code generation, and mixed-domain multi-teacher distillation. Across repeated runs, REOPD outperforms G-OPD on single-teacher math and on both math and code in the multi-teacher setting, and matches G-OPD on single-teacher code. The main practical gain is competitive performance without task-specific λ tuning, along with reduced instability from extreme implicit-reward peaks. The paper does not report concrete model sizes or absolute scores; ablations focus on the q and γ designs.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20 minutes. Focus on the latter half of the introduction for the observation that alignment and extrapolation should be controlled separately, and on the token-cost derivation in the method section; Figure 1(b) showing the token path / controller path split is the central design. If you care about implementation, note how the all-reduced statistics for γ_b are computed without breaking on-policy semantics.

recommendation.zh: 重点看§3.3的token级兼容性权重设计，预训练蒸馏时可参考该思路避免局部极端表示的放大。
recommendation.en: Focus on §3.3 for token-level compatibility weight design; reference this idea to avoid amplifying local extreme representations during pretraining distillation.

paper.title: SQuaT: Self-Supervised Knowledge Distillation via Student-Aware Quantized Teacher Features
paper.abstract: Quantization-Aware Training (QAT) enables the deployment of quantized models with minimal accuracy degradation. However, in practical scenarios, training labels are often unavailable due to privacy, copyright, or cost constraints. Knowledge Distillation (KD) is a common approach to address this challenge, but we observe that prior work combining QAT with KD suffers from a fundamental limitation: during distillation, the range mismatch between the teacher and the quantized student model induces a

summary.core_problem: 解决无标签场景下量化感知训练结合知识蒸馏时，教师与量化学生特征范围不匹配导致蒸馏损失存在不可达残差下界的问题。
summary.importance: 这是量化/蒸馏方向的训练方法论文，主要面向部署效率。对 LLM 基座研究的直接价值有限，但“teacher target 需适配 student 表示约束”这个结论对蒸馏和低比特训练有普适性。
summary.technical_approach: SQuaT 提出 student-aware quantized teacher features：在蒸馏时，不直接用全精度教师特征作为目标，而是用学生的量化参数对教师特征做同构量化，使教师目标落入学生可表达的范围，从理论上消除由 range mismatch 带来的 distillation loss 下界。整个框架是 label-free QAT with KD。
summary.experiments: 摘要称在多种设置下持续优于强基线，但未给出具体模型、位宽、数据集和提升幅度。工作重点是量化模型训练与部署，不是 LLM 推理系统或大模型压缩的系统级研究。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses an irreducible distillation-loss floor in label-free QAT with KD, caused by range mismatch between full-precision teacher features and quantized student representations.
summary_en.importance: This is mainly an efficiency/quantization training paper. Its direct relevance to LLM foundation-model research is limited, but the lesson that teacher targets should respect student representational constraints is broadly useful.
summary_en.technical_approach: SQuaT introduces student-aware quantized teacher features: instead of distilling from full-precision teacher activations, it quantizes teacher features using the student’s quantization parameters so the targets lie in the student’s attainable space. The authors argue this removes the lower bound on distillation loss induced by range mismatch.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract claims consistent gains over strong baselines across diverse settings, but does not provide model sizes, bit widths, datasets, or exact margins. The focus is quantized training rather than LLM-specific compression or serving.

recommendation.zh: 增量型量化蒸馏论文，但那个“teacher target 必须落在 student 可达空间里”的论证是干净的；看理论动机即可，实验不必细抠。
recommendation.en: Incremental quantization work, but the argument that teacher targets must live inside the student’s attainable space is clean; read the motivation, not the full experimental section.

paper.title: Chain of Spatial Thoughts: Modality-Agnostic Spatial Grounding for Vision Language Models
paper.abstract: Spatial understanding is fundamental to embodied intelligence, underpinning applications such as robotic manipulation, embodied navigation, and autonomous driving. Although recent vision-language models (VLMs) have achieved impressive performance on spatial reasoning benchmarks, state-of-the-art approaches typically rely on additional spatial encoders or architectural modifications during inference, increasing computational cost. We introduce Space Tokens, a lightweight, architecture-agnostic fr

summary.core_problem: 这项工作要解决的是 VLM 空间推理能力的注入方式：如何让模型获得显式 3D 几何和物体级空间属性，同时不在推理时外挂 3D 重建编码器、几何连接器或额外空间模块。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练研究的启发主要在统一表示和 latent token 监督。它不是单纯做空间 benchmark，而是把 3D 几何知识压到 VLM 的生成序列中，用保留词表位置对应的 hidden states 承载连续空间表示。这个思路和视觉 tokenizer、latent knowledge token、native multimodal mid-train 接口关系较近：外部专家模型只在训练阶段提供监督，推理阶段由原 VLM 内部表示承接知识。贡献量级偏方法型，不是大规模预训练 recipe，但对“如何把不可文本化的结构知识并入 LM token 流”有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: 方法叫 Space Tokens。核心做法是预留一组特殊 token，但不使用它们的离散 token id 表达空间信息，而是取这些 token 生成位置的最后层 hidden states 作为连续空间向量。模型仍按自回归方式生成文本和空间 token，因此不需要改 Transformer 结构，也不需要在推理时调用额外 3D 模块。训练时，空间 token 接受两类监督：一类是 scene-level 3D geometry，把大型 3D reconstruction 模型产生的场景几何知识蒸馏进 VLM latent space；另一类是 object-centric spatial attributes，把 3D bounding box 的位置、朝向和尺寸编码进专用 latent token。与直接拼接深度图、点云 encoder 或几何 adapter 相比，这种方案把几何监督放在训练期，把推理期接口保持为普通 VLM token 流。代价是空间 token 的语义依赖监督质量，且连续表示需要额外 decoder 或 probe 才能被显式验证。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖空间推理、视觉问答和通用 VQA。文中报告 Space Tokens 在 VSI-Bench 上使 Qwen3-VL-8B 提升 4.3 分，使 SenseNova1.3 提升 1.3 分；在 object size 和 room size estimation 上也取得较强结果。更有信息量的部分不是单个分数，而是两个现象：第一，外部 3D 教师模型可以在训练后被移除，说明几何信号部分进入了 VLM 内部状态；第二，空间 token 可被解码回可解释 3D 模态，用于检查模型学到的是否是几何结构，而不只是 benchmark shortcut。摘要和给定正文没有完整列出各 benchmark 的绝对分数、训练数据规模和消融数值，因此这些部分需要读表确认。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 20–30 分钟。重点看 Methodology 中空间 token 的定义、hidden state 抽取位置、scene-level 和 object-level 两类监督的具体 loss，以及是否在训练和推理阶段引入不同组件。实验部分优先看 VSI-Bench 的主表、object size / room size 估计表、空间 token 可视化或可解码验证图。消融需要关注三点：只用场景几何、只用物体 3D box、两者同时使用的差异；空间 token 数量和插入位置；通用 VQA 是否退化。这些决定它更像一个稳健的 latent token 接口，还是主要依赖特定空间 benchmark 的监督适配。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how to inject explicit 3D geometry and object-level spatial attributes into VLMs without adding reconstruction encoders, geometry adapters, or other inference-time spatial modules.
summary_en.importance: The main relevance to foundation-model pretraining is the representation interface. Space Tokens treat reserved token positions as carriers of continuous latent states, supervised by external geometric signals during training and used as native tokens at inference. This connects to visual tokenization, latent knowledge tokens, and multimodal mid-training: a teacher model supplies structured non-text information, while the deployed VLM keeps the same autoregressive interface. The contribution is methodological rather than a large-scale pretraining recipe, but it is useful for thinking about how non-linguistic structure can be folded into an LM token stream.
summary_en.technical_approach: Space Tokens reserve a subset of the vocabulary and let the VLM generate these tokens just like normal autoregressive tokens. Their discrete identities are not the main representation; the final-layer hidden states at these positions are used as continuous spatial embeddings. The training supervision has two branches. One distills scene-level 3D geometry from large 3D reconstruction models into the VLM latent space. The other encodes object-centric 3D bounding-box attributes, including position, orientation, and size, into dedicated spatial tokens. Compared with attaching depth, point-cloud, or geometry encoders, the heavy geometry model is only used during training. The trade-off is that the learned latent tokens depend on teacher quality and need decoders or probes for explicit verification.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation covers spatial reasoning, visual QA, and general VQA. The reported gains include +4.3 points on VSI-Bench for Qwen3-VL-8B and +1.3 points for SenseNova1.3. The method also reports strong results on object-size and room-size estimation. The more useful evidence is qualitative and diagnostic: the 3D teacher can be removed at inference, and the learned spatial states remain decodable into interpretable 3D modalities. The provided text does not expose the full score tables, data scale, or all ablation numbers, so those details should be checked directly in the experimental section.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20–30 minutes. Focus on the Methodology section: how spatial tokens are inserted, which hidden states are supervised, what losses are used for scene-level geometry and object-level boxes, and whether the training and inference graphs differ. In the experiments, read the VSI-Bench table, the object-size and room-size estimation results, and any visualization or decoding analysis of Space Tokens. The most important ablations are scene geometry only versus object boxes only, the number and placement of spatial tokens, and whether general VQA performance is preserved.

recommendation.zh: 做多模态预训练的空间能力注入可参考其蒸馏思路，重点看§3的Space Tokens设计和消融实验
recommendation.en: Reference for spatial ability injection in multimodal pretraining; focus on §3 Space Tokens design and ablation studies.

paper.title: SkillLens: Visual Skill Cards for Retrieval-Augmented GUI Action Prediction and On-Policy Distillation
paper.abstract: Computer-using agents can perceive rich software interfaces, yet their decisions often lack visual procedural memory: they may recognize individual controls without identifying which familiar workflow is active, which control matters next, or what evidence would confirm progress. Raw interaction traces preserve such information but are long and noisy to condition on, whereas text-only skills often omit the visual state that makes a procedure applicable. We introduce Visual Skill Cards (VSCs), a

summary.core_problem: GUI操作Agent缺乏结构化视觉过程记忆，原始交互轨迹过长噪声大，纯文本技能描述丢失视觉状态线索，导致决策不可靠。
summary.importance: 方法创新，提出视觉技能卡这一状态条件化的记忆表示，同时支持检索增强推理和同策略蒸馏。
summary.technical_approach: 提出SkillLens框架：1）Trace-to-Visual-Skill-Card模块从异构交互经验中抽取可复用过程、适用线索、视觉证据与验证信号，绑定为Visual Skill Cards（VSC）；2）推理时检索相关VSC，仅展开执行器所需证据；3）CardDistill用VSC证据作为监督信号对固定VLM执行器做同策略蒸馏。
summary.experiments: 在GUI操作预测任务上，基于固定视觉语言模型执行器，对比原始轨迹条件与纯文本技能检索，VSC检索+选择性证据展开提升预测准确率，蒸馏后模型进一步降低推理开销。

summary_en.core_problem: GUI agents lack structured visual procedural memory; raw interaction traces are long and noisy, while text-only skill descriptions discard visual state cues needed for reliable decision-making.
summary_en.importance: Methodological contribution: a state-conditioned memory representation (Visual Skill Cards) that supports both retrieval-augmented inference and on-policy distillation in a unified framework.
summary_en.technical_approach: SkillLens consists of three parts: (1) Trace-to-Visual-Skill-Card extracts reusable procedures, applicability cues, visual evidence, and verification signals from heterogeneous interaction traces into Visual Skill Cards (VSCs); (2) at inference, retrieves relevant VSCs and selectively expands only evidence required by a fixed VLM executor; (3) CardDistill uses VSC evidence as supervision for on-policy distillation of the executor.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on GUI action prediction tasks; compared to raw trace conditioning and text-only skill retrieval, VSC retrieval with selective evidence expansion improves prediction accuracy, and distillation further reduces inference compute.

recommendation.zh: GUI Agent的记忆表示改进，对预训练研究员无直接方法迁移价值，看摘要了解视觉-过程绑定思路即可。
recommendation.en: Incremental memory representation work for GUI agents; no direct transferable insight for pretraining researchers, read only the abstract for the visual-procedure binding idea.

paper.title: Agent Memory Distillation: Empowering Small LLM Agents with Hierarchical Teacher Memory
paper.abstract: Memory systems have shown promise for improving agent performance, but their potential remains largely unexplored for small language models, which struggle to generate sufficient successful trajectories on their own. We propose Agent Memory Distillation (AMD), a training-free framework that transfers structured knowledge from a large teacher agent to a small student agent through hierarchical memory. AMD constructs three complementary memory types from successful teacher trajectories: Workflow m

summary.core_problem: 小语言模型agent自身任务成功率低，生成的成功轨迹数量少，自建记忆库以失败轨迹为主，记忆利用效果受限。直接将大模型teacher的原始记忆迁移给小模型student收益极低，原因是师生能力存在差距，且小模型的上下文学习能力和指令跟随能力较弱，无法有效理解和应用teacher的知识。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发在于，分层知识迁移的设计思路可借鉴到模型蒸馏、合成数据构造等场景，尤其适用于需要向小模型做参数高效或免训练能力注入的场景；迁移质量依赖师生兼容性的结论，也对学生模型预训练和蒸馏流程设计有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出Agent Memory Distillation（AMD）免训练框架，从teacher agent的成功轨迹中构造三类互补的分层记忆：Workflow记忆编码任务级的分解与高层规划策略，Subtask记忆提供子任务粒度的具体行为示例，Function记忆记录工具调用的schema、约定和常见问题。Workflow和Subtask记忆在任务开始时主动注入给student，Function记忆则在推理过程中student遇到工具调用错误时被动检索使用。
summary.experiments: 以GPT-5-mini为teacher，4个4B/8B参数的小模型为student，在3个基准上验证效果。AMD相比零样本基线，在AppWorld上平均准确率提升27.2个百分点，BFCL V3上提升11.2个百分点，ToolSandbox上提升3.4个百分点，优于所有非蒸馏设计的记忆基线；同时减少了交互轮数，生成的轨迹更接近teacher。消融实验显示三类记忆各有独立贡献，迁移质量同时取决于teacher准确率和师生兼容性，4B规模的student收益最大。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议：重点看引言中关于朴素记忆迁移失效的观察（图1），第3章的三层记忆设计与注入机制，实验部分的消融结果与师生兼容性分析。预计阅读时间15-20分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Small LLM agents have low task success rates and produce few successful trajectories, so their self-built memory repositories are dominated by failed experiences, limiting the utility of memory-based methods. Naive transfer of raw memory from a stronger teacher agent brings only marginal gains, as the capability gap between teacher and student, combined with limited in-context learning and instruction-following ability of small models, prevents effective comprehension and application of teacher knowledge.
summary_en.importance: For pretraining research, the hierarchical knowledge transfer design offers a useful reference for distillation pipelines and synthetic data construction, especially for scenarios requiring parameter-efficient or training-free capability injection into small models. The finding that transfer quality depends on teacher-student compatibility also informs student model pretraining and distillation recipe design.
summary_en.technical_approach: Agent Memory Distillation (AMD) is a training-free framework that constructs three complementary hierarchical memory types from successful teacher agent trajectories. Workflow memory encodes task-level decomposition and high-level planning strategies. Subtask memory provides concrete action examples at intermediate subtask granularity. Function memory captures tool calling schemas, conventions, and common pitfalls. Workflow and Subtask memories are proactively injected into the student at the start of each task, while Function memory is retrieved reactively when the student encounters tool calling errors during inference.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated with GPT-5-mini as the teacher and 4 small models (4B or 8B parameters) as students across 3 benchmarks. AMD achieves average accuracy improvements of 27.2 percentage points on AppWorld, 11.2 percentage points on BFCL V3, and 3.4 percentage points on ToolSandbox over zero-shot baselines, outperforming all non-distillation memory baselines. It also reduces interaction turns and produces trajectories more similar to the teacher. Ablations show each memory type contributes uniquely, transfer quality depends on both teacher accuracy and teacher-student compatibility, and 4B-scale students gain the largest benefit.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the introduction for the observation of naive memory transfer failure (Figure 1), Section 3 for the three-layer memory design and injection mechanism, and the experiment section for ablation results and teacher-student compatibility analysis. Estimated reading time: 15-20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 一种 test-time 的知识蒸馏（通过 prompt/memory 注入），展示了如何结构化地利用大模型的轨迹来辅助小模型，对构建 Agent 系统有一定参考价值，但非预训练核心。
recommendation.en: A test-time knowledge distillation approach (via prompt/memory injection) demonstrating how to structurally utilize large model trajectories to assist small models; offers reference value for building Agent systems, though not core to pretraining.

paper.title: SPOT: Sparse Probing and Outcome Calibration for On-Policy Distillation
paper.abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) provides dense teacher supervision on student-generated trajectories, but standard reverse-KL training can assign insufficient probability to other plausible continuations. Teacher entropy alone does not reveal whether uncertainty is concentrated among a few plausible next tokens or dispersed over a long probability tail, nor whether the student already represents those candidates well. Moreover, local teacher probabilities may not predict downstream success. We intr

summary.core_problem: 现有同策略蒸馏（OPD）采用的reverse KL训练存在模式寻找缺陷，会压缩合理替代续写的概率空间；后续改进的基于熵触发的EOPD方法仅依靠教师熵标记不确定位置，既无法区分不确定性是集中在少数合理token还是分散在概率长尾，也未考虑学生对候选token的掌握程度，同时教师的局部token概率与下游轨迹成功率不存在稳定对应关系，最终导致探针预算分配失准、蒸馏目标与实际任务结果不匹配。
summary.importance: 属于大模型后训练蒸馏方向的实用改进，解决了OPD中探针位置选择与蒸馏目标校准的耦合问题，在不损失平均准确率的前提下提升了小模型的多解覆盖能力，对推理类小模型的生产落地有直接参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 将OPD的选择性监督拆分为「在哪里分配探针预算」和「构造什么蒸馏目标」两个耦合决策，通过三阶段的获取-探索-利用流程实现：1）获取阶段设计位置级评分，乘积组合三个筛选因子——教师top-k候选集的概率集中度、位置处教师熵、学生与教师在候选集上的分布/排序匹配度，仅给三个因子同时满足阈值的位置分配探针；2）探索阶段对选中位置，依次将教师top-k集合中的每个候选接在当前前缀后，用学生策略生成完整轨迹，交由任务验证器打分；3）利用阶段基于验证得到的下游结果对教师分布做奖励倾斜，得到带KL正则的闭式蒸馏目标，仅在存在正奖励候选的位置施加额外局部损失，让目标既锚定教师分布，又向下游成功率更高的候选倾斜概率。
summary.experiments: 在3个不同规模的Qwen学生模型、6个数学推理基准上开展测试，SPOT在所有实验设置下的macro Pass@8指标均达到对比方法最优，macro Avg@8达到最优或次优，在保持平均准确率竞争力的同时，显著提升了多采样场景下的解覆盖度。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，预计阅读时间15分钟。重点关注引言部分对现有OPD方法缺陷的拆解、三阶段流程的设计逻辑，无需深究闭式目标的推导细节，核心可借鉴点是探针位置的三个筛选维度，以及用下游rollout结果校准局部token级监督目标的设计思路。

summary_en.core_problem: Standard on-policy distillation (OPD) for LLM reasoning transfer suffers from mode-seeking behavior under reverse-KL training, which underweights plausible alternative continuations. Existing entropy-aware improvements such as EOPD rely solely on teacher entropy to flag uncertain positions, which cannot distinguish whether uncertainty is concentrated on a small set of plausible tokens or spread across a long probability tail, nor account for how well the student already represents those candidates. Local teacher next-token probabilities also do not reliably predict downstream trajectory success, leading to misallocated probing budgets and distillation targets misaligned with actual task outcomes.
summary_en.importance: This work delivers a practical improvement to post-training distillation pipelines for transferring reasoning capabilities from large teachers to smaller students. It formalizes the coupled decisions of probing budget allocation and target construction in OPD, delivering better multi-solution coverage without sacrificing average accuracy, which is relevant for production deployment of small reasoning models.
summary_en.technical_approach: SPOT frames selective OPD supervision as two coupled decisions: where to allocate limited probing budget, and what supervision target to distill at probed positions, implemented via a three-stage acquisition-exploration-exploitation pipeline. In acquisition, positions are ranked by a composite score multiplying three factors: concentration of teacher probability mass in a small top-k candidate set, teacher entropy at the position, and distribution/ranking mismatch between student and teacher over the candidate set. In exploration, for selected positions, each candidate in the teacher's top-k is appended to the current prefix, rolled out under the student policy, and scored by a task verifier. In exploitation, verified downstream outcomes are used to construct a closed-form, KL-regularized distillation target that tilts the teacher distribution toward high-outcome candidates; an additional local loss is applied only at positions where at least one candidate receives positive verifier reward.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated across three Qwen student model scales on six mathematical reasoning benchmarks, SPOT achieves the highest macro Pass@8 across all tested settings, and the highest or second-highest macro Avg@8 across compared methods. The method delivers stronger multi-sample solution coverage while maintaining competitive average accuracy.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the paper in approximately 15 minutes. Focus on the problem analysis in the introduction identifying limitations of prior OPD approaches, and the design rationale for the three-stage pipeline. Skip exhaustive derivation of the closed-form target unless implementing the method; the core actionable insight is the set of factors for selecting probing positions and the principle of calibrating local token supervision with downstream rollout outcomes.

recommendation.zh: on-policy蒸馏的实用改进，重点看§3的探测预算分配策略与结果校准目标设计，可用于内部RL后蒸馏ablation。
recommendation.en: Practical improvement for on-policy distillation; focus on §3 probing budget allocation and outcome-calibrated target design, useful for internal post-RL distillation ablations.

paper.title: Maglev: Sliding Recurrent Memory
paper.abstract: We introduce \ours{}, a recurrent Transformer architecture with fixed-size memory that generalizes sliding-window attention while remaining parallelizable during training. \ours{} consists of two coupled models: a prefiller $Q$, which leverages full attention\footnote{In practice, we use interleaved full and sliding-window attention for $Q$, as this yields stronger performance. The essential requirement is that $Q$ be more expressive than $P$, with access to the full history.} to produce memory

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是长上下文语言建模里一个老问题：全注意力 Transformer 记忆能力强，但推理成本随上下文增长；滑窗注意力推理便宜，但没有真正的长期记忆；传统 recurrent/SSM 虽然有固定状态，但更新形式受限，且往往难以兼顾 Transformer 的非线性表达和大规模并行预训练。作者想要的是三件事同时成立：每个 token 都能写入一个可持续的潜在记忆；推理时记忆大小固定、KV cache 有界；训练时仍然能像普通 Transformer 一样并行。Maglev 的核心问题就是如何在不做顺序展开训练的前提下，得到一个 token-wise、非线性、可部署的 recurrent Transformer。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发主要在架构与训练接口，而不是单纯长上下文 benchmark。它提出了一种把“训练时并行、推理时递归”分开的做法：训练阶段用更强的 prefiller 生成目标记忆轨迹，部署阶段只保留轻量 decoder 自回馈自己的记忆。这个思路和知识蒸馏有相似处，但蒸馏的对象不是 logits，而是每个位置的 latent memory trajectory。对基座模型研究来说，价值在于它给出了一个可扩展的 recurrent memory 训练范式，试图保留 Transformer 的非线性更新能力，同时把推理成本压到固定窗口。若这一范式继续成立，它会影响长上下文预训练、bounded-memory serving、以及“训练目标是否应显式约束内部状态”这类问题。
summary.technical_approach:
Maglev 由两个耦合模型组成：prefiller Q 和 decoder P。

Q 是训练时使用的强模型。它是因果的，但拥有比部署模型更强的上下文访问能力。文中实际实现里，Q 使用 interleaved full attention 和 sliding-window attention，因此它能在不看未来的前提下，用整段已观测前缀并行地产生每个位置的目标记忆 m'_t。这里的关键不是 Q 的具体形式，而是它必须比 P 更有表达力，能给出一个“理想记忆轨迹”。

P 是真正部署的模型。它只使用 sliding-window attention，再加一个 recurrent K/V injection 通道，把前一时刻或前一段的 memory window 作为额外 K/V 输入。P 在位置 t 既要预测下一个 token，也要输出自己的记忆 m_t。作者把 decoder 最后一层的 normalized state 同时作为 LM head 输入和 memory 写入值，因此不需要额外 memory token，也不需要单独的 memory cache 结构。推理时，P 只保留固定大小的 token window 和 memory window，随着序列增长成本不再增加。

训练难点在于：如果直接训练 P 的递归接口，就必须顺序生成 m_1, m_2, ..., m_T，失去 Transformer 预训练最重要的序列并行性。作者的 lifted parallel training 通过 Q 绕开这个问题。训练时先用 Q 在整段序列上并行生成 m'_1:T，再把移位后的 m'_{0:T-1} 喂给 P，让 P 在并行条件下学习两件事：一是用这些目标记忆做 next-token prediction，二是输出自己的 m_t 去逼近 m'_t。这个 consistency loss 把“内部状态监督”显式化了。到推理时，Q 被丢弃，P 用自己上一时刻生成的 memory 闭环运行。

从方法取舍看，Maglev 和 segment-level memory Transformer 的区别在于它是 token-wise memory，没有块边界；和 linear attention/SSM 的区别在于 memory update 经过完整 Transformer 深度，是非线性的；和普通 sliding-window Transformer 的区别在于它多了一个可持续的 latent memory 通道；和直接训练 recurrent Transformer 的区别在于它把训练中的 latent trajectory 外显出来，用双通路并行训练替代顺序展开。
summary.experiments:
摘要和正文给出的主结果集中在一个 435M 级别的 deployed decoder，上游训练 token 数为 43.52B。对比对象包括 matched sliding-window Transformer，以及 matched latent recurrent Transformer。最核心的指标是 FineWeb-Edu validation BPB，从 0.7413 降到 0.7251；平均下游准确率从 54.1 提升到 56.4。这个提升幅度不算夸张，但在参数量和训练预算匹配的前提下，说明固定记忆窗口确实带来了可测的语言建模收益。

从论文叙述看，作者还强调两个实验点。第一，Q 和 P 可以共享大部分参数，同时保留大部分收益。这一点很关键，因为如果 prefiller 完全独立，训练成本会接近双模型；参数共享意味着 lifted training 可能在工程上可接受。第二，Maglev 不只优于纯 sliding-window，也优于 matched latent recurrent Transformer，说明收益不只是“多加一个状态”这么简单，而是来自 memory target construction + consistency training 这套接口。

虽然当前给出的数字主要是验证集 BPB 和平均下游准确率，但读实验时要特别留意三类消融：memory window 大小、prefiller 能力强弱、以及 consistency loss 权重。如果这些消融完整，能帮助判断收益到底来自更强训练教师，还是来自部署时真正学会了稳定的递归记忆。另一个值得看的是参数共享比例与性能的关系，这决定方法的实际预训练成本。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读时建议按“问题—接口—成本”三步看。

先看引言前半和方法总图，确认作者要解决的不是一般的 long-context attention 优化，而是 token-wise latent memory 的训练可并行化问题。理解这一点后，Q/P 双模型结构就比较自然。

然后重点看方法部分关于 lifted parallel training 的定义。需要弄清楚三件事：Q 生成的 m'_t 是否严格因果；P 在训练时到底接收什么输入；consistency loss 约束的是哪一层、哪种 memory 表示。这里决定了方法是否存在训练-推理错配，以及这种错配有多大。

最后看实验部分的主表和消融。优先关注与 matched sliding-window Transformer 的对比、与其他 latent recurrent baseline 的对比、以及参数共享实验。如果时间有限，30–45 分钟足够完成一次有效泛读。若要判断它是否适合基座预训练路线，建议额外细看训练吞吐、显存开销、prefiller 是否需要 full attention、以及长序列推理时 memory drift 是否累积。

summary_en.core_problem: Maglev targets a long-standing trade-off in language modeling. Full-attention Transformers retain the whole prefix and therefore support strong retrieval and in-context computation, but inference cost grows with context length. Sliding-window attention keeps inference bounded, but it has no true persistent long-term memory. Classical recurrent models and modern linear-attention or state-space models keep fixed-size state, yet their update rules are more constrained and do not preserve the full nonlinear depth of a Transformer. The paper asks whether one can build a token-wise nonlinear recurrent-memory Transformer that has bounded-memory inference and still supports large-scale parallel pretraining.
summary_en.importance: The main contribution is architectural and procedural rather than benchmark-driven. Maglev proposes a clean split between training-time memory construction and inference-time memory propagation. During training, a stronger causal prefiller produces target latent memories in parallel; at deployment, only a lighter decoder remains, feeding back its own memories recurrently. This is reminiscent of distillation, but the distilled object is not logits or hidden states in the usual sense. It is a full latent memory trajectory. For pretraining research, this matters because it offers a plausible recipe for combining Transformer-style nonlinear computation with fixed-memory inference, and because it makes internal-state supervision an explicit training signal rather than an emergent side effect.
summary_en.technical_approach:
Maglev consists of two coupled models, a prefiller Q and a decoder P.

Q is used only during training. It is causal, but more expressive than the deployed model because it has access to a larger receptive field. In the implementation described in the paper, Q uses interleaved full attention and sliding-window attention. Its job is to produce a target memory trajectory m'_1:T in parallel from the observed prefix, without leaking future information.

P is the deployed model. It uses sliding-window attention plus recurrent K/V injection, where a shifted memory window is inserted as additional key-value context. At each position, P predicts the next token and emits its own memory m_t. A notable design choice is that the decoder’s final normalized state serves both as the input to the LM head and as the written memory. This avoids dedicated memory tokens and avoids a separate memory-cache mechanism. At inference time, P keeps only a fixed token window and a fixed memory window, so cost remains bounded as the sequence grows.

The training challenge is that direct recurrent training would require sequentially generating m_1, m_2, ..., m_T, which destroys the sequence parallelism that makes Transformer pretraining efficient. The paper’s lifted parallel training avoids this by externalizing the latent trajectory. First, Q computes m'_1:T in a causal but sequence-parallel pass. Then shifted memories m'_{0:T-1} are fed into P, which is trained in parallel to do two things: predict next tokens and reproduce the target memories via a consistency loss between m_t and m'_t. At inference, Q is discarded and P closes the loop with its own generated memories.

Relative to prior approaches, Maglev differs from segment-level memory Transformers by writing memory at every token rather than at block boundaries. It differs from linear attention and SSMs by using full nonlinear Transformer depth for each memory update. It differs from a plain sliding-window Transformer by adding a persistent latent-memory channel. And it differs from directly trained recurrent Transformers by replacing sequential latent-state unrolling with a two-pass parallel training procedure.
summary_en.experiments:
The headline experiment uses a deployed decoder at roughly 435M parameters trained on 43.52B tokens. The main baselines are a matched sliding-window Transformer and a matched latent recurrent Transformer. The key reported result is on FineWeb-Edu validation BPB, improving from 0.7413 to 0.7251. Average downstream accuracy improves from 54.1 to 56.4. The gains are moderate rather than dramatic, but they are meaningful given matched model scale and training budget, and they suggest that bounded recurrent memory can improve language modeling beyond what a plain sliding window captures.

Two additional experimental points are especially relevant. First, Q and P can share most parameters while retaining most of the gains. This matters because otherwise the training setup would look like nearly doubling the model. Parameter sharing makes the recipe more plausible for large-scale pretraining. Second, Maglev outperforms not only the sliding-window baseline but also a matched latent recurrent Transformer baseline, which suggests the benefit is not merely from adding state, but from the specific target-memory construction and consistency-training interface.

When reading the experiments, the most informative ablations are likely to be memory-window size, prefiller strength, and consistency-loss weighting. These determine whether the gains come from a genuinely stable recurrent interface or simply from a stronger training-time teacher. Another important axis is the amount of parameter sharing between Q and P, since that directly affects the true pretraining cost.
summary_en.reading_guide:
A useful skim is to read it in the order of problem, interface, and cost.

Start with the introduction and the main architecture figure. The paper is not primarily about making attention cheaper. It is about making token-wise latent memory trainable in parallel. Once that is clear, the Q/P split makes sense.

Then read the method section carefully, especially the definition of lifted parallel training. Three details matter: whether the prefiller memories are strictly causal, exactly what inputs the decoder receives during training, and where the consistency loss is applied. These determine the degree of train-test mismatch and whether the recurrent interface is likely to remain stable at deployment.

Finally, read the main results and ablations. Prioritize comparisons against the matched sliding-window Transformer, the matched latent recurrent baseline, and the parameter-sharing variants. A solid skim should take about 30 to 45 minutes. If the goal is to judge relevance for foundation-model pretraining, look more closely at throughput, memory overhead, whether the prefiller still relies on full attention, and whether memory drift accumulates during long recurrent inference.

recommendation.zh: train-full/deploy-recurrent的蒸馏思路不新，但memory consistency对齐设计和预训练benchmark对比值得看§3方法和§4实验，关注是否在长上下文上真正缩小与全注意力的gap。
recommendation.en: The train-full/deploy-recurrent distillation idea isn't new, but the memory consistency design and pretraining benchmark comparisons are worth §3-4; check whether it truly closes the gap to full attention on long context.

paper.title: Efficient Knowledge Distillation for LLMs: Offline Top-K Logits and a Fused Chunked KL Loss
paper.abstract: Small language models are often the only option for deployment under tight latency, cost, and on-premises constraints, but they are rarely trained from scratch: a compressed model is usually recovered through knowledge distillation (KD). This recovery step largely decides the final quality, yet it is expensive. We present a practitioner's study of how to make distillation training efficient, organised around two systems contributions. First, we show that offline KD (caching the teacher's top-$K$

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是一个很实际但常被轻描淡写的问题：LLM 蒸馏阶段怎样在不明显损失效果的前提下，把训练成本、显存占用和长上下文限制一起压下来。作者关注的不是提出新的蒸馏目标，而是把工程上真正卡住实验迭代的两个瓶颈拆开处理：一是 online KD 需要教师常驻并重复前向，导致算力和显存浪费；二是即便改成 offline KD，KL 蒸馏损失仍会在词表维度上产生巨大的 logits / log-softmax 张量，尤其在长序列 healing 场景下，真正限制可训练上下文的往往不是 Transformer 主体，而是输出头和 loss 计算。
summary.importance: 对预训练和压缩研究的意义主要有两层。第一，它把“蒸馏是否必须在线进行”这个常见默认设定重新校准了：在 teacher top-K 分布足够保真的条件下，offline KD 可以接近 online KD 的训练损失和最终质量，却显著改善吞吐和实验可复现性。这对做大规模 recipe 搜索、loss 设计、数据课程和长上下文修复的人很重要，因为同一份 teacher cache 可以支撑大量受控对比。第二，它把 memory-efficient cross-entropy 的思路扩展到了 sparse teacher 的 forward KL，上了一个此前库里普遍缺失的环节。对小模型恢复、continual distillation、long-context mid-training 这类场景，这种 kernel 级优化比“再省一点激活”更直接，因为瓶颈就在 vocab-sized head 上。贡献量级偏系统与方法学，不是范式变化，但对实践影响很实在。
summary.technical_approach: 方法分两部分。第一部分是 offline top-K logits distillation。作者从 teacher 预先缓存每个 token 位置 top-K=100 的概率及索引，不做重新归一化，而是保留截断后的总质量 M<=1。关键点在于他们没有把 sparse teacher 近似成一个重新归一化后的 K 类分布，而是从 forward KL 的闭式展开出发，把损失写成三项：teacher entropy H、support 上的交叉项 C，以及依赖 student 全词表归一化常数的 M log Z。这样只需要 gather 学生在 top-K support 上的 logits，再加一个对全词表的 logsumexp 标量归约，就能精确计算“截断质量未补齐”的 forward KL。文中还比较了三种 offline 实现：重建 dense teacher 的 correctness baseline、保持 teacher sparse 但仍显式算 dense student log-softmax 的中间方案，以及最终 fused/chunked 的高效实现。第二部分是 fused chunked KL loss。作者借鉴 memory-efficient cross-entropy kernel，把输出投影和 loss 融合，并沿 sequence 维分块，避免物化 B×S×V 级别的 dense logits / log-prob 张量。与 one-hot CE 不同，这里目标是 sparse top-K teacher，梯度形式也不同：support 内 token 的梯度要减去 teacher 概率，support 外 token 只通过截断质量 M 乘以 student softmax 进入。作者据此实现了适配 sparse forward KL 的 fused kernel，使峰值显存随序列长度近似线性增长，而不是被 vocab 维大张量拉爆。除此之外，文中还给出若干 recipe 细节，包括 loss 设计和 sequence packing 的取舍，强调这些结论是在 3.2B student、8B teacher 的真实蒸馏 campaign 中得到的，而不是单点 micro-benchmark。
summary.experiments: 核心实验围绕 3.2B student 蒸馏自 Llama 3.1 8B Instruct 展开。结果上，offline KD 与 online KD 的训练损失几乎重合，说明 top-K cache 没有带来明显目标偏移；同时由于移除了教师常驻和教师前向，单张 H200 上每步训练速度约快 29%，吞吐最高提升到 41%。这部分价值不只是省算力，还在于能在同一 teacher target 上做大量 ablation。关于 fused chunked KL，作者通过受控 output-head benchmark 和完整训练实验都显示：传统 dense loss 的峰值显存会随 B×S×V 急剧上升，而 fused/chunked 版本把峰值显存压到近似线性随序列长度增长，从而解锁单卡上的 long-context healing。文中还做了 supporting ablations，讨论 top-K 截断、loss 变体、packing 策略等对训练稳定性和效率的影响。摘要截断了部分数字，但从正文可确认，作者强调 offline top-K 在质量上接近 online，而 kernel 优化主要改变的是可训练上下文长度和系统吞吐，而非模型上限。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读时先看 Introduction 和方法部分关于公式(2)的推导，理解为什么“不重归一化的 top-K teacher”仍能精确写成 sparse gather + logZ 的形式，这是全文最关键的数学点。然后看 fused chunked KL 的实现思路和 Figure 1，对应的是这篇工作的真正工程贡献：瓶颈不在 Transformer block，而在 LM head 与 loss。实验部分优先看 offline vs online 的对比，以及 output-head benchmark，能快速判断这套做法对自己的蒸馏流程是否有迁移价值。若你关心长上下文修复或单卡蒸馏，建议再看 supporting ablations 里的 sequence packing 和 loss design。预计 25–35 分钟可以抓住主要结论；若要复现 kernel 或改到自家训练栈里，需要精读损失推导和实现细节。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles a practical bottleneck in LLM distillation: how to make the recovery stage of a compact student cheaper in memory and compute without giving up the quality of online KD. The authors isolate two separate constraints. First, online KD keeps the teacher resident and recomputes it every step, which is expensive and slows down ablations. Second, even with offline KD, the dominant memory spike for long-context training often comes from the vocabulary-sized LM head and KL loss, not from the transformer body itself.
summary_en.importance: Its value is mainly methodological and systems-oriented. The paper shows that offline top-K teacher caching can preserve nearly the same training signal as online KD while materially improving throughput and making large ablation campaigns much easier to run. That matters for compact-model recovery, continual distillation, and long-context healing, where recipe iteration is often the real bottleneck. The second contribution is also useful beyond this exact setup: it extends memory-efficient fused cross-entropy ideas to sparse-teacher forward KL, filling a gap in current training libraries. This is not a new distillation paradigm, but it is the kind of implementation detail that changes what experiments are feasible.
summary_en.technical_approach: The first component is offline top-K logit distillation. For each token position, the teacher’s top-K probabilities and indices are cached once, with K=100 in the main setup. Importantly, the retained mass M is not renormalized to 1. Instead, the forward KL is rewritten exactly for a truncated teacher distribution: the loss decomposes into a teacher-entropy term, a cross term over the retained support, and an M log Z term that depends on the student’s full-vocabulary log-normalizer. This means the implementation only needs to gather student logits on the top-K support plus compute a scalar logsumexp over the vocabulary, rather than materializing dense teacher and student distributions. The paper discusses three mathematically equivalent offline variants, differing only in how densely they instantiate tensors. The second component is a fused, chunked KL loss. Borrowing from recent fused CE kernels, the authors fuse the output projection with the loss and chunk along the sequence dimension so that dense B×S×V tensors are never materialized. Because the target is a sparse teacher rather than a one-hot label, the gradient differs from standard CE: support tokens subtract teacher mass, while off-support tokens only enter through the truncated mass M times the student softmax. This yields a sparse forward-KL kernel whose peak memory scales roughly linearly with sequence length, enabling longer-context distillation on a single GPU.
summary_en.experiments: The main study distills a roughly 3.2B student derived from Llama 3.1 8B Instruct. In the quality comparison, offline KD matches online KD at nearly identical training loss, indicating that top-K caching preserves the relevant teacher signal well enough for this setup. On efficiency, removing the teacher from the training loop gives about 29% faster iteration time and up to 41% higher throughput on a single H200 GPU. For the fused chunked KL, the paper includes both controlled output-head benchmarks and end-to-end training evidence showing that the dense loss path suffers from the expected vocabulary-sized memory spike, whereas the fused/chunked implementation keeps peak memory close to linear in sequence length and unlocks long-context healing. Additional ablations cover loss design and sequence packing, with the main takeaway being that the systems changes alter feasibility and throughput much more than they alter final quality.
summary_en.reading_guide: Start with the derivation around the offline objective, especially the equation that rewrites truncated top-K forward KL without renormalizing the teacher. That is the key mathematical idea. Then read the fused/chunked loss section and the memory-scaling figure, because the paper’s main contribution is really about where the memory bottleneck lives: the LM head and loss, not the transformer stack. In the experiments, prioritize the online-vs-offline comparison and the isolated output-head benchmark. Those sections are enough to judge whether the method is worth porting into an existing distillation stack. If long-context training is your use case, also read the packing and loss ablations. A quick but useful read is about 30 minutes; implementing it faithfully requires a closer pass over the loss derivation and kernel details.

recommendation.zh: 两个蒸馏效率优化的工程方案实用性强，做蒸馏的团队可直接复现，重点看分块KL损失的实现细节
recommendation.en: Two highly practical engineering optimizations for LLM distillation efficiency, worth reproducing for distillation teams, focus on the implementation details of the chunked KL loss

paper.title: Learning What to Remember: Test-Time Training via Context Distillation
paper.abstract: Effective long-context modeling is not merely about retaining more of the past, but about preserving the information that may prove relevant later. Test-time training (TTT) is an appealing approach that performs online parameter updates for long-context modeling, yet existing TTT methods only optimize either reconstruction or online adaptation objectives without considering the future utility of retained information. In this work, we propose \textbf{T}est-\textbf{T}ime \textbf{C}ontext \textbf{D

summary.core_problem: 现有长上下文 test-time training 方法只做重建或在线自适应，未考虑保留信息对未来预测的实际效用。
summary.importance: 方法创新：提出基于上下文蒸馏的 test-time training 框架，用长窗口教师监督短窗口学生的快速权重，为有限记忆容量提供面向未来效用的自监督分配信号。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 TTCD（Test-Time Context Distillation）：长窗口教师模型的隐状态作为监督信号，指导短窗口学生在 test-time 更新快速权重，使学生优先保留对未来 token 预测关键的上下文；并给出 In-Place TTCD 变体，直接复用现有模型权重无需额外结构。
summary.experiments: 在长上下文语言建模和下游任务上验证，相比仅做重建或自适应的 TTT 方法，TTCD 在相同记忆预算下取得更低困惑度和更好下游性能。
summary.authors_note: Jason D. Lee 为普林斯顿大学知名机器学习理论与大模型优化研究者。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing test-time training methods for long-context modeling optimize only reconstruction or online adaptation objectives and ignore the future utility of retained information under limited memory budgets.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation: introduces a context-distillation-based test-time training framework that uses a long-window teacher to supervise a short-window student's fast weights with future-utility-aware self-supervision.
