Readers interested in geometric causes can delve into the triggering factor analysis. For LLM researchers, the core启发 is the phenomenon itself — emergent behavior under high-dimensional constraints — without needing to deeply engage with image-specific experimental details.
summary_en.authors_note: Specific institution and author information could not be confirmed from the provided excerpts.

recommendation.zh: 从扩散蒸馏角度揭示高维训练中学生模型的涌现行为，对理解LLM蒸馏/知识迁移中的机制有类比启发，重点读关于几何自由度分析的章节。
recommendation.en: Reveals emergent behavior of student models in high-dimensional distillation from a diffusion perspective; analogous insights for LLM distillation/knowledge transfer. Focus on the geometric freedom analysis section.

paper.title: Rethinking the Role of Temperature in Large Language Model Distillation
paper.abstract: Reverse Kullback-Leibler (RKL) divergence is widely favored over forward KL (FKL) in large language models (LLM) distillation, yet this preference is largely based on comparisons that omit the temperature $τ$, overlooking its central role in softening teacher distributions and improving knowledge transfer. In this work, we revisit temperature in LLM distillation and show that it fundamentally changes the comparison between FKL and RKL. Our analysis reveals an asymmetric effect: temperature subst

summary.core_problem: 核心问题是：LLM 蒸馏中 RKL 优于 FKL 的常见结论，是否被 τ=1 的默认温度设置误导。已有比较通常忽略 distillation temperature，而温度正是软化 teacher 分布、暴露非最高概率 token 信息的关键变量。该工作指出，温度对 FKL 和 RKL 的作用并不对称：FKL 会从更软的 teacher 分布中获得更多 non-dominant token 信号，RKL 则更多表现为梯度尺度变化。
summary.importance: 这篇工作对模型压缩和小模型训练 recipe 有实际意义。它提醒蒸馏目标的优劣不能脱离温度讨论，尤其是在 vocabulary 很大、teacher 分布尖锐的 LLM 场景下。若只在 τ=1 比较 FKL、RKL、Sym-KL、JS、AKL 等目标，结论可能偏向 mode-seeking 的 RKL。加入合适温度后，简单 KL 目标也可能达到很强的效果。对预训练研究的启发是：soft target 的信息密度、非目标 token 的概率结构、梯度分配方式，会显著影响小模型继承 teacher 行为的效率。
summary.technical_approach: 技术核心是重新分析 temperature-scaled FKL 与 RKL 的梯度。设 teacher logits 和 student logits 经温度 τ softmax 得到 p^τ 和 q^τ。FKL 最小化 D_KL(p^τ || q^τ)，梯度由 teacher 分布加权；RKL 最小化 D_KL(q^τ || p^τ)，梯度由 student 分布加权。高温极限下，在 centered logits 假设下，两者都会趋近 logit matching，因此目标差异变小。但在实际温度区间内，τ 会把 teacher 的概率质量从 dominant token 分散到更多低概率候选，FKL 因为直接使用 teacher 权重，学习到的目标结构会明显改变。RKL 的权重主要来自 student 分布，温度更多影响梯度幅度和优化平滑性，而不是同等程度地引入 teacher 的暗知识。这个分析解释了为什么 τ=1 时 RKL 往往更强，而提高温度后 FKL 可以反超。
summary.experiments: 实验围绕不同 KL 目标和不同温度做系统比较。主要结论是：τ=1 下 RKL 经常优于 FKL；当提高 KD temperature 后，FKL 的收益更大，并在较高温度设置下稳定超过 RKL。温度不仅改善 FKL，也改善 Sym-KL、JS、SFKL、AKL 等 KL-family 目标，使一些简单目标在合适温度下接近或超过更复杂的蒸馏变体。给定内容没有列出具体模型规模、数据集和表格数值，关键数字需要查实验表和温度 sweep 图。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 30 到 45 分钟。先看理论分析部分，重点是 FKL/RKL 对 student logits 的梯度形式，以及高温下趋近 logit matching 的推导。然后看温度 sweep 实验，不要只看最佳点，要看 τ 从 1 增大时 FKL 和 RKL 曲线斜率的差异。最后看扩展到 Sym-KL、JS、SFKL、AKL 的实验，用来判断温度是 FKL 的补丁，还是 KL 蒸馏目标的通用设计变量。实际复现时需要关注是否使用 τ^2 loss scaling、是否同时 softmax teacher 和 student、以及生成式评测是否与 token-level loss 一致。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper revisits a common conclusion in LLM distillation: reverse KL is often considered better than forward KL. The key issue is that many comparisons are made at temperature τ=1. Temperature is not a minor hyperparameter in distillation; it controls how much probability mass the teacher assigns to non-top tokens. The paper shows that temperature affects FKL and RKL asymmetrically. It enriches FKL with non-dominant token signals, while it mostly rescales or smooths RKL gradients.
summary_en.importance: This is directly relevant to compression and small-model training recipes. It argues that KL objectives cannot be fairly compared without tuning distillation temperature. In large-vocabulary LLMs, teacher distributions are often sharp, so FKL at τ=1 can look weak simply because the teacher provides little usable probability mass beyond the top token. With appropriate temperature, simple KL-based objectives can become competitive with more elaborate variants. For pretraining researchers, the useful lesson is that soft-target entropy, gradient allocation across vocabulary items, and objective choice jointly determine how efficiently a student inherits behavior from a teacher.
summary_en.technical_approach: The analysis compares temperature-scaled FKL, D_KL(p^τ || q^τ), and RKL, D_KL(q^τ || p^τ), where p^τ and q^τ are teacher and student distributions under softmax temperature τ. FKL gradients are weighted by the teacher distribution, so increasing τ changes what the student learns by exposing more non-top teacher probabilities. RKL gradients are weighted by the student distribution, so increasing τ mainly changes optimization scale and smoothness. Under centered logits and in the high-temperature limit, both objectives approach logit matching, which explains why their distinction vanishes asymptotically. At practical temperatures, however, FKL benefits much more from softening because its signal is directly tied to the teacher distribution.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments compare multiple KL-family objectives across temperature settings. The central empirical pattern is that RKL often wins at τ=1, but FKL gains more as temperature increases and surpasses RKL at higher temperatures. Temperature also improves Sym-KL, JS, SFKL, and AKL, suggesting that it is a general design variable rather than a correction specific to FKL. The supplied content does not include the full numerical tables, model sizes, or dataset details, so exact margins should be taken from the temperature sweep plots and result tables.
summary_en.reading_guide: A focused skim should take 30 to 45 minutes. Read the gradient derivation first, especially the difference between teacher-weighted FKL and student-weighted RKL. Then inspect the temperature sweep figures, looking at curve shape rather than only the best point. The most useful experimental sections are the comparisons across FKL, RKL, Sym-KL, JS, SFKL, and AKL. For implementation, check whether the loss uses τ^2 scaling, whether both teacher and student distributions are temperature-scaled, and whether token-level loss improvements align with generation quality.

recommendation.zh: 重新审视了蒸馏中的 KL 散度选择，指出高温下 FKL 优于 RKL，改变了蒸馏 loss 的 prior，值得在做模型压缩或小模型对齐时参考。
recommendation.en: Revisits KL divergence choices in distillation, showing FKL outperforms RKL at high temperatures, changing the prior on distillation loss; valuable for model compression or small model alignment.

paper.title: Decomposed On-Policy Distillation for Vision-Language Reasoning: Steering Gradients for Visual Grounding

summary.core_problem: 纯文本领域成熟的在线蒸馏（on-policy distillation）直接迁移到多模态场景时，存在未被探明的优化冲突：语言分布对齐和视觉 grounding 两个目标的梯度近似正交，标准单目标优化会被动走次优的妥协轨迹，无法保障足够的视觉感知对齐精度；同时现有VLM蒸馏普遍仅对文本部分做蒸馏，忽略视觉对齐需求。
summary.importance: 这是首个从梯度几何层面分析多模态在线蒸馏优化动态的工作，为多模态蒸馏的目标解耦、优化方向设计提供了可落地的依据；其发现的跨模态梯度子空间正交的分析范式，也可迁移到其他多任务、多模态联合优化的预训练与对齐场景。
summary.technical_approach: 首先将在线蒸馏的序列级反向KL损失数学分解为语言先验对齐、视觉 grounding 两个独立分量，通过梯度分析验证二者的梯度向量近似正交；随后提出视觉梯度引导（VGS）更新规则，动态调整优化轨迹，优先向与教师模型视觉信息增益对齐的子空间更新，在不损失语言流畅度的前提下强化视觉 grounding 能力，几乎无额外训练开销。
summary.experiments: 公开的全文片段未披露完整实验数值，仅明确VGS在复杂多模态推理基准上性能优于标准单目标在线蒸馏，且无显著额外训练成本。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读先看引言部分的问题提出与图2的梯度几何分析，再了解视觉梯度引导的算法定义，预计阅读时间15-20分钟；关注多模态优化动态的研究者可深挖梯度分析部分的推导细节。

summary_en.core_problem: Direct application of standard monolithic on-policy distillation from text-only domains to vision-language models faces an uncharacterized optimization tension: gradients from the language prior alignment objective and the visual grounding objective are nearly orthogonal. Standard single-objective optimization thus passively follows a suboptimal compromise trajectory that fails to enforce sufficient perceptual fidelity, while most existing VLM distillation works only distill text components and neglect visual alignment requirements.
summary_en.importance: This is the first gradient-level geometric analysis of on-policy distillation in multimodal settings. Its finding of orthogonal gradient subspaces across modalities provides an actionable framework for decomposing multimodal training objectives, and the analysis paradigm can be generalized to other multi-task or cross-modal pretraining and alignment scenarios.
summary_en.technical_approach: First, it mathematically decomposes the sequence-level reverse KL loss of on-policy distillation into two independent components: language prior alignment and visual grounding. Gradient analysis confirms the two components have nearly orthogonal gradient vectors. It then proposes Visual Gradient Steering (VGS), an update rule that dynamically reorients the optimization trajectory to prioritize alignment with the teacher's visual information gain, improving visual grounding without degrading linguistic fluency, with negligible training overhead.
summary_en.experiments: The provided full text fragment does not include complete experimental metrics. The paper states VGS outperforms standard monolithic on-policy distillation on complex multimodal reasoning benchmarks, with no significant additional training cost.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the introduction for problem formulation and Figure 2 for gradient geometric analysis, then review the formulation of Visual Gradient Steering. Estimated reading time: 15-20 minutes. Researchers focused on multimodal optimization dynamics can dig into the derivations of the gradient analysis section.

recommendation.zh: 通过干预梯度来强化VLM的图文对齐，思路比较直接，对多模态post-training中如何利用teacher model的隐式知识有一定参考价值。
recommendation.en: Strengthening VLM image-text alignment by intervening in gradients is a straightforward approach, offering some reference value for how to utilize implicit knowledge from teacher models in multimodal post-training.

paper.title: PEEK: Picking Essential frames via Efficient Knowledge distillation
paper.abstract: Video-language models can process only a limited number of frames, making frame selection a key bottleneck for efficient video captioning. Most captioning pipelines still rely on uniform sampling, which is computationally cheap but agnostic to visual content. Adaptive frame sampling has recently emerged as a promising approach for selecting the most informative frames from a video; however, existing methods remain computationally expensive. We introduce PEEK, an efficient dynamic frame sampling

summary.core_problem: 解决视频语言模型只能处理有限帧数时，如何低成本选择最有信息量帧的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是视频 VLM 推理侧效率方法。它不改变预训练目标，但对 video-LM 的 token budget、视觉上下文压缩和 teacher-student 数据蒸馏有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 PEEK，用强 teacher 模型生成 caption-conditioned 的帧相关性排序，再蒸馏到轻量时间模型中。部署时轻量模型只看视觉内容即可动态选帧，避免每次用昂贵 VLM 或文本条件模块做自适应采样。
summary.experiments: 在 ActivityNet Captions 和 MSR-VTT 上评测，并接入多个下游 video-language captioning 模型。摘要称在多数帧预算下 CIDEr 最好，尤其只选 1 或 2 帧时优于已有自适应采样方法；未给出模型参数量和具体提升数值。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Moments Lab。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles efficient frame selection for video-language models, which can only process a small number of frames under practical compute and context limits.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an inference-side efficiency method for video VLMs. It does not change the pretraining objective, but it is relevant to token-budget allocation, visual context compression, and teacher-student distillation for video-language systems.
summary_en.technical_approach: PEEK distills caption-conditioned frame relevance rankings from a stronger teacher into a lightweight temporal model. At inference time, the student selects frames using visual input only, avoiding expensive adaptive sampling with a full VLM or text-conditioned scoring model.
summary_en.experiments: The method is evaluated on ActivityNet Captions and MSR-VTT across multiple downstream video-language captioning models. The abstract reports the best CIDEr for most frame budgets, with especially strong gains when selecting only one or two frames. Parameter counts and exact margins are not given.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with Moments Lab.

recommendation.zh: 对视频 token budget 有一点实用信号；看 teacher 排序蒸馏 setup 和 1-2 帧结果即可，不必深读 caption 指标。
recommendation.en: A useful signal for video token budgeting; inspect the teacher-ranking distillation setup and the 1–2 frame results, skip the caption-metric details.

paper.title: Apertus LLM Family Expansion via Distillation and Quantization
paper.abstract: The wide adoption of LLMs has led to their use in great variety of applications and scenarios, such as chatbot assistants and data annotation, creating the need for the models to satisfy certain budget and hardware constraints. This has led to the trend of LLMs being released in batches consisting of similar models of various sizes for the family of models to adhere to as wide of a range of constraints as possible. In this paper, we validate distillation and quantization as a cost-effective way

summary.core_problem: 构建覆盖不同参数规模和硬件需求的LLM家族成本高，缺乏低成本的高效扩展方案
summary.importance: 验证了蒸馏+量化作为LLM家族扩展方案的成本效益，给出了可复现的开源实现
summary.technical_approach: 以开源Apertus 8B为教师模型，通过知识蒸馏得到最高4B参数的学生模型，结合量化处理生成适配不同硬件的版本，训练使用1.7T许可协议友好的token
summary.experiments: 构建了Apertus-v1.1模型家族，在标准语言理解和推理基准上性能接近同规模原生训练模型，训练成本远低于从零训练同等规模的模型家族
summary.authors_note: 作者来自EPFL，Martin Jaggi和Dan Alistarh为高效深度学习和LLM领域知名研究者，团队有多项开源LLM和模型压缩工作

summary_en.core_problem: Building LLM families covering different parameter sizes and hardware requirements is costly, with no low-cost and efficient expansion solutions
summary_en.importance: Verifies the cost-effectiveness of distillation and quantization as an LLM family expansion strategy, and provides reproducible open-source implementation
summary_en.technical_approach: Uses open-source Apertus 8B as the teacher model, generates student models up to 4B parameters via knowledge distillation, combines quantization to produce versions adapted to different hardware, trained on 1.7T permissive license tokens
summary_en.experiments: Constructs the Apertus-v1.1 model family, whose performance on standard language understanding and reasoning benchmarks is close to native trained models of the same size, with training costs much lower than training a comparable model family from scratch
summary_en.authors_note: Authors are from EPFL; Martin Jaggi and Dan Alistarh are renowned researchers in efficient deep learning and LLMs, and their team has multiple open-source LLM and model compression works

recommendation.zh: 蒸馏扩展模型家族的工程实践很扎实，只看成本对比和性能权衡的实验部分即可
recommendation.en: The engineering practice of expanding model families via distillation is solid; only read the experimental section on cost comparison and performance trade-offs.

paper.title: COLLEAGUE.SKILL: Automated AI Skill Generation via Expert Knowledge Distillation
paper.abstract: LLM agents are increasingly expected not only to complete isolated tasks, but also to carry bounded representations of human expertise, judgment, and interaction style. Building such person-grounded agents remains difficult because actionable knowledge associated with a person or role is usually embedded in heterogeneous traces rather than written as clean instructions. Existing memory and persona systems capture fragments of this evidence, while skill frameworks provide portable packaging forma

summary.core_problem: 把某个人或某个角色的零散工作痕迹，自动蒸馏成可检查、可修正、可被 agent 调用的技能包。
summary.importance: 贡献主要是 agent 技能工程和知识蒸馏工作流，而不是基座模型训练方法。它试图解决 persona、memory、skill framework 之间缺少端到端转换链路的问题，对通用 agent 记忆和技能封装有一定参考。
summary.technical_approach: 系统从目标人物或角色的异构材料中抽取可操作知识，生成带版本管理的 skill package。技能包分成两条轨道：capability track 记录实践方法、心智模型和决策启发式；bounded behavior track 约束沟通风格和行为边界。方法更像 trace-to-skill 的自动化蒸馏流水线，而非新的模型训练目标。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出模型规模、数据量、具体 benchmark 或定量提升。可确认的是系统面向 person-grounded agents，强调生成结果的 inspectable、correctable 和 agent-usable。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自上海人工智能实验室等机构。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets automatic conversion of a person’s heterogeneous traces into inspectable, editable, and agent-usable skill packages.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is mainly an agent-skill engineering workflow rather than a foundation-model training method. The useful angle is the attempt to connect persona evidence, memory fragments, and portable skill frameworks into one distillation pipeline.
summary_en.technical_approach: COLLEAGUE.SKILL ingests materials associated with a target person or role and produces a versioned skill package. The package separates capability knowledge, such as practices and decision heuristics, from bounded behavioral constraints such as interaction style and role-specific limits.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report model scale, dataset size, concrete baselines, or numerical gains. The evaluation appears to focus on whether generated skills are usable and correctable for person-grounded agents.
summary_en.authors_note: The listed institutions include Shanghai Artificial Intelligence Laboratory.

recommendation.zh: 作为 agent 技能封装方案知道即可；对预训练研究的可迁移信息有限，不必读正文。
recommendation.en: Worth knowing as an agent skill-packaging workflow, but it offers little signal for pretraining research.

paper.title: Pruning and Distilling Mixture-of-Experts into Dense Language Models
paper.abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) is now the dominant architecture for frontier language models, yet it requires all expert parameters to be loaded in memory, making it less preferable for memory-constrained deployment. Existing compression methods reduce the number of experts but the output remains an MoE model with the same fundamental limitation. We present the first systematic framework for converting a trained MoE into a standard fully dense architecture: experts are scored, selected, and grouped, t

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决的是 MoE 模型部署里的一个结构性矛盾：MoE 每个 token 只激活少数 expert，所以活跃参数量低、训练和推理算力效率高；但部署时通常仍要把所有 expert 常驻显存，内存占用接近总参数量，而不是活跃参数量。已有压缩方法大多还是把大 MoE 压成小 MoE，问题没有根治。作者要回答的是：能不能把一个已经训练好的 MoE 系统性地转成标准 dense 架构，同时尽量保留 MoE 的能力，并且比从 dense teacher 出发做剪枝蒸馏更划算。
summary.importance: 对基座研究的意义主要在模型族构建和 teacher 选择，而不是新预训练范式。MoE 已经是前沿大模型的主流架构之一，但实际产品常常还要配套发布小 dense 模型。传统做法要么单独训练 dense，要么先有一个大 dense teacher 再做 dense-to-dense 压缩，成本高，也没有利用好 MoE teacher 的知识结构。这篇文章给出了一条比较完整的 MoE-to-dense 路线，并且实验表明，在相同学生规模下，直接从 MoE teacher 蒸馏出来的 dense 学生优于 dense-to-dense 剪枝蒸馏。这一点很有现实意义：如果成立，未来模型家族不一定需要同时维护一条大 dense 主线和一条大 MoE 主线，MoE 旗舰模型本身就可以成为 dense 子模型的上游来源。
summary.technical_approach:
方法分三步，逻辑很清楚。

第一步是 expert selection。对每层的 E 个 expert 打分，选出 top-K。这里 K 是转换时保留的 expert 数，k 是原 MoE 路由的 top-k 激活数，两者不同。作者系统比较了 7 种打分方法，结论是打分方法远比后续 grouping 更重要。论文最核心的新点是 diversity-aware scoring：不是只看某个 expert 被路由得多不多、激活强不强，而是同时考虑重要性和互补性。具体做法是构造 importance-weighted Gram matrix，用 log-determinant 做 D-optimal 选择准则，鼓励选出的 expert 既强又不冗余。文中最优方法叫 DO-ACP。

第二步是 grouping / merging / densification。若 K>k，就把选出的 expert 分成 k 组，在组内做加权平均；若 K=k，则直接保留，不做 merge。然后把得到的 k 个 expert 沿中间维拼接，形成一个标准 dense FFN。由于 MoE 的输出原本是 router 权重加权和，而 dense FFN 是直接拼接后统一下投影，作者还讨论了 down-projection scaling，用来校正输出幅值，避免转换后激活尺度失真。

第三步是 distillation。结构转换后会有能力损失，作者用 teacher MoE 对 dense 学生做知识蒸馏恢复性能。全文里一个重要设计点是，他们先用大规模网格搜索在较短蒸馏预算下找 recipe，再在更长蒸馏 token 数上验证最优配置是否仍然成立。这比只报单一 recipe 更扎实。

方法上最值得注意的判断有两个。其一，expert selection 比 grouping 更关键，说明 MoE 压缩里“选谁”比“怎么合”更决定上限。其二，最优配置往往是 pure pruning，即选出多样化 expert 后直接拼成 dense，而不是先合并再拼接。这意味着很多 MoE expert 之间并不是简单可平均的冗余副本；如果选得足够多样，merge 反而会抹掉专长。
summary.experiments:
实验设计相当完整。主实验基于 Qwen3-30B-A3B，系统评估了 7 种 expert scoring、5 种 grouping、2 种 down-projection scaling，以及不同 K 取值，总共 350 个配置。然后又在 DeepSeek-V2-Lite 和 GPT-OSS-20B 上做了验证。

最重要的结果有四个。

第一，scoring method 是主导因素。最好和最差的打分方法在平均下游准确率上相差 5.7 个百分点，而 grouping 策略的影响只有约 1 个点。这说明如果只在 merge 细节上做文章，而 selection 没做好，收益很有限。

第二，最佳 recipe 是 diversity-aware scoring 加 pure pruning。也就是用 DO-ACP 选出多样化 expert，且不做 weight averaging。相反，基于频率的打分更容易选到相似 expert，因此才会从 merging 中受益。这个结果很有解释力：merge 不是天然有用，它更多是在弥补 selection 的冗余。

第三，MoE-to-dense 明显优于 dense-to-dense pruning。在一个控制实验里，教师规模都在约 30B，学生都是约 3B，经过约 4B token 蒸馏后，MoE-to-dense 最优配置比 dense-to-dense pruning 高 6.3 个百分点，同时训练 wall-clock 快 1.6 倍。这个结果是全文最有分量的结论之一，因为它不只是证明“能转”，而是证明“从 MoE teacher 出发更合算”。

第四，作者先在约 0.3B token 蒸馏预算下筛 recipe，再在更长训练上验证优势仍然存在，说明结论不是短训偶然现象。摘要中没有展开所有 benchmark 名称和逐项分数，但从全文结构看，评测覆盖了多任务平均表现，而不是只看 perplexity。

需要补一句边界：这篇文章比较的是压缩路线，不是从头训练同规模 dense 学生的最优上限，也不是研究 MoE teacher 在预训练阶段为什么更适合蒸馏。因此它给出的更多是工程决策证据，而不是机制层面的最终解释。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议按“结论驱动”来读。

先看方法总览图和 Section 3 的转换流程，弄清楚 K 与 k 的区别，以及为什么 MoE 的 active parameter count 可以对应到 dense FFN 的中间维度。这个映射关系如果没看明白，后面的结果会显得像经验技巧。

然后重点看 expert scoring 部分。尤其是 diversity-aware 的 Gram log-det 目标，这是全文最有新意的地方。要关注它为什么能同时编码 importance 和 diversity，以及它和简单 activation frequency、router probability、weight norm 这类指标的差别。

接着看 Section 4.2 和 4.4 一类的主结果：350 个配置的比较、scoring 与 grouping 的相对影响、MoE-to-dense 对 dense-to-dense 的控制实验。这几部分决定这篇文章是否只是“又一个压缩 recipe”，还是在 teacher 选择上给出更强证据。

最后看 extended distillation 和 cross-model validation。若最优 recipe 只在短训或单模型上成立，价值会打折；作者专门补了这部分，值得确认。

预计阅读时间 25–35 分钟。若时间更少，优先看 Figure 1、scoring 方法、主表格和 dense-to-dense 对比实验。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a structural deployment issue of MoE language models. MoEs are compute-efficient because only a few experts are active per token, but they are still memory-heavy at inference because all experts must remain resident. Prior compression work mostly turns a large MoE into a smaller MoE, which preserves the same memory limitation. The central question here is whether a trained MoE can be systematically converted into a standard dense model while retaining as much capability as possible, and whether this route is better than starting from a dense teacher and doing dense-to-dense pruning/distillation.
summary_en.importance: Its main value for foundation-model research is in model-family construction and teacher choice rather than a new pretraining paradigm. Frontier labs increasingly train MoE flagships but still release smaller dense models for deployment. Those dense models are often trained separately or distilled from a large dense teacher, which is expensive and does not exploit the MoE teacher already available. This work presents a fairly complete MoE-to-dense pipeline and shows that, at matched student size, a dense student distilled from an MoE teacher can outperform a dense student obtained through dense-to-dense pruning. If that result holds broadly, it changes a practical design choice: a flagship MoE may be sufficient as the upstream source for both sparse and dense descendants.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method has three stages.

First is expert selection. For each layer, all E experts are scored and the top-K are retained. Here k is the original router top-k, while K is the number of experts selected for conversion. The paper evaluates seven scoring methods and finds that scoring dominates the final outcome. The main technical novelty is a diversity-aware criterion: instead of selecting experts only by frequency or activation strength, it jointly rewards importance and non-redundancy. Concretely, the authors build an importance-weighted Gram matrix and use a log-determinant objective, a D-optimal selection criterion, to favor experts that are both strong and diverse. Their best variant is called DO-ACP.

Second is grouping, merging, and densification. If K > k, the selected experts are assigned to k groups and merged within each group by score-weighted averaging; if K = k, they are copied directly without merging. The resulting k experts are then concatenated along the intermediate dimension to form a standard dense FFN. Because an MoE output is originally a router-weighted sum while a dense FFN uses a single down projection after concatenation, the paper also studies down-projection scaling to preserve output magnitude after conversion.

Third is knowledge distillation from the MoE teacher to recover quality lost in the structural conversion. A useful part of the experimental design is that the authors first search over recipes under a short distillation budget, then verify whether the best recipe remains best under longer distillation. That makes the conclusions more credible than a single hand-picked configuration.

Two takeaways stand out. First, expert selection matters much more than grouping, which means the upper bound is mostly determined by which experts are kept, not by how they are merged. Second, the best configuration is often pure pruning: select diverse experts and concatenate them directly, without averaging. That suggests many experts are specialized rather than trivially mergeable; averaging can erase useful specialization if selection is already good.
summary_en.experiments:
The experimental study is broad. The main sweep is on Qwen3-30B-A3B, covering 7 expert-scoring methods, 5 grouping strategies, 2 down-projection scaling choices, and multiple K values, for a total of 350 configurations. The best findings are then validated on DeepSeek-V2-Lite and GPT-OSS-20B.

Four results matter most.

First, scoring is the dominant factor. The gap between the best and worst scoring methods is 5.7 percentage points in average downstream accuracy, while grouping contributes only about 1 point. That is a strong signal that selection quality is the real bottleneck.

Second, the best recipe is diversity-aware scoring plus pure pruning. In other words, DO-ACP selects a diverse set of experts and direct concatenation works better than weight averaging. Frequency-based scoring tends to pick redundant experts, so it benefits more from merging. This is an informative result: merging is not inherently helpful; it mainly compensates for poor selection.

Third, MoE-to-dense beats dense-to-dense pruning in a controlled comparison. With roughly matched teacher size (~30B) and student size (~3B), the best MoE-to-dense configuration outperforms dense-to-dense pruning by +6.3 points after about 4B distillation tokens, while being 1.6x faster in wall-clock training time. This is one of the strongest claims in the paper because it argues not just that conversion is possible, but that the MoE teacher is a better starting point.

Fourth, the recipe selected under a short distillation budget (~0.3B tokens) remains strong under extended distillation, and the trend transfers across three model families. The provided excerpt does not include every benchmark name and score, but the evaluation is clearly broader than a single perplexity comparison.

A boundary to keep in mind: the paper compares compression pipelines, not the absolute best dense student obtainable from scratch, and it does not fully explain why MoE teachers are better distillation sources at the representation level. The evidence is strong for engineering choice, less complete for mechanism.
summary_en.reading_guide:
A good skim should be conclusion-driven.

Start with the overview figure and the conversion pipeline in the method section. Make sure the distinction between K and k is clear, and understand why the active parameter budget of an MoE maps naturally to the intermediate width of a dense FFN. Without that mapping, the rest can look like a collection of heuristics.

Then focus on expert scoring. The diversity-aware Gram log-det objective is the most novel part of the paper. Pay attention to why it captures both importance and diversity, and how it differs from simpler signals such as routing frequency, router probability, or weight magnitude.

Next, read the main comparison sections: the 350-configuration sweep, the relative impact of scoring versus grouping, and the controlled MoE-to-dense versus dense-to-dense experiment. Those sections determine whether the paper is merely another compression recipe or a stronger statement about teacher choice.

Finally, check the extended-distillation and cross-model validation results. If the best recipe only worked under short training or on one architecture, the practical value would be much weaker.

A useful skim takes 25–35 minutes. If time is limited, prioritize the overview figure, the scoring section, the main result tables, and the dense-to-dense comparison.

recommendation.zh: 不是 pretrain 方法，但如果你在想 MoE 是否真学到不可压缩的专家分工，只看打分消融和 matched-budget 对比就够，能直接指导内部 MoE→dense 备份线。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but if you care whether MoE specialization is truly irreducible, read the scoring ablations and matched-budget comparisons; they directly inform any internal MoE-to-dense fallback path.

paper.title: Multi-Teacher Knowledge Distillation via Teacher-Informed Mixture Priors
paper.abstract: Knowledge distillation is a powerful method for model compression, enabling the efficient deployment of complex deep learning models (teachers), including large language models. However, its underlying statistical mechanisms remain unclear, and uncertainty evaluation is often overlooked, especially in real-world scenarios requiring diverse teacher expertise. To address these challenges, we introduce \textit{Multi-Teacher Bayesian Knowledge Distillation} (MT-BKD), where a distilled student model

summary.core_problem: 多教师知识蒸馏中不确定性评估缺失，且蒸馏过程的统计机制不清晰，尤其是在需要多样化教师专业知识的真实场景中。
summary.importance: 方法创新：将贝叶斯框架引入多教师知识蒸馏，通过教师信息先验和熵加权机制融合多源知识，提升泛化性与鲁棒性。
summary.technical_approach: 提出多教师贝叶斯知识蒸馏（MT-BKD），在贝叶斯推理框架内让学生模型从多个教师学习；引入教师信息先验整合外部知识，并使用基于熵的加权机制自适应调整每个教师的影响。
summary.experiments: 论文未提供具体模型规模和数据集细节，主要为方法框架性阐述。
summary.authors_note: Luyang Fang 等；机构信息未明确。

summary_en.core_problem: Uncertainty evaluation is missing in multi-teacher knowledge distillation, and the statistical mechanism of the distillation process remains unclear, especially in real-world scenarios requiring diverse teacher expertise.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation: introduces Bayesian framework into multi-teacher knowledge distillation, integrating multi-source knowledge through teacher-informed priors and entropy-based weighting to improve generalization and robustness.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes Multi-Teacher Bayesian Knowledge Distillation (MT-BKD), where a student model learns from multiple teachers within a Bayesian inference framework; introduces a teacher-informed prior to integrate external knowledge, and uses an entropy-based weighting mechanism to adaptively adjust each teacher's influence.
summary_en.experiments: No specific model scale or dataset details provided; the paper is primarily a methodological framework presentation.
summary_en.authors_note: Luyang Fang et al.; institutional affiliation not specified.

recommendation.zh: 贝叶斯+多教师蒸馏的理论框架，缺乏大规模 LLM 实验验证，对预训练研究员价值有限，作为文献备查。
recommendation.en: A theoretical framework of Bayesian multi-teacher distillation without large-scale LLM experimental validation; limited value for pretraining researchers. Keep as literature reference.

paper.title: Counteraction-Aware Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation for General Capability Recovery with Domain Preservation
paper.abstract: Domain specialization can improve LLM behavior in vertical domains, but often weakens the general capabilities inherited from the original model. Recent Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation (MOPD) pipelines recover model capabilities by supervising student-generated trajectories with teacher feedback, but typically assume teacher-aligned prompt coverage, requiring prompts to match the teachers' training distributions. This assumption is difficult to satisfy when the general teacher is an open-so

summary.core_problem: 领域专项微调后的LLM会丢失从基座模型继承的通用能力，现有多教师On-Policy蒸馏（MOPD）方法依赖与教师训练分布对齐的提示词覆盖，当通用教师的后训练数据未知时无法满足这一前提；原生MOPD在使用代理通用提示词的不完全覆盖场景下存在两种失效模式：通用能力恢复与领域能力保留的梯度对冲、弱信号梯度弥散。
summary.importance: 属于后训练与能力保留交叉方向，提出的失效模式分析为多教师蒸馏的落地场景提供了可解释的故障归因；方法无需重建教师原始训练数据，降低了领域模型能力恢复的工程成本。
summary.technical_approach: 提出反作用感知多教师On-Policy蒸馏（CaMOPD），包含两个核心模块：1）解耦交替训练，默认执行3步通用能力恢复更新后再执行1步领域能力保留更新，避免两类任务梯度在同一步更新中对冲；2）基于间隙的样本选择，优先选择教师与学生token级对数概率间隙更大的样本，集中更新信号强度更高的样本，提升梯度方向的一致性。
summary.experiments: 在角色扮演对话、医疗推理QA两个差异较大的垂直领域验证，在保留领域专项能力的前提下，通用能力恢复效果优于所有基线方法；训练过程中观测到跨域梯度点积持续为负，验证了梯度对冲失效模式的存在。
summary.reading_guide: 优先阅读第3.2节的两种失效模式分析、第3.3节的两个核心模块设计，泛读实验部分的跨场景验证结果，预计阅读时间20分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Domain-specialized fine-tuning degrades the general capabilities inherited from base LLMs. Existing Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation (MOPD) pipelines require prompt distributions aligned with teachers' post-training data, which is unavailable when using open-source general teachers. Vanilla MOPD fails under proxy general prompt settings with incomplete coverage, suffering from two failure modes: counteracting gradients between recovery and preservation tasks, and dispersed weak gradients that dilute effective training signals.
summary_en.importance: This work contributes actionable failure mode analysis for multi-teacher distillation in practical post-training scenarios, and the proposed method eliminates the need to reconstruct teachers' hidden post-training distributions, reducing engineering overhead for domain model capability recovery.
summary_en.technical_approach: The proposed Counteraction-Aware MOPD (CaMOPD) introduces two components: 1) Decoupled alternating training schedule, which runs 3 general capability recovery updates followed by 1 domain preservation update to avoid gradient conflict within single training steps; 2) Gap-based sample selection, which prioritizes samples with larger token-level log-probability gaps between teacher and student outputs to concentrate high-strength correction signals and improve gradient coherence.
summary_en.experiments: Validated across two distinct vertical domains: role-play dialogue and medical reasoning QA. CaMOPD outperforms all baselines on general capability recovery while retaining full domain specialization performance. Persistently negative cross-domain gradient dot products observed during training confirm the existence of the gradient counteraction failure mode.
summary_en.reading_guide: Prioritize Section 3.2 for failure mode analysis and Section 3.3 for core method design. Skim the cross-domain experiment results in Section 4. Estimated reading time: 20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 分析了多教师蒸馏中通用能力与领域能力的梯度冲突问题，对做 domain-specific post-training 的同学有启发，重点看其梯度处理机制。
recommendation.en: Analyzes the gradient conflict between general and domain capabilities in multi-teacher distillation, inspiring for domain-specific post-training; focus on its gradient handling mechanism.

paper.title: Not All Disagreement Is Learnable: Token Teachability in On-Policy Distillation
paper.abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains a student on its own rollouts with token-level teacher supervision. Recent selective OPD methods exploit the non-uniformity of OPD signals by prioritizing high-entropy or high-disagreement tokens. We revisit this principle and ask: which token-level teacher signals are actually learnable? Using a fixed-context diagnostic that measures same-context teacher-student KL reduction, we show that raw KL disagreement is a coarse proxy for learning value. It conflates

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文处理的是 on-policy distillation 里的一个细粒度问题：学生模型在自己生成的前缀上接受教师 token 分布监督，但高 teacher-student KL 并不一定意味着这个 token 位置真的能学到东西。作者要区分两类分歧：一种是教师把概率质量重新分配到学生已经认为可能的候选 token 上，更新容易被学生吸收；另一种是教师主要支持学生当前预测支撑集之外的 token，KL 很大，但局部更新效果弱。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接影响在于训练信号质量分析，尤其是蒸馏、SFT 数据选择和 RL 前后的 policy improvement。它提醒一个常见误区：token 级别的 loss 或 KL 大，不等于学习价值高。对小模型蒸馏大模型时，瓶颈不只是 token 数量，而是教师信号是否落在学生当前可表示、可调整的局部区域内。这对高效蒸馏、token budget 分配、以及训练动态诊断都有参考价值，但贡献主要在 post-train/distillation 的信号选择层面，不是新的基座预训练 recipe。
summary.technical_approach: 核心方法有两步。第一步是 fixed-context diagnostic。作者收集学生 on-policy rollout 产生的前缀，把这些前缀固定成 context bank，然后用训练前后的学生模型在同一批上下文上重新打分，计算同一上下文下 teacher-student KL 的下降量。这样可以把 token 位置自身的可学习性从 rollout 噪声、后续上下文漂移和答案级评价中分离出来。第二步是定义 token teachability。作者用学生 top-K token 集合作为局部支撑集，考察教师概率质量是否主要落在这个支撑集或其附近。如果教师纠正信号与学生当前支撑集对齐，那么高 KL 更可能转化为 KL reduction；如果教师质量主要在学生支撑集之外，高 KL 往往只是不可兼容分歧。基于这个诊断，TA-OPD 用 support-aligned teacher-student disagreement 给 token 位置打分，只在高 teachability 的位置施加 OPD loss。它和高熵选择、原始 KL 选择的区别在于：不是选“不确定”或“分歧大”的 token，而是选学生当前状态下更可能被更新吸收的 token。实现上主要依赖 OPD 中已有的教师和学生 token 概率，可以用轻量 top-K 近似，不需要 reward model 或 verifier。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 Qwen3 和 Qwen2.5 系列的 teacher-student 配置，包含不同规模、推理能力和 backbone 的组合。诊断实验显示，低熵高 KL 区域并不均质；同样是 confident disagreement，support-aligned 的 token 更能预测固定上下文下的 KL 下降，而 off-support mismatch 的 token 学习收益弱。方法实验中，TA-OPD 在只保留 5% token 的设置下，经常可以匹配或超过 full-token OPD，并优于同 token budget 下的 entropy-based 和 divergence-based 选择方法。这个结果的重点不是单个 benchmark 的提升，而是说明 OPD 的有效性受 token teachability 约束，密集监督并不总是更好。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 25 分钟。先看 Introduction 中 Fig. 1，对 learnable disagreement 和 incompatible disagreement 的例子建立直觉。然后看 Diagnosing Token Teachability，重点是 fixed-context token gain 的定义、为什么要固定上下文、以及 entropy-KL 平面里 Q3 区域被进一步拆开的分析。TA-OPD 的算法部分可以快速看公式和伪代码，关注 teachability score 如何用 top-K 支撑集近似。实验部分优先看 token retention ratio 的消融、和 entropy/KL selector 的对比、不同 K 值的敏感性。附录 C 和 I 如果有时间值得看，分别对应诊断协议和固定上下文收益的理论说明。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks which token-level teacher signals are actually learnable in on-policy distillation. In OPD, the student is supervised on its own rollouts, but a large teacher-student KL at a token does not necessarily imply a useful update. The key distinction is between support-aligned disagreement, where the teacher reallocates probability mass among tokens the student already considers plausible, and off-support disagreement, where the teacher mostly prefers tokens outside the student’s current predictive support.
summary_en.importance: The main value is a sharper view of training-signal quality in distillation. It is relevant to LLM post-training, small-model distillation, and the pretrain-posttrain interface because it shows that token loss magnitude is a weak proxy for improvement. The result suggests that token budget should be spent on locally compatible supervision rather than simply dense supervision or high-KL positions. The contribution is methodological and diagnostic rather than a new foundation-model pretraining recipe.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper first introduces a fixed-context diagnostic. Student-generated on-policy prefixes are stored as a context bank. The initial and trained student are then rescored on exactly the same contexts against the same teacher distribution. For each token position, the diagnostic measures same-context teacher-student KL reduction, isolating local learnability from rollout variance and answer-level effects. The paper then formalizes token teachability using local support. The student’s top-K predictions define the tokens it currently treats as plausible. A teacher correction is more teachable when its probability mass is aligned with this support. Based on this idea, Teachability-Aware OPD scores response positions by support-aligned disagreement and applies the OPD loss only to high-teachability tokens. Unlike entropy-based or raw-KL selection, the criterion asks whether the teacher signal can be absorbed by the current student state. The method uses probabilities already available during OPD and can be approximated with top-K supports, without a reward model or verifier.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments use Qwen3 and Qwen2.5 teacher-student settings with variation in scale, reasoning strength, and model backbone. The diagnostic shows that the low-entropy, high-KL region is heterogeneous: support-aligned disagreements predict same-context KL reduction, while incompatible disagreements often remain hard to learn despite large KL. In training experiments, TA-OPD with only 5% retained tokens often matches or surpasses full-token OPD, and improves over entropy-based and divergence-based selectors under the same token budget. The important empirical message is that token quality can dominate token count in OPD.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 25 minutes. Start with Fig. 1 and the diagnostic setup, since they contain the central idea. Then read the section defining fixed-context token gain and local support; this is where the paper separates salience from learnability. The TA-OPD algorithm can be read quickly, focusing on how the score is computed from top-K teacher and student probabilities. In the experiments, prioritize the retention-ratio ablations, comparisons with entropy and KL selectors, and sensitivity to K. The appendices on the diagnostic protocol and the smoothness/gradient-alignment argument are useful if the method is being considered for implementation.

recommendation.zh: 修正了蒸馏中“高分歧token优先训练”的常见误区，可教性指标设计精巧，做蒸馏或模型压缩的可直接复用其固定上下文诊断方法。
recommendation.en: Corrects the common misconception of prioritizing high-disagreement tokens in distillation; the teachability metric is well-designed, and its fixed-context diagnostic can be directly reused by distillation and model compression researchers.

paper.title: The Bridge-Garden Dilemma in LLM Distillation: Why Mixing Hard and Soft Labels Works
paper.abstract: Knowledge distillation (KD) transfers knowledge from a large teacher model to a smaller student. In language modeling, the student is trained either on tokens sampled from the teacher (hard labels) or the teacher's full next-token distribution (soft labels). Despite soft labels appear strictly richer, we find that mixing hard and soft labels consistently yields better results. Crucially, we show that this gain cannot be explained by closer teacher matching during training. Instead, it comes from

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解释并改进 LLM 蒸馏中的一个现象：软标签包含完整 teacher 分布，按直觉应优于硬标签，但实验上硬标签和软标签混合训练常常更好。
summary.importance: 它对 post-train 和小模型压缩更直接，对预训练也有启发。关键点不是“更多分布信息一定更好”，而是训练目标要考虑自回归生成时的分布偏移。纯 soft KD 在 teacher prefix 上拟合得更好，但并不保证 student 在自己生成的 prefix 上稳定。这个观察也适用于预训练数据合成、teacher-generated corpus、SFT 数据蒸馏和小模型 continued pretrain：局部 next-token 拟合与序列级行为之间存在缺口。
summary.technical_approach: 论文提出 Bridge–Garden Decomposition，用局部风险敏感性把生成位置分成两类。Bridge 是高风险位置，下一个 token 需要比较精确；一旦选错，后续轨迹容易偏离。Garden 是低风险位置，多个候选 token 都能保持语义和连贯性。基于这个划分，作者给出 exposure bias 的上界分解，解释 hard 和 soft 的互补性：hard label 会把概率集中到 teacher 实际选择的 token，更适合 Bridge，能减少早期错误引起的级联偏移；soft label 保留 teacher 对多个合理 token 的分布，更适合 Garden，能保持多样性和分布形状。方法上，论文不只用固定比例混合，而提出一组自适应混合策略，包括 confidence-guided、entropy-guided、curriculum-guided 和 risk-guided，把不同 prefix 位置分配给不同程度的 hard/soft 监督。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖多个 teacher–student 组合：Qwen 7B→3B、Llama 8B→1B、Gemma 4B→1B、DeepSeek-Coder 6.7B→1.3B，并扩展到更大 Qwen2.5 容量差距、Qwen2.5-Coder 和开放式生成。任务包括 commonsense、math 和 coding。核心实验证据有三点：第一，hard+soft 混合稳定优于纯 soft KD；第二，这种提升不是来自更好的 teacher matching，加入 hard 后训练拟合指标反而变差；第三，混合目标降低了 exposure bias，因此序列级生成表现更好。论文还报告其方法优于 divergence-based 和 on-policy baselines，并将训练成本降低 9.7×。这个 9.7× 主要来自避免更昂贵的 on-policy 或复杂分布匹配流程，而不是单步 loss 计算本身的微小优化。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读到精读之间，预计 30–45 分钟。先看 Introduction 中 Fig. 2 对三件事的拆分：性能提升、训练拟合变差、exposure bias 下降。这是理解全文的入口。然后看 Bridge–Garden 理论部分，重点关注局部风险敏感性的定义、exposure bias 上界如何分解，以及 hard/soft 分别在哪类区域占优。方法部分可重点看自适应 mixing rule，而不是固定线性混合。实验部分建议看跨模型族结果、容量差距扩展实验，以及与 on-policy KD 的成本对比。若时间有限，理论直觉和 Fig. 2 比具体 benchmark 排名更有价值。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a puzzling behavior in LLM distillation: soft labels expose the full teacher distribution and should be more informative, yet mixing soft labels with sampled hard labels often produces better students.
summary_en.importance: The immediate relevance is model compression and post-training, but the lesson also matters for pretraining-adjacent workflows. The main point is that better next-token matching under teacher prefixes does not necessarily imply better autoregressive behavior under student-generated prefixes. This distinction applies to teacher-generated corpora, synthetic SFT data, continued pretraining with distilled data, and small-model training recipes that rely on large-model supervision.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper introduces a Bridge–Garden Decomposition based on local risk sensitivity. Bridge positions are high-risk: the next token has to be close to exact, because a wrong choice can push the future trajectory into a bad region. Garden positions are low-risk: several alternatives can preserve meaning and coherence. This decomposition yields an exposure-bias bound with separate contributions from these regions. The explanation is then straightforward: hard-label training concentrates probability on the teacher’s sampled action and is useful in Bridges, while soft-label training preserves the teacher’s distribution over alternatives and is useful in Gardens. The proposed methods therefore adapt the hard/soft mixture by prefix context, using confidence-, entropy-, curriculum-, and risk-guided strategies rather than a single global mixing weight.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments cover several teacher–student pairs and model families, including Qwen 7B to 3B, Llama 8B to 1B, Gemma 4B to 1B, and DeepSeek-Coder 6.7B to 1.3B, with additional tests on larger Qwen2.5 capacity gaps, Qwen2.5-Coder, and open-ended generation. Evaluation spans commonsense reasoning, math, and coding. The key empirical findings are: mixed hard/soft supervision consistently outperforms pure soft KD; the gain is not explained by closer teacher matching, since adding hard labels can worsen the training-fit metric; and the mixed objective reduces exposure bias, which improves sequence-level behavior. The paper also reports better results than divergence-based and on-policy baselines, with a 9.7× reduction in training cost, mainly by avoiding more expensive on-policy or heavy distribution-matching procedures.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim-to-careful reading is recommended, roughly 30–45 minutes. Start with the introduction and Fig. 2, which separate final performance, teacher matching during training, and exposure bias. Then read the Bridge–Garden theory section, especially the definition of local risk sensitivity and the exposure-bias decomposition. In the method section, focus on the adaptive mixing rules rather than the fixed linear combination. In the experiments, prioritize cross-family teacher–student results, capacity-gap extensions, and the cost comparison against on-policy KD. If time is limited, the theoretical intuition and Fig. 2 are more informative than individual benchmark numbers.

recommendation.zh: 值得看机制实验；若 exposure bias 证据干净，应把 hard/soft 混合纳入内部蒸馏消融。
recommendation.en: Read the mechanism experiments; if the exposure-bias evidence is clean, hard/soft mixing deserves an internal distillation ablation.

paper.title: X-Token: Projection-Guided Cross-Tokenizer Knowledge Distillation
paper.abstract: Cross-tokenizer knowledge distillation allows a student model to learn from teachers with incompatible vocabularies. Prior work operates on hidden states or logits; the latter is preferred as a drop-in replacement requiring no auxiliary components. Logit-based methods either use only the correct-token probability, missing the full 'dark knowledge' in the teacher's distribution, or operate on the full output distribution, relying on strict token partitioning and/or unprincipled heuristic ranking.

summary.core_problem: 论文处理的是跨 tokenizer 知识蒸馏中的“词表不兼容”问题。标准 KD 在每个位置对 teacher 与 student 的 next-token 分布做 KL，需要共享 tokenizer；这会把 student 绑定到同一 tokenizer 家族，限制了使用 Qwen、Phi、Llama 等异构 teacher 的能力。已有 logit-based 方法虽然部署成本低，但要么只用正确 token 概率，丢掉 teacher 分布里的暗知识；要么把词表切成 common/uncommon 两部分，依赖严格字符串匹配和 rank-based 对齐，导致两类问题：关键 token 落入 unmatched subset 后被错误压低，例如多位数字；以及等价 token 或 teacher 多 token 分解无法被利用，例如 student 的一个词对应 teacher 的多个子词。
summary.importance: 这篇工作的价值在于把跨 tokenizer KD 从启发式 rank matching 推向了可审计、可扩展的词表投影。对基座预训练和持续预训练有直接意义：第一，student 可以保持自己的 tokenizer，不必为了吃到更强 teacher 的信号而换词表；第二，可以做跨家族 multi-teacher KD，把不同 teacher 的推理、代码、多语能力合成到同一个训练信号里；第三，方法仍然是 logit-level loss，避免 representation alignment 那类额外模块和额外 forward 的成本，更接近大规模 continual pretraining 可用的形态。贡献量级主要体现在失败模式修复，而不是单纯小幅调参：在 Qwen3-4B teacher 场景，P-KL 对 GOLD 平均提升 +3.82，GSM8K 从 2.56 提到 15.54，说明 numerals 这类 critical token 的处理不是边角问题。
summary.technical_approach: X-Token 有三步。第一步是 span alignment。不同 tokenizer 会把同一段文本切成不同长度的 token 序列，因此不能直接逐位置做 KD。论文用确定性的动态规划对齐，把 student token span 与 teacher token span 分组成解码后文本一致的 chunk。随后用 chain-rule merge，把一个 chunk 内的自回归 token 概率相乘，得到 chunk-level distribution。这样 KD 的单位从单 token 位置变成文本一致的 span。第二步是构造稀疏 projection matrix W，尺寸为 |V_S| × |V_T|，把 student 词表上的概率映射到 teacher 词表空间。W 不是简单 string equality，而是使用 canonicalized string matching 和 multi-token decoding rules，把大小写、空格、规范化形式以及 teacher 多 token 分解带来的等价关系纳入匹配。这个矩阵可以固定，也可以在 KD 中进一步 refine。第三步是两个互补 loss。P-KL 去掉 common/uncommon partition，在投影后的完整分布上做 KL，适合关键 token 大量落在严格 common set 之外的情形，例如跨 tokenizer 数字切分差异。H-KL 则保留一种更保守的高置信映射，用 W 下的 top-ranked mapping 放宽匹配，适合覆盖率已经较好、但严格字符串匹配仍漏掉等价项的情形。论文给出一个实用的 coverage audit：先检查 numerals 等任务关键 token 在 common set 与 projection 下的覆盖情况，再决定用 P-KL 还是 H-KL。multi-teacher 扩展把多个异构 teacher 的 projected loss 加权合并；实验中简单静态权重优于自适应权重，提示 teacher 互补性和稳定权重比复杂调度更重要。
summary.experiments: 实验围绕 Llama-3.2-1B 这类固定 tokenizer 的 student，蒸馏来自 Phi-4-mini、Qwen3-4B、Llama-3.2-3B 等 teacher 的信号。核心结果有三组。第一，Qwen3-4B teacher 下，P-KL 相对 GOLD 平均提升 +3.82；GSM8K 从 2.56 提升到 15.54，接近 6 倍。这与论文诊断一致：Qwen 对多位数字的切分和 Llama 的 packed numeral 不一致，GOLD 的 common/uncommon 切分会把关键数字 token 放到弱监督甚至错误监督区域。第二，Phi-4-mini teacher 下，H-KL 带来稳定的约 +0.5 平均提升，说明当 critical token 覆盖没有严重破损时，更保守的高质量映射比 full-distribution 投影更稳。第三，multi-teacher KD 中，Phi-4-mini + Llama-3.2-3B 比单 teacher KD 高 +1.3；teacher 组合是否互补比 teacher 数量更重要。消融层面，值得关注的是 projection 覆盖率、W 是否 refine、P-KL 与 H-KL 的选择，以及 static weighting 与 adaptive weighting 的比较。论文的数字还显示，跨 tokenizer KD 的主要风险不是 KL 形式本身，而是错误匹配产生的系统性梯度偏置。
summary.reading_guide: 建议精读 Introduction 中对 GOLD/ULD 失败模式的拆解，尤其是 uncommon-token failure 和 over-conservative matching。这两点直接决定方法设计。Method 部分重点看 span alignment、chain-rule merge、projection matrix W 的构造规则，以及 P-KL/H-KL 的公式。这里要关注一个细节：它不是把 token 对齐问题简化成字符串相等，而是先把文本 span 对齐，再把词表概率投影到同一空间。实验部分建议优先看三类表和图：不同 teacher 下 P-KL/H-KL/GOLD 的对比；numeral 或其他 critical token 的 coverage audit；multi-teacher 权重策略的消融。深挖点包括：W refine 是否会引入不稳定或过拟合；P-KL 在大词表 teacher 上的计算成本；coverage audit 能否扩展到代码 token、Unicode、多语形态变化；chunk-level distribution 的 chain-rule merge 在长 span 上是否会出现数值和校准问题。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses cross-tokenizer knowledge distillation when teacher and student models use incompatible vocabularies. Standard logit KD assumes a shared next-token support, which effectively locks a student into teachers from the same tokenizer family. Existing logit-based cross-tokenizer methods either retain only the probability of the gold token or split the vocabulary into string-matched common tokens and an unmatched remainder. This creates two concrete failure modes: important tokens can fall into the unmatched set and receive noisy or suppressive gradients, as in multi-digit numerals under Qwen-to-Llama distillation; and useful equivalences are missed when one tokenizer represents a string as one token while another represents it as multiple tokens.
summary_en.importance: The work is directly relevant to continual pretraining and model upgrading. It lets a fixed-tokenizer student consume distributional supervision from stronger or specialized teachers without changing the student tokenizer or adding representation-alignment modules. This matters for multi-teacher distillation across model families, where teachers may differ in reasoning, code, and multilingual strengths. The main contribution is not a small loss tweak, but a more principled interface between mismatched vocabularies. The reported gains are also tied to a real pretraining concern: tokenization artifacts can create systematic training bias. With Qwen3-4B as teacher, P-KL improves over GOLD by +3.82 on average, including GSM8K moving from 2.56 to 15.54.
summary_en.technical_approach: X-Token has three components. First, it aligns student and teacher token sequences into text-consistent spans. Because different tokenizers produce different sequence lengths, per-position KD is ill-defined. The method uses deterministic dynamic-programming alignment to form paired chunks that decode to the same underlying text. Within each chunk, token probabilities are merged using the autoregressive chain rule to obtain chunk-level distributions. Second, it builds a sparse projection matrix W of shape |V_S| by |V_T|, mapping student-vocabulary probabilities into the teacher vocabulary space. The projection is constructed with canonicalized string matching and multi-token decoding rules, rather than exact string equality alone, and it can optionally be refined during KD. Third, it introduces two loss variants. P-KL removes the common/uncommon partition and aligns full projected distributions, which is useful when critical tokens are poorly covered by strict common-token matching. H-KL uses top-ranked mappings under W and is better suited to cases where the common coverage is already reasonably good but exact matching is too conservative. A coverage audit over categories such as numerals guides the choice between P-KL and H-KL. The multi-teacher extension combines projected KD losses from heterogeneous teachers, with static weighting reported to be more reliable than adaptive weighting.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments study fixed-tokenizer students such as Llama-3.2-1B distilled from teachers including Phi-4-mini, Qwen3-4B, and Llama-3.2-3B. Three results are central. Under Qwen3-4B supervision, P-KL outperforms GOLD by +3.82 on average, and GSM8K rises from 2.56 to 15.54. This matches the diagnosed numeral-tokenization failure: Qwen and Llama segment multi-digit numbers differently, and partition-based KD gives poor gradients to the tokens that determine math accuracy. Under Phi-4-mini supervision, H-KL gives a consistent gain of about +0.5, suggesting that a more conservative high-quality mapping is preferable when critical-token coverage is not badly broken. In multi-teacher KD, Phi-4-mini plus Llama-3.2-3B improves by +1.3 over single-teacher KD. The ablations to inspect are projection coverage, fixed versus refined W, P-KL versus H-KL selection, and static versus adaptive teacher weighting.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read the failure analysis in the introduction carefully. The two useful concepts are uncommon-token failure and over-conservative matching; they explain why previous full-distribution logit KD can harm exactly the tokens that matter for downstream accuracy. In the method, focus on span alignment, chain-rule merging, construction of the projection matrix W, and the definitions of P-KL and H-KL. The key design choice is that X-Token aligns text spans first and then projects distributions, instead of relying on exact token-string equality. In the experiments, prioritize the tables comparing GOLD, P-KL, and H-KL across teachers; the coverage audit for numerals or other critical categories; and the multi-teacher weighting ablation. Open questions worth checking are the compute cost of full projected distributions, numerical stability for long chunks, whether W refinement can drift, and how the same audit would behave for code tokens, Unicode-heavy text, and multilingual morphology.

recommendation.zh: NVIDIA团队提出的跨tokenizer蒸馏方法，指出了Llama→Qwen蒸馏中数字token被压制的具体问题，对模型迁移和tokenizer兼容性研究有直接参考价值。
recommendation.en: NVIDIA team's cross-tokenizer distillation method identifies concrete issues with numeric token suppression in Llama→Qwen distillation, directly relevant for model transfer and tokenizer compatibility research.

paper.title: TextTeacher: What Can Language Teach About Images?
paper.abstract: The platonic representation hypothesis suggests that sufficiently large models converge to a shared representation geometry, even across modalities. Motivated by this, we ask: Can the semantic knowledge of a language model efficiently improve a vision model? As an answer, we introduce TextTeacher, a simple auxiliary objective that injects text embeddings as additional information into image classification training. TextTeacher uses readily available image captions, a pre-trained and frozen text

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文问的是：在不做大规模图文对比预训练、也不改变推理模型结构的前提下，语言模型中的语义知识能否帮助训练一个纯视觉分类模型。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练研究的直接价值有限，因为实验主体仍是 ImageNet 分类和 ViT 监督训练，不是通用多模态预训练。但它提供了一个有用的训练信号设计样例：把冻结文本编码器产生的语义嵌入作为训练期的辅助锚点，用来改善视觉表征的早期组织方式。这个思路和 VLM 预训练里的跨模态表征对齐有关，尤其适合思考一个问题：语义先验是否必须通过端到端图文对比学习注入，还是可以作为低成本的 feature-space regularizer 使用。
summary.technical_approach: TextTeacher 的做法很简单。对没有文本标注的 ImageNet，先用预训练 captioning 模型生成图像描述；再用冻结的文本编码器把 caption 编成文本语义 embedding；视觉模型正常做分类训练，同时在视觉 backbone 的表示上接一个轻量 projection，用辅助损失把图像表示拉向对应的文本语义锚点。训练结束后，文本编码器和 projection 都移除，推理时仍是标准 ViT。论文强调 caption 不能只是类别名，最好是简洁但包含额外语义的信息，因为辅助信号需要补充标签和像素中不充分显式的概念，而不是重复监督标签。和传统知识蒸馏相比，它不需要运行大教师模型去输出每张图的 dense logits 或中间特征，也不把目标模型变成图文双塔；它更像是在训练早期给视觉表征提供一个语义坐标系。
summary.experiments: 主要实验在 ImageNet 和若干下游 fine-grained transfer 任务上进行，backbone 是标准 ViT 系列。论文报告在相同训练 recipe 和预算下，ImageNet top-1 accuracy 最高提升 +2.7 个百分点；在 noisy label 设置下提升可达 +8.4 个百分点；Transformer backbone 的迁移任务平均提升约 +1.0 个百分点。效率对比中，TextTeacher 在固定 compute 下优于若干蒸馏基线，或者达到相近/更好精度时只需约 66% 的训练时间。消融结论比较有信息量：辅助文本信号主要在训练早期起作用，更像 feature-space preconditioner；作用位置更多集中在较深层；caption 内容质量和互补性比单纯增加文本长度更关键。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，预计 15–20 分钟。建议重点看方法部分的 auxiliary alignment loss、caption 构造策略，以及 ablation 中关于训练阶段、层位置、caption 类型和 noisy label 的分析。对预训练研究更有价值的是它如何把冻结语言表征转成训练期语义约束，而不是 ImageNet 分类结果本身。可以跳过大部分下游分类表格，只保留效率对比和消融结论。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies whether semantic knowledge from a language model can improve a vision-only classifier without large-scale image-text contrastive pretraining and without adding any text component at inference time.
summary_en.importance: Its relevance to foundation-model pretraining is indirect. The main setting is supervised ViT training on ImageNet, not general-purpose multimodal pretraining. The useful part is the training-signal design: frozen text representations are used as semantic anchors that regularize image features during training. This gives a low-cost alternative to full image-text co-training and is relevant to questions around cross-modal representation geometry, auxiliary objectives, and how semantic priors can shape early feature formation.
summary_en.technical_approach: TextTeacher first obtains captions for ImageNet images using a pretrained captioning model, then encodes those captions with a frozen text encoder. During vision training, a lightweight projection maps visual features into the text-embedding space, and an auxiliary alignment loss pulls image features toward their corresponding textual anchors. The classifier is still trained with the standard supervised objective. At inference time, both the text encoder and the projection head are removed, so the deployed model remains a normal ViT. A key design choice is that captions should contain concise information beyond the class label; otherwise the auxiliary signal mostly duplicates the label and adds little. Compared with knowledge distillation, this method does not require a large teacher to be queried for dense predictions throughout training, and it does not convert the model into a multimodal architecture.
summary_en.experiments: The paper reports experiments on ImageNet and several fine-grained transfer benchmarks using standard ViT backbones. With the same training recipe and compute budget, TextTeacher improves ImageNet accuracy by up to 2.7 percentage points. Under noisy labels, the gain reaches 8.4 percentage points. For transformer backbones, average transfer performance improves by about 1.0 percentage point. In compute-controlled comparisons, it outperforms several distillation-style baselines, or reaches comparable or better accuracy with roughly 66% of the training time. The ablations suggest that the auxiliary text signal mainly helps in the early phase of optimization, acts more strongly in deeper layers, and behaves like a feature-space preconditioner rather than a permanent inference-time dependency.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 15–20 minutes. Focus on the auxiliary alignment objective, the caption-generation choices, and the ablations on training stage, layer placement, caption content, and noisy labels. For pretraining researchers, the main takeaway is the use of frozen language representations as a cheap semantic constraint during representation learning, not the ImageNet classification setup itself.

recommendation.zh: 仅看方法部分即可，跨模态知识注入的低成本思路可作为多模态预训练消融的参考，无范式级突破
recommendation.en: Only read the method section; the low-cost cross-modal knowledge injection idea can serve as reference for multimodal pretraining ablations, no paradigm-level breakthrough.

institutions: German Research Center for Artificial Intelligence (DFKI)

paper.title: The Distillation Game: Adaptive Attacks & Efficient Defenses
paper.abstract: Distillation attacks create a deployment trade-off for model providers: the same outputs that make a model more useful can also make it easier to imitate. We study this trade-off through a minimax game between a utility-constrained teacher and an adaptive student. Our framework yields tractable one-sided response rules: an adaptive evaluation rule in which the student reweights high-value examples, and a teacher-side defense template that suppresses outputs most useful for distillation. From a c

summary.core_problem: 现有蒸馏攻防研究普遍孤立设计防御方法、采用固定均匀采样的学生模型做评估，未考虑真实攻击者会自适应筛选、重加权高蒸馏价值样本的情况，也缺乏统一框架来比较不同防御的设计逻辑。
summary.importance: 对预训练基座模型部署阶段的知识产权保护、能力泄露防护有直接参考价值；其自适应评估框架修正了过往防御效果评估的乐观偏差，也为后续蒸馏防御的设计提供了统一的形式化基础。
summary.technical_approach: 将蒸馏攻防建模为带约束的极小极大博弈：教师端受效用约束，输出不能偏离原参考模型过多；学生端受自适应预算约束，不能无限制偏离观测到的教师输出分布。从博弈的最优响应分别推导出两部分：1）学生端的自适应评估规则，按每个样本对蒸馏的价值重加权训练数据；2）教师端的防御模板，抑制对蒸馏最有用的输出。进一步引入低成本的代理学生估计样本价值，提出仅需前向传播的Product-of-Experts（PoE）防御，生成阶段融合教师与代理学生的输出。
summary.experiments: 在GSM8K和MATH数据集上，自适应评估相比被动均匀采样，能让学生模型准确率相对提升约50%，暴露了现有防御被高估的鲁棒性。PoE防御的推理开销仅为原教师模型的1.6倍，低于现有性能领先防御的2.9倍；同时在LLM评审的输出质量评测中，PoE生成的推理链质量更高。在商用前沿模型的推理链摘要数据上，即使是被动学生也能蒸馏出不可忽略的能力，说明仅靠隐藏或摘要推理链不足以完全防御蒸馏。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读重点看第1章的问题背景与贡献概述、第2章的博弈框架形式化定义、第3章的PoE防御实现细节；附录C的商用模型蒸馏实验可快速浏览，预计阅读时间20-30分钟。
summary.authors_note: 加州大学伯克利分校Simons计算理论研究所，作者为共同贡献、按姓氏字母排序。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing distillation attack and defense studies typically design defenses in isolation and evaluate them against passive students that train uniformly on released outputs. This setup ignores the fact that realistic attackers adaptively filter or reweight high-value examples for distillation, and lacks a unified framework to compare the design logic of different defenses.
summary_en.importance: Provides direct reference for intellectual property protection and capability leakage mitigation during pretrained base model deployment. Its adaptive evaluation framework corrects the optimistic bias in prior defense effectiveness assessments, and offers a unified formal foundation for future distillation defense design.
summary_en.technical_approach: Models distillation attack and defense as a constrained minimax game: the teacher operates under a utility constraint that outputs cannot deviate too much from the reference model, while the student operates under an adaptation budget constraint that it cannot deviate indefinitely from the observed teacher output distribution. The optimal responses of the game derive two components: 1) An adaptive evaluation rule for the student side that reweights training data by the distillation value of each sample; 2) A defense template for the teacher side that suppresses outputs most useful for distillation. A low-cost proxy student is further used to estimate sample value, leading to the Product-of-Experts (PoE) defense — a forward-pass-only method that combines teacher and proxy student outputs during generation.
summary_en.experiments: On GSM8K and MATH datasets, adaptive evaluation improves student model accuracy by ~50% relative to passive uniform sampling, exposing the overestimated robustness of existing defenses. PoE defense incurs only 1.6× teacher inference overhead, lower than the 2.9× overhead of prior leading defenses. PoE also produces higher-quality reasoning chains in LLM-judged output quality assessments. Experiments on reasoning chain summaries from commercial frontier models show that even passive students can distill non-trivial capabilities, indicating that hiding or summarizing reasoning chains alone is insufficient for full distillation defense.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 1 for problem background and contribution overview, Section 2 for formal definition of the game framework, Section 3 for PoE defense implementation details. Appendix C experiments on commercial model distillation can be skimmed quickly. Estimated reading time: 20-30 minutes.
summary_en.authors_note: Simons Institute for the Theory of Computing, UC Berkeley. Authors contributed equally, listed in alphabetical order.

recommendation.zh: 蒸馏攻击的自适应评估发现被动评估严重低估了攻击有效性，对评估蒸馏防御和学生模型评估方法有借鉴意义，重点看§4自适应评估部分
recommendation.en: Adaptive evaluation of distillation attacks reveals passive evaluation severely underestimates attack effectiveness; relevant for distillation defense evaluation and student model assessment; focus on §4 adaptive evaluation

paper.title: Consistently Informative Soft-Label Temperature for Knowledge Distillation
paper.abstract: Knowledge distillation (KD) transfers knowledge from a high-capacity teacher to a compact student by matching their predictive distributions, with temperature scaling serving as a central mechanism for smoothing teacher predictions and exposing informative "dark knowledge" beyond the hard label. However, the standard fixed-temperature design is inherently sample-agnostic. Since samples differ in logit scale and learning difficulty, a single global temperature produces teacher soft labels with hi

summary.core_problem: 解决知识蒸馏中固定全局 temperature 对所有样本一视同仁，导致教师软标签信息量不稳定的问题。
summary.importance: 这是模型压缩中的方法改进。它指出固定 temperature 会让部分样本过尖锐、部分样本过平滑，并进一步质疑教师和学生共享同一 temperature 的默认设计。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 CIST，为教师和学生分别分配 sample-wise adaptive temperature。教师侧目标是让软标签保持一致的信息量，学生侧则避免强行对齐教师和学生的 logit scale，适应容量差异。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型、数据集和提升幅度。可确认的是论文围绕 KD 预测分布和 temperature scaling 做实验验证，但是否覆盖 LLM 蒸馏无法从给定信息确认。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Rochester Institute of Technology 和 Oakland University。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the problem that a fixed global temperature in knowledge distillation produces inconsistently informative soft labels across samples.
summary_en.importance: This is an incremental but plausible model-compression contribution. It argues that fixed temperature can make some teacher distributions too sharp and others over-smoothed, and questions the default of sharing the same temperature between teacher and student.
summary_en.technical_approach: CIST assigns separate sample-wise adaptive temperatures to the teacher and the student. The teacher-side temperature aims to maintain consistent soft-label informativeness, while the student-side temperature avoids rigid logit-scale matching under capacity mismatch.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide concrete model sizes, datasets, or improvement numbers. It indicates empirical validation around KD distributions and temperature scaling, but LLM distillation coverage is not confirmed from the provided information.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Rochester Institute of Technology and Oakland University.

recommendation.zh: 只看方法定义即可；若没有 LLM 蒸馏实验，它更像分类 KD 的温度调参论文，迁移价值有限。
recommendation.en: Skim the method definition only; without LLM distillation experiments, this is mostly a classification-KD temperature paper with limited transfer.

paper.title: DeltaPrompts: Escaping the Zero-Delta Trap in Multimodal Distillation
paper.abstract: Distillation enables compact Vision-Language Models (VLMs) to obtain strong reasoning capabilities, yet the prompts driving this process are typically chosen via simple heuristics or aggregated from off-the-shelf datasets. We reveal a critical inefficiency in this approach: up to 69% of the prompts in standard chart / document reasoning datasets are effectively zero-delta, meaning the teacher and student already induce the exact same answer distribution. Training on these prompts provides minima

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作讨论的不是蒸馏目标怎么写，而是蒸馏数据里哪些 prompt 真正有学习价值。作者指出，多模态蒸馏里一个被长期忽略的问题是：大量现成 chart/document reasoning 数据对 teacher 和 student 来说几乎没有分歧，因而蒸馏信号接近于零。文中把这种现象称为 zero-delta trap。若 teacher 与 student 在某个输入上诱导出的答案分布相同或近似相同，那么无论做 forward KL、reverse KL，还是 on-policy distillation，这个样本都很难继续推动 student 学到新能力。核心问题因此变成：如何系统地找到并构造那些能暴露 teacher-student capability gap、同时又保持技能覆盖面的 prompt，而不是继续堆更多现成题目。
summary.importance: 对预训练/蒸馏研究的启发主要有两层。第一，它把“数据质量”具体化成了 teacher-student 分歧强度，而不是传统的数据难度、人工标签质量或题型覆盖率。这一点对蒸馏、continual pretrain、teacher-generated SFT 都有直接参考价值。第二，它给出一个很实用的判断：当 student 已经较强时，蒸馏瓶颈往往不在优化器或 loss，而在训练分布里缺少真正有梯度价值的样本。文中在多模态推理上验证了这一点，但这个结论对文本蒸馏也成立，尤其适用于强 student 从更强 teacher 学习时的数据筛选与合成。贡献量级上，它不是提出新蒸馏目标，而是重新定义蒸馏数据构造原则；这类工作通常不会立刻改写范式，但很可能改变后续数据管线的设计。
summary.technical_approach:
方法核心是用 answer divergence（记作 Δ）近似每个 prompt 的蒸馏价值。作者没有直接估计完整序列分布之间的 divergence，因为序列级 KL 既昂贵又噪声大，尤其在长链式推理和多模态输出里更难稳定。替代做法是只看离散答案分布：给定一个 prompt，让 teacher 和 student 产生答案分布，再衡量两者在答案层面的差异。若 Δ≈0，则该 prompt 被视为 zero-delta；若 Δ>0，则说明这个样本暴露了功能差距，更适合蒸馏。

但作者进一步指出，简单从现有数据中过滤 non-zero-delta 样本并不够，因为过滤后剩余样本的技能多样性会明显下降，容易把训练集收缩成少数高分歧但窄覆盖的题型。为此他们设计了一个分阶段的数据合成管线，而不是只做筛选。第一阶段是 seed-guided synthesis：把现有 chart/document 等数据集当作种子，不直接拿来训练，而是让 teacher 基于这些种子扩展 prompt 池，主动搜索更高 Δ 的变体。第二阶段是 skill-targeted augmentation：针对 student 尚未表现出的具体推理技能继续定向增广，目标不是单纯提高难度，而是提高 capability gap 并补足覆盖面。整个流程里 teacher 既是数据生成器，也是 gap 的参照系。

最终得到的 DeltaPrompts 是一个 200k 规模的合成数据集，强调两个约束：一是非零 answer divergence，二是广泛技能覆盖。训练上既支持 on-policy distillation，也支持把它当作 off-policy SFT 资源。方法与已有工作最大的区别在于：过去很多蒸馏工作把 prompt 看成固定背景，只在 loss、采样或 on/off-policy 机制上做文章；这篇工作把 prompt distribution 本身当成主要优化对象，并给出可操作的 proxy 指标和合成流程。
summary.experiments:
实验里最关键的发现有三点。第一，现有标准 chart/document reasoning 数据集中，最高可有 69% 的 prompt 属于 effectively zero-delta，也就是 teacher 和 student 诱导出相同答案分布。这直接解释了为什么蒸馏收益会很快饱和，而且继续加同类数据规模帮助不大。第二，在只保留 non-zero-delta 样本时，虽然单样本学习价值提高，但数据多样性显著下降，因此“过滤”不是完整解法。第三，DeltaPrompts 在多个设置下都带来稳定收益。

文中报告，基于 200k 合成 prompt，在 chart/document reasoning 与高分辨率、感知导向推理任务上做 on-policy distillation，可带来最高 15% 的相对提升；而且这个提升是在已经较强、且经过较多优化的 Qwen3-VL-8B-Thinking 之上取得的，不是弱基线上的轻松增益。作者还展示了跨模型族迁移：用同一批 DeltaPrompts，不重新生成数据，也能迁移到 GLM-4 系列并获得收益，说明数据并未过度绑定某个 student。另一个值得注意的结果是 out-of-domain transfer：在 STEM reasoning 上也有外溢收益，说明这些 prompt 并非只记住 chart/document 模板，而是确实推动了更一般的推理能力。除此之外，DeltaPrompts 作为 off-policy SFT 数据也明显优于常见的现成数据混合。

从消融逻辑看，最值得注意的是作者把“更多数据”“更高 Δ”“更广覆盖”拆开验证：zero-delta 数据即便继续扩容也很快饱和；只追求高 Δ 而忽略覆盖面也不稳；两者结合才形成持续收益。这部分对数据工程很有参考价值。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇适合泛读，但建议把引言和方法部分认真看完，因为作者真正有价值的地方不在 benchmark 分数，而在问题定义。优先看三部分：
1. 引言与“What prompts are fit for distillation?”这一节。这里把蒸馏价值重新表述为 per-prompt capability gap，值得细读。
2. answer divergence 的定义与为何不用 sequence-level divergence。这里能看出作者在工程上做了什么取舍。
3. 数据分析和消融图表，尤其是 zero-delta 比例、过滤后多样性下降、以及 DeltaPrompts 相对现成数据混合的收益。

如果时间有限，先抓住两个问题：为什么 zero-delta 会让蒸馏饱和；为什么简单过滤不够而必须做 synthesis。预计 20–30 分钟可以读到主要信息。若想深挖，可继续看附录里关于 divergence 估计、数据生成细节和质量过滤的实现，因为这些部分决定了方法能否迁移到纯文本蒸馏或其他模态。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks a data-centric question in multimodal distillation: which prompts actually carry learning signal? The main claim is that a large fraction of commonly used chart/document reasoning prompts are effectively useless for distillation because the teacher and the student already induce the same answer distribution on them. The authors call this the zero-delta trap. If the teacher-student gap is near zero on a prompt, optimizing KL-style distillation objectives on that prompt contributes little, regardless of whether the training is off-policy or on-policy. The real problem, then, is not how to tweak the distillation loss, but how to construct prompts that reliably expose capability gaps while preserving broad skill coverage.
summary_en.importance: Its value is less about a new objective and more about a sharper definition of data quality for distillation. The paper operationalizes useful training data as prompts with non-trivial teacher-student disagreement, rather than prompts that are merely difficult, diverse, or drawn from standard benchmarks. That framing matters beyond VLM distillation. It is relevant to teacher-generated SFT, continual pretraining with synthetic data, and strong-student / stronger-teacher transfer in general. The practical message is clear: once the student is already competent, the bottleneck often shifts from optimization to prompt distribution. In that sense, this work is a meaningful contribution to data construction methodology, even if it does not introduce a new modeling paradigm.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The central tool is answer divergence, denoted as Delta, used as a proxy for the distillation value of a prompt. Instead of estimating sequence-level divergence between teacher and student distributions, which is expensive and noisy for long multimodal reasoning outputs, the paper measures divergence over the induced discrete answer distribution. Prompts with Delta approximately zero are treated as zero-delta prompts; prompts with non-zero Delta are considered informative because they reveal a functional gap between teacher and student.

A key observation is that simple filtering is not enough. If one only keeps non-zero-delta prompts from existing datasets, the remaining pool becomes much narrower in skill coverage. So the authors do not stop at selection. They build a staged synthesis pipeline. First, seed-guided synthesis expands the prompt pool from existing chart/document datasets, using them as seeds rather than as direct training data. The goal is to search for prompt variants with higher answer divergence. Second, skill-targeted augmentation explicitly generates prompts around reasoning skills that the student still fails to exhibit, so the dataset improves both disagreement and coverage.

The resulting dataset, DeltaPrompts, contains 200k synthetic prompts designed to satisfy two constraints: non-zero answer divergence and broad skill diversity. The same dataset can be used for on-policy distillation or as an off-policy SFT resource. The main difference from prior distillation work is conceptual: earlier work mostly treated prompts as fixed and focused on the objective, decoding, or policy mismatch; this paper treats the prompt distribution itself as the primary optimization target.
summary_en.experiments:
The most important empirical findings are straightforward and useful. First, in standard chart/document reasoning datasets, up to 69% of prompts are effectively zero-delta, meaning the teacher and student induce the same answer distribution. This explains why distillation gains saturate quickly even when more data is added. Second, simply filtering to non-zero-delta prompts improves per-sample usefulness but hurts diversity, so filtering alone is not a sufficient solution. Third, the synthesized DeltaPrompts dataset produces consistent gains across settings.

The paper reports a 200k-prompt synthetic corpus and shows up to 15% relative improvement in on-policy distillation on chart/document reasoning and high-resolution perception-centric reasoning tasks. Importantly, these gains are obtained on top of an already strong student, such as Qwen3-VL-8B-Thinking, rather than on a weak baseline. The gains also transfer across model families: the same DeltaPrompts data improves GLM-4 models without regenerating the dataset. There is also out-of-domain transfer to STEM reasoning, suggesting that the prompts are not merely overfitting benchmark templates. In addition, DeltaPrompts works well as an off-policy SFT resource and outperforms standard off-the-shelf data mixtures.

The ablation logic is one of the stronger parts of the paper. It separates the effects of more data, higher Delta, and broader coverage. More zero-delta data saturates quickly. High-Delta data without coverage is brittle. The combination of disagreement and diversity is what sustains improvement.
summary_en.reading_guide:
This is a skim paper, but the framing is worth reading carefully. Start with the introduction and the section on what makes prompts fit for distillation. That is where the paper earns its value. Then read the definition of answer divergence and the discussion of why sequence-level divergence is avoided. After that, focus on the dataset analysis and ablations: the zero-delta ratios, the diversity collapse after filtering, and the comparison between DeltaPrompts and standard data mixtures.

If time is limited, keep two questions in mind: why does zero-delta data cause saturation, and why is synthesis necessary beyond filtering? Around 20 to 30 minutes should be enough to extract the main ideas. If you want to adapt the method to text-only distillation or other modalities, the appendix on divergence estimation, generation details, and quality filtering is the part to inspect more closely.

recommendation.zh: 零delta陷阱的观测可直接复用在所有蒸馏任务的数据筛选流程，仅需阅读第3节的散度量化方法
recommendation.en: The zero-delta trap observation can be directly reused for data selection in all distillation tasks, only read §3 for divergence quantification methods

paper.title: BootstrapAgent: Distilling Repository Setup into Reusable Agent Knowledge
paper.abstract: Code agents increasingly help developers work with unfamiliar repositories, but every such task depends on a costly prerequisite: bootstrapping the repository into a usable development state. This process requires substantial trial-and-error exploration, yet the resulting knowledge--resolved dependencies, repair strategies--stays trapped in a single conversation, unavailable to future agents. We therefore formulate repository bootstrapping as a reusable startup knowledge problem and introduce Bo

summary.core_problem: 代码Agent处理陌生仓库时，仓库环境引导（bootstrapping）成本高，探索得到的依赖修复、配置策略等知识无法复用在后续任务中
summary.importance: 系统创新，首次将仓库引导过程的知识蒸馏为可复用的结构化合约
summary.technical_approach: 提出多Agent框架BootstrapAgent，将引导过程的启发式知识蒸馏为可验证的.bootstrap合约，支持Docker验证、trace驱动修复、热启动加速迭代
summary.experiments: 论文摘要未提供完整实验细节，仅验证框架可有效降低仓库引导的时间成本
summary.authors_note: 浙江大学、中科院信工所、澳大利亚国立大学联合团队

summary_en.core_problem: When code agents work with unfamiliar repositories, repository bootstrapping is costly, and discovered knowledge such as dependency fixes and configuration strategies cannot be reused in subsequent tasks
summary_en.importance: System innovation, first to distill knowledge from repository bootstrapping process into reusable structured contracts
summary_en.technical_approach: Propose multi-agent framework BootstrapAgent, which distills heuristics discovered during bootstrapping into verifiable .bootstrap contracts, supporting Docker verification, trace-driven repair, and warm start to accelerate iteration
summary_en.experiments: Full experimental details are not available in truncated abstract, only verified that the framework effectively reduces repository bootstrapping time cost
summary_en.authors_note: Joint work by Zhejiang University, Institute of Information Engineering CAS, and Australian National University

recommendation.zh: 仓库级代码Agent的辅助工具，仅作为文献备查，不需要阅读正文
recommendation.en: This auxiliary tool for repository-level code agents is for literature reference only, no need to read the full text

institutions: Institute of Information Engineering, Chinese Academy of Sciences

paper.title: Prompting Policies for Multi-step Reasoning and Tool-Use in Black-box LLMs with Iterative Distillation of Experience
paper.abstract: The shift toward interacting with frozen, "black-box" Large Language Models (LLMs) has transformed prompt engineering from a heuristic exercise into a critical optimization challenge. We propose a Reinforcement Learning (RL) framework for training learned prompting policies via iterative distillation of experience. In this architecture, a lightweight prompter model is optimized to maximize task-specific rewards for a larger, frozen worker LLM. By utilizing a contrastive experience buffer that co

summary.core_problem: 如何通过强化学习优化黑盒LLM在多步推理和工具使用任务中的Prompt策略？
summary.importance: 提出了一种通过迭代经验蒸馏来训练Prompt策略的RL框架，将迭代的Prompt优化过程摊销到轻量级Prompter模型的单次前向传播中，显著提升了黑盒LLM的复杂任务性能。
