summary.technical_approach: 训练一个轻量级的Prompter模型，以最大化冻结的Worker LLM的任务特定奖励。利用包含标量奖励和密集文本批评的对比经验缓冲区，将迭代的Prompt改进蒸馏到策略权重中。
summary.experiments: 在Big Bench Extra Hard (BBEH)和Tau-bench上进行实验。在逻辑推理任务上性能从55%提升至90%，在工具使用任务上从74%提升至91%。
summary.authors_note: Google Research团队工作。

summary_en.core_problem: How to optimize prompt policies for black-box LLMs in multi-step reasoning and tool-use tasks via reinforcement learning?
summary_en.importance: Proposes an RL framework for training prompt policies via iterative distillation of experience, amortizing the iterative prompt refinement process into a single forward pass of a lightweight prompter model, significantly improving black-box LLM performance on complex tasks.
summary_en.technical_approach: Trains a lightweight prompter model to maximize task-specific rewards for a frozen worker LLM. Utilizes a contrastive experience buffer coupling scalar rewards with dense textual critiques to distill iterative prompt refinement into policy weights.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on Big Bench Extra Hard (BBEH) and Tau-bench. Improved performance from 55% to 90% in logic-intensive reasoning and 74% to 91% in tool-use tasks.
summary_en.authors_note: Work from Google Research.

recommendation.zh: Google用RL训练小模型来给大模型写Prompt，将迭代优化蒸馏为单次生成，对Post-train阶段的推理能力增强和Agent系统设计有参考价值。
recommendation.en: Google uses RL to train a small model to write prompts for a large model, distilling iterative optimization into single-shot generation, valuable for reasoning enhancement in post-train and agent system design.

paper.title: SimCT: Recovering Lost Supervision for Cross-Tokenizer On-Policy Distillation
paper.abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) is a standard tool for transferring teacher behavior to a smaller student, but it implicitly assumes that teacher and student predictions are comparable token by token, an assumption that fails whenever the two models tokenize the same text differently. Under heterogeneous tokenizers, exact shared-token matching silently discards a large fraction of the teacher signal at precisely the positions where vocabularies disagree. We propose \textbf{\underline{Sim}ple \under

summary.core_problem: 解决异构 tokenizer 下 on-policy distillation 无法逐 token 对齐、从而丢失大量教师监督信号的问题。
summary.importance: 这是一个很实际的训练接口问题。它不改变蒸馏目标本身，而是修正“监督该落在哪个单位上”这一前提，属于后训练/蒸馏流程中的方法改进；对跨 tokenizer 蒸馏、小模型继承大模型行为、以及 tokenizer 迁移都有直接参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 SimCT（Simple Cross-Tokenizer OPD）。核心做法不是重写 OPD loss，而是把 teacher-student 的比较单位从“共享 token”扩展到“双方 tokenizer 都能表达的最细短文本 continuation”。也就是说，除了完全共享的 token 外，还允许在短多 token 片段上比较两边对同一文本单元的概率，从而恢复原先因分词不一致而被静默丢弃的监督。论文进一步主张，这类 jointly tokenizable 的最小单元是跨 tokenizer 监督的最细接口；如果再做得更粗，会抹平 teacher 与 student 在局部决策上的差异，削弱 on-policy 学习信号。
summary.experiments: 摘要显示作者在三个异构 tokenizer 设置上做了实验，比较 SimCT 与传统只在共享 token 上做 OPD 的方法，并分析不同监督单元粒度的效果。核心结论是：在 tokenizer 不一致时，传统 OPD 会丢掉相当比例的监督，而 SimCT 能稳定恢复这部分信号并带来更好的蒸馏效果。当前可见信息未给出具体模型规模、数据量和提升幅度；从分享者解读看，方法实现较简单，当前更像是“单词/短片段级 KL”接口修正，而不是全词表分布蒸馏。

summary_en.core_problem: It addresses the loss of teacher supervision in on-policy distillation when teacher and student use different tokenizers and token-level alignment breaks down.
summary_en.importance: This is a practical training-interface problem rather than a new objective. The contribution is to fix where supervision should be applied under tokenizer mismatch, which matters for distillation, tokenizer migration, and transferring behavior from larger models to smaller ones.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper proposes SimCT (Simple Cross-Tokenizer OPD). Instead of changing the OPD loss itself, it enlarges the supervision space from exact shared tokens to the finest short continuations that both tokenizers can realize. In other words, teacher and student are compared not only on identical tokens but also on short multi-token text units that correspond to the same underlying string. The paper argues that these jointly tokenizable minimal units are the finest valid supervision interface; coarser units erase useful teacher-student distinctions needed for on-policy learning.
summary_en.experiments: From the abstract, the method is evaluated on three heterogeneous-tokenizer settings against standard OPD that only uses shared-token supervision, with additional analysis on supervision granularity. The main result is that standard OPD silently drops a substantial amount of signal under tokenizer mismatch, while SimCT recovers that signal and improves distillation quality. The visible metadata does not provide exact model sizes, data scale, or gains; based on the shared commentary, the implementation appears simple and closer to word/short-span KL matching than full-vocabulary distribution distillation.

recommendation.zh: 这是个很干净的接口层修补：不改 loss 先把 supervision 对齐做对；若你做跨 tokenizer 蒸馏，先读方法和消融，但别急着高估，内部 credit assignment 还没解决。
recommendation.en: A clean interface fix: get supervision alignment right before inventing new losses; worth reading if you do cross-tokenizer distillation, but do not over-credit it—the intra-span credit assignment problem is still open.

summary.core_problem: 现有同策略蒸馏（OPD）默认师生模型使用相同分词器，当二者分词器异构时，仅匹配共现token的监督方式会丢失大量教师模型的监督信号；现有跨分词器OPD方法要么引入额外计算开销、额外训练参数，要么降低监督粒度，造成性能损失。
summary.importance: 验证了仅通过扩展监督空间即可低成本恢复跨分词器蒸馏丢失的信号，不需要复杂的对齐模块，为不同模型家族之间的知识蒸馏、大模型轻量化部署提供了更简洁的方案，也为持续预训练中的跨模型知识迁移提供参考。
summary.technical_approach: 提出SimCT方法，不修改OPD原有的反向KL损失函数，仅扩展监督空间：除了师生分词器的共享token外，加入两个分词器都能表示的最短多token连续文本作为最小对齐单元，在这个统一空间上计算常规OPD损失；不需要额外参数、学习投影或最优传输计算，监督空间直接基于两个现有分词器构造。
summary.experiments: 在数学推理、代码生成基准上测试3个不同模型家族，相比SFT平均相对提升6.0%，稳定优于代表性跨分词器OPD基线；消融实验显示增加分词器不匹配文本的监督占比可提升性能，粗化最小对齐单元会丢失KL监督信号，降低下游任务收益。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读Introduction的跨分词器OPD问题分析部分、Methodology的最小对齐单元构造逻辑，以及实验的消融分析部分，预计阅读时间15分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing on-policy distillation (OPD) for LLMs assumes identical tokenizers between teacher and student models. Under heterogeneous tokenizers, matching only shared tokens discards most teacher supervision signals, and existing cross-tokenizer OPD methods incur extra computation, additional trainable parameters, or coarser supervision granularity, leading to performance loss.
summary_en.importance: Demonstrates that supervision space expansion can recover lost cross-tokenizer distillation signals without complex alignment modules, providing a low-cost solution for knowledge distillation across different model families and lightweight LLM deployment, also offering reference for cross-model knowledge transfer in continual pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes SimCT, which keeps the standard reverse-KL OPD loss unchanged, expands the supervision space to include both shared tokens and minimal aligned units, which are the shortest multi-token continuations representable by both tokenizers. No additional parameters, learned projections or optimal transport computation are required, as the supervision space is constructed directly from the two existing tokenizers.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on mathematical reasoning and code generation benchmarks across 3 model families. Achieves 6.0% average relative gain over SFT, outperforms representative cross-tokenizer OPD baselines consistently. Ablations show that increasing recovered supervision from tokenizer-mismatched text improves performance, while coarsening minimal aligned units reduces downstream gains.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the problem analysis in Introduction, the construction logic of minimal aligned units in Methodology, and ablation studies in Experiments. Expected reading time: 15 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 做跨tokenizer蒸馏的团队可直接复现该方法，异构模型迁移适配场景实用性强
recommendation.en: Teams working on cross-tokenizer distillation can directly reproduce this method, which has strong practicability in heterogeneous model migration scenarios

institutions: University of Science and Technology of China

paper.title: Chain-based Distillation for Effective Initialization of Variable-Sized Small Language Models
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) achieve strong performance but remain costly to deploy in resource-constrained settings. Training small language models (SLMs) from scratch is computationally expensive, while conventional knowledge distillation requires repeated access to large teachers for different target sizes, leading to poor scalability. To solve these problems, we propose \textbf{Chain-based Distillation (CBD)}, a scalable paradigm for efficiently initializing variable-sized language models. A

summary.core_problem: 不同尺寸小语言模型通常需要分别从大教师蒸馏或从头训练，导致初始化成本高、教师推理重复、尺寸扩展不灵活。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是模型压缩和小模型初始化方法。它不属于预训练范式创新，但对小模型族训练、teacher budget 复用、不同 vocab/架构间迁移有工程参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Chain-based Distillation。先构造少量 intermediate anchors，通过逐步蒸馏形成从源 LLM 到小模型的知识链；目标尺寸模型通过相邻 anchors 的参数插值初始化，不必每个尺寸都重新访问大教师；对跨架构和跨词表设置，引入 bridge distillation 做过渡。
summary.experiments: 摘要称该方法能高效初始化 variable-sized language models，并减少重复大教师推理。具体源模型规模、anchor 数量、目标模型尺寸、训练 token 数、baseline 和提升幅度未在给定摘要中披露。

summary_en.core_problem: Variable-size small language models are expensive to initialize because each target size often requires either training from scratch or running a large teacher again for distillation.
summary_en.importance: This is a model-compression and efficient-training contribution. It is not a new pretraining paradigm, but it is relevant for building model families under a fixed teacher-inference budget and for transferring across architectures or vocabularies.
summary_en.technical_approach: CBD builds a sparse chain of distilled anchor models and initializes intermediate target sizes by parameter interpolation between adjacent anchors. Bridge distillation is introduced for cross-architecture and cross-vocabulary transfer, reducing repeated large-teacher calls.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract claims effective initialization for variable-sized language models and lower reliance on repeated teacher inference. The provided abstract does not include source-teacher scale, anchor count, target sizes, data scale, baselines, or exact numerical gains.

recommendation.zh: 方法像模型族生产线优化；看参数插值是否真能省 teacher compute，预训练 insight 不多。
recommendation.en: This is more model-family factory optimization than pretraining science; check whether interpolation really saves teacher compute.

paper.title: Rubric-based On-policy Distillation
paper.abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) is a powerful paradigm for model alignment, yet its reliance on teacher logits restricts its application to white-box scenarios. We contend that structured semantic rubrics can serve as a scalable alternative to teacher logits, enabling OPD using only teacher-generated responses. To prove it, we introduce ROPD, a simple yet foundational framework for rubric-based OPD. Specifically, ROPD induces prompt-specific rubrics from teacher-student contrasts, and then utilizes

summary.core_problem: 现有on-policy蒸馏依赖教师模型logits，仅适用于白盒场景，无法对接闭源商用模型
summary.importance: 方法创新，提出黑盒兼容的on-policy蒸馏范式，打破了对教师模型logits的依赖，大幅提升样本效率
summary.technical_approach: 通过师生响应对比生成特定prompt的结构化评分准则，用该准则给学生采样回复打分，替代logits进行on-policy优化，无需访问教师模型内部参数
summary.experiments: 在多类对齐任务上优于现有logit基on-policy蒸馏方法，样本效率最高提升10倍，兼容闭源教师模型场景
summary.authors_note: 腾讯与新加坡国立大学、中国科学技术大学联合团队，含蔡文胜(Tat-Seng Chua)教授

summary_en.core_problem: Existing on-policy distillation relies on teacher model logits, only applicable to white-box scenarios and unable to use closed-source commercial models as teachers
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation that proposes a black-box compatible on-policy distillation paradigm, breaking the dependence on teacher logits and greatly improving sample efficiency
summary_en.technical_approach: Generates prompt-specific structured scoring rubrics by contrasting teacher and student responses, uses these rubrics to score student rollouts for on-policy optimization, requiring no access to the teacher model's internal parameters
summary_en.experiments: Outperforms existing logit-based on-policy distillation methods on multiple alignment tasks, with up to 10x sample efficiency gain, and is compatible with closed-source teacher model scenarios
summary_en.authors_note: Joint team from Tencent, National University of Singapore, and University of Science and Technology of China, including Prof. Tat-Seng Chua.

recommendation.zh: 黑盒蒸馏思路实用，适合用闭源模型做教师的对齐场景，重点看评分准则生成方法和样本效率对比实验
recommendation.en: The black-box distillation idea is practical for alignment scenarios using closed-source models as teachers; focus on the rubric generation method and sample efficiency comparison experiments.

institutions: University of Science and Technology of China

paper.title: Asymmetric On-Policy Distillation: Bridging Exploitation and Imitation at the Token Level
paper.abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains a student on its own trajectories with token-level teacher feedback and often outperforms off-policy distillation and standard reinforcement learning. However, we find that its standard advantage weighted policy gradient suffers from three structural weaknesses, including high variance updates, vanishing gradients in zero-advantage regions, and exploration bottlenecks when corrective signals are insufficient.We therefore propose Asymmetric On-Policy Distillati

summary.core_problem: 标准在线策略蒸馏（OPD）的优势加权策略梯度存在三个结构性缺陷：负优势区域更新方差高、零优势区域梯度消失、校正信号不足时存在探索瓶颈，限制了大模型教师向小模型学生的能力蒸馏效果。
summary.importance: 为强化学习驱动的知识蒸馏、小模型推理能力对齐训练提供了更稳定的训练目标设计思路，也可迁移到预训练后的强化学习微调阶段，降低训练方差、提升样本效率。
summary.technical_approach: 提出非对称在线策略蒸馏（AOPD），对不同优势区域采用差异化训练规则：正优势区域保留原有的优势加权策略梯度以强化正确决策，非正优势区域放弃低效的负强化，改为直接最小化学生在当前轨迹前缀下的输出分布与教师分布的散度，同时兼顾强化学习的利用特性与监督学习的校正效率。
summary.experiments: 在竞赛级数学推理基准测试中，跨不同模型规模、初始化预热设置，AOPD性能稳定优于标准OPD，弱初始化场景下提升幅度更明显；在连续工具使用适配任务中，也能更好保留模型原有能力。
summary.reading_guide: 重点关注第3章OPD负强化的缺陷分析、第4章AOPD的非对称损失设计、图1的两种学习模式示意图、图2的优势分布统计，预计阅读时长15分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Standard on-policy distillation (OPD) with advantage-weighted policy gradient has three structural flaws: high update variance in negative advantage regions, vanishing gradients in zero advantage regions, and exploration bottlenecks when corrective signals are insufficient, which limits the effectiveness of distilling capabilities from large teacher models to small student models.
summary_en.importance: Provides a more stable training objective design for RL-driven knowledge distillation and reasoning capability alignment of small models. It can also be transferred to post-pretrain RL fine-tuning stages to reduce training variance and improve sample efficiency.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes Asymmetric On-Policy Distillation (AOPD), which applies differentiated training rules for different advantage regions: retains the original advantage-weighted policy gradient in positive advantage regions to reinforce correct decisions, abandons inefficient negative reinforcement in non-positive advantage regions, and directly minimizes the divergence between the student's output distribution under the current trajectory prefix and the teacher's distribution, balancing the exploitation property of RL and correction efficiency of supervised learning.
summary_en.experiments: Tested on competition-level mathematical reasoning benchmarks, AOPD consistently outperforms standard OPD across different model scales and initialization warm-up settings, with more significant improvement under weak initialization. It also preserves the model's original capabilities better in continuous tool use adaptation tasks.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Chapter 3 for defect analysis of OPD negative reinforcement, Chapter 4 for AOPD asymmetric loss design, Figure 1 for the two learning modes illustration, and Figure 2 for advantage distribution statistics. Estimated reading time is 15 minutes.

recommendation.zh: OPD 是 RL 蒸馏中被低估的方向，这篇指出的三个结构性缺陷和非对称处理方案值得在内部蒸馏 pipeline 中做小规模 ablation，重点看 §3 的方法设计
recommendation.en: OPD is an underappreciated direction in RL distillation; the three structural flaws identified and the asymmetric treatment scheme are worth small-scale ablation in internal distillation pipelines. Focus on §3 for method design.

institutions: Huazhong University of Science and Technology

paper.title: Short Data, Long Context: Distilling Positional Knowledge in Transformers
paper.abstract: Extending the context window of language models typically requires expensive long-context pre-training, posing significant challenges for both training efficiency and data collection. In this paper, we present evidence that long-context retrieval capabilities can be transferred to student models through logit-based knowledge distillation, even when training exclusively on packed short-context samples within a long-context window. We provide comprehensive insights through the lens of Rotary Posit

summary.core_problem: 这项工作研究一个很具体的长上下文问题：学生模型能否只用短上下文数据，通过知识蒸馏学到长距离位置感知能力。这里的长上下文能力被限定为检索型能力，例如 Needle-in-a-Haystack 和 RULER，而不是更宽泛的长程推理。核心问题不是如何收集长文档数据，也不是如何降低长序列注意力成本，而是蒸馏目标里是否已经携带了足够的位置结构，能让学生模型外推到训练长度之外。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的价值在于，它把长上下文扩展拆成了一个更可控的问题：位置知识是否可以从 teacher 的输出分布中被蒸馏出来。如果结论成立，长上下文训练不一定完全依赖真实长序列语料，也不一定需要在早期预训练中承担完整的长序列显存成本。这对小模型、端侧模型、后期 context extension 都有直接意义。贡献类型偏机制分析和训练配方验证，重点在 RoPE、KD objective、短上下文数据三者的耦合，而不是提出一个全新的注意力结构。
summary.technical_approach: 方法围绕 RoPE 和 logit-based knowledge distillation 展开。RoPE 只作用在 attention 的 query/key 上，通过旋转角度把位置信息注入注意力打分。作者的假设是：teacher 在前向传播中受到 RoPE 位置扰动影响，这些扰动会继续传到 hidden states 和最终 logits；学生在匹配 teacher logits 时，虽然只看到短上下文样本，也会被迫学习这种位置相关的输出变化。这个观点和常见的长上下文扩展不同。常见做法直接拉长训练序列，或者调整 RoPE base θ 后用长数据继续训练；这里关注的是，短数据上的蒸馏信号是否足够传递位置结构。技术上，作者显式考察 RoPE base θ 的缩放策略、短上下文本地位置能否迁移到更长长度、RoPE 对 query/key 的扰动是否在 teacher 前向中形成可学习信号，以及学生参数更新是否呈现与位置编码相关的模式。teacher 使用 Llama-4 Scout，采用 iRoPE，即 RoPE 层和 NoPE 层交错；student 是 1B 参数级别模型，并在每层使用 RoPE。这一点很有意思，因为 teacher 和 student 的位置编码结构并不完全一致，蒸馏是否有效可以反映位置知识是否以更抽象的函数形式存在于输出分布里。
summary.experiments: 可见实验设置包含两个阶段。第一阶段是短上下文预训练：student 从随机初始化开始，训练 128,000 steps，共 100B tokens，序列长度为 2,048。student 配置为 30 层、20 个 attention heads、4 个 KV heads、hidden size 1,280、FFN hidden dim 6,144、vocab size 202,048。teacher 是 Llama-4 Scout，48 层、40 个 attention heads、8 个 KV heads、hidden size 5,120、FFN hidden dim 16,384、vocab size 202,048。蒸馏采用 logit-based KD。评测目标是检索型长上下文 benchmark，包括 Needle-in-a-Haystack 和 RULER。提供的内容没有给出完整实验表、性能数字、RoPE θ 消融结果、不同数据长度对比、是否使用 packing 的详细配置，也没有给出参数更新分析图。因此不能确认最终提升幅度。需要特别注意的是，这项工作把 long-context ability 明确定义为长距离检索和 attention 定位能力，实验结论不应直接外推到复杂长文档推理。
summary.reading_guide: 精读时先看问题定义和 Figure 1。它限定了工作边界：RoPE、KD objective、short-context data 三者如何组合。然后看 RoPE background 和 Figure 2，重点理解 θ 放大为什么会延缓角度 wrap，从而减少远距离位置混淆。方法部分需要重点看四组问题：RoPE θ 在 KD 中如何设定；短上下文 token 的局部位置变化如何变成长上下文外推信号；teacher 的 RoPE 扰动如何从 query/key 传播到 logits；student 的哪些参数更新和位置知识相关。实验部分应优先检查 NIAH/RULER 随 context length 的曲线，而不只看平均分；还要看是否比较了普通 LM loss、KD loss、不同 θ、不同 teacher positional scheme、不同短序列长度，以及是否存在训练后短上下文能力退化。最值得深挖的是 teacher/student 位置编码不一致的情况下，logit KD 是否仍能迁移位置知识；这会影响后续做 long-context distillation、context annealing、端侧模型蒸馏时的训练设计。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a narrow but important long-context question: can a student transformer acquire long-range positional awareness from short-context data through knowledge distillation alone. Long-context ability is defined as retrieval and attention over long sequences, measured by tasks such as Needle-in-a-Haystack and RULER. The target is not broad long-document reasoning. The central issue is whether the teacher's output distribution contains enough positional structure for the student to extrapolate beyond the sequence lengths seen during training.
summary_en.importance: The main relevance to pretraining is the separation of long-context extension into a positional knowledge transfer problem. If the claim holds, long-context capability does not always require large amounts of curated long documents or full long-sequence training from the beginning. This matters for small and on-device models, where quadratic attention cost and distribution shifts across training stages are serious constraints. The contribution is primarily mechanistic and recipe-oriented: it examines how RoPE, the distillation objective, and short-context data interact, rather than proposing a new attention architecture.
summary_en.technical_approach: The approach is built around RoPE and logit-based knowledge distillation. RoPE injects position through rotations applied to attention queries and keys. The authors hypothesize that these position-dependent perturbations propagate through the teacher forward pass and appear in the final logits. When the student matches those logits, it receives an implicit positional training signal even if the sequences are short and even if packed samples do not attend to one another. This differs from standard long-context extension recipes that rely on training directly on long sequences after changing the RoPE base. The paper investigates four linked questions: how to scale the RoPE base θ under KD; whether local positional information from short contexts can support long-context learning; whether RoPE perturbations in the teacher meaningfully propagate to the output distribution; and whether student parameter updates show patterns aligned with positional information. The setup uses Llama-4 Scout as the teacher, which has an iRoPE design with interleaved RoPE and NoPE layers, while the 1B student uses RoPE in every layer. This mismatch is useful: successful transfer would suggest that the positional signal is not merely copied layer by layer, but expressed through the teacher's output function.
summary_en.experiments: The visible setup includes a progressive context-extension training pipeline. Stage 1 trains the randomly initialized student for 128,000 steps on 100B tokens with a 2,048-token context window. The student has 30 layers, 20 attention heads, 4 KV heads, model dimension 1,280, FFN hidden dimension 6,144, and a vocabulary size of 202,048. The teacher, Llama-4 Scout, has 48 layers, 40 attention heads, 8 KV heads, model dimension 5,120, FFN hidden dimension 16,384, and the same vocabulary size. Distillation is logit-based. Evaluation is framed around retrieval-oriented long-context benchmarks such as Needle-in-a-Haystack and RULER. The provided content does not include the final result tables, RoPE θ ablations, sequence-length curves, packing details, or parameter-update visualizations. For that reason, the size of the reported gain cannot be verified from the available text. A key caveat is that the claimed capability should be interpreted as positional retrieval competence, not general long-context reasoning.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read the problem framing and Figure 1 first, because they define the three interacting factors: RoPE, KD objective, and short-context data. Then read the RoPE background and Figure 2 carefully; the important point is how increasing θ slows angular rotation and reduces position aliasing at longer lengths. In the method and experiment sections, focus on four checks: the RoPE θ choice under distillation, the evidence that short-range positions transfer to longer ranges, the analysis showing propagation from query/key perturbations to logits, and the parameter-update patterns in the student. In the results, prioritize Needle-in-a-Haystack and RULER curves as a function of context length rather than only aggregate scores. Also check comparisons against plain LM training, KD with different θ values, different teacher positional schemes, and different short-context lengths. The most useful detail to inspect is whether positional knowledge transfers despite the teacher using iRoPE and the student using RoPE in all layers, since that directly informs practical long-context distillation recipes.

recommendation.zh: 这篇会动摇“长上下文必须靠长数据喂出来”的默认前提；先看受控重复序列实验和 RoPE 分阶段缩放，若你做 context extension，值得立刻加进内部 ablation。
recommendation.en: This weakens the default prior that long-context ability must be trained on long data; read the repeated-token control setup and phase-wise RoPE scaling first, then add it to your internal context-extension ablations.

commentary.article_excerpt: 大模型任我行 关注 Meta：短数据蒸馏长上下文位置知识 📖标题：Short Data, Long Context: Distilling Positional Knowledge in Transformers 🌐来源：arXiv, 2604.06070v1 🛎️文章简介 🔸研究问题：学生模型仅使用打包的短上下文数据进行训练，如何能通过知识蒸馏获得处理长上下文的检索能力？ 🔸主要贡献：证实了基于 Logit 的知识蒸馏能传递位置信息，并揭示了 RoPE 扰动在 Transformer 中的传播机制及参数更新规律。 📝重点思路 🔸采用分阶段 RoPE 缩放策略，在短上下文预训练阶段使用较小基值，在长上下文扩展阶段增大基值，以最大化各阶段的旋转谱利用率。 🔸构建重复令牌序列实验，隔离语义内容干扰，专门追踪由 RoPE 引起的位置扰动如何从查询和键向量传播至输出 Logits。 🔸对比不同训练阶段检查点的隐藏状态，分析在长上下文扩展过程中，学生模型特定维度参数 span 的结构性更新模式。 🔎分析总结 🔸分阶段缩放 RoPE 基值的效果优于固定基值，且知识蒸馏在长上下文任务上显著优于仅使用交叉熵损失的训练方法。 🔸RoPE 引入的位置扰动会随网络层数加深而被放大，最终导致教师模型输出分布产生系统性位置依赖，形成有效的蒸馏信号。 🔸长上下文能力的获取并非依靠记忆特定位置，而是通过针对性地更新负责编码长距离关系的高索引隐藏状态维度来实现。 💡个人观点 论文打破了“长上下文必须依赖长文本数据训练”的传统认知，从机理上解释了知识蒸馏如何通过 RoPE 的数学特性，将教师模型的位置感知能力隐式地迁移给仅见过短数据的学生模型。 #LLM #大模型 #大模型训练 #论文分享 #Meta 04-29

paper.title: Validity-Calibrated Reasoning Distillation
paper.abstract: Reasoning distillation aims to transfer multi-step reasoning capabilities from large language models to smaller, more efficient ones. While recent methods have shown promising gains, they typically rely on static teacher-student hierarchies and frame distillation as trajectory imitation. This is misaligned with the structure of reasoning, where intermediate steps are often locally under-specified: global correctness constrains the final answer, but does not uniquely determine each intermediate m

summary.core_problem: 在多步推理蒸馏中，传统“轨迹模仿（trajectory imitation）”默认一个隐含前提：全局更强的 teacher 在每个中间步骤上也提供更好的局部学习信号；论文指出该单调性假设在推理任务中经常被违反，导致 token 级蒸馏强度分配失真，从而提出一种按“局部有效性（local validity）”自适应校准蒸馏强度的方法。
summary.importance:
对 post-train/蒸馏链路更直接，但对预训练研究也有两点启发：
1) 训练信号质量不是“teacher 越强越好”这么简单，关键在于局部决策点的可辨识度与约束强度；这会影响用合成 CoT/推理轨迹做 mid-train 或 continual pretrain 的数据配方。
2) 提供了一个可迁移的思路：把 token 级监督看成“学习信号分配问题”，而不是“路径对齐问题”，与更一般的 credit assignment/局部 KL 约束视角一致。
summary.technical_approach:
VCRD（Validity-Calibrated Reasoning Distillation）的核心做法是：在每个前缀处同时生成 teacher 与 student 的下一步候选（next-step action/continuation），用一个外部 judge 在相同上下文下评估两者的局部有效性，然后用两者相对有效性来缩放蒸馏更新强度，而不是强制 token 级模仿 teacher 轨迹。
- 关键点 1：不改变监督“方向”（仍以 teacher 为锚），改变的是更新“力度”（allocation）。
- 关键点 2：出现三种区间：当 teacher 局部更强时衰减（attenuation），两者接近时保持（parity），当 student 局部更强时放大（amplification）。作者强调 amplification 区间对收益很关键，因为它允许学生在局部更合理时不被 teacher 轨迹压制。
- 理论上用 teacher-anchored 的 KL trust-region 形式给出一阶尺度上的合理性：相对有效性应当决定更新幅度的缩放。
summary.experiments:
论文先用诊断实验直接展示单调性假设被破坏：以 Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B student 与 Qwen2.5-Math-7B-Instruct teacher 为例，在 28.8% 的决策点上，student 的下一步在 judge 下获得不低于 teacher 的局部 reward（r_S / r_T >= 1）。
效果实验覆盖数学推理、代码生成、指令跟随三类任务，报告平均提升分别为 2.09%、2.15%、2.35%，并指出增益主要来自允许“amplification”的校准策略，而不是单纯更温和的蒸馏。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 30–45 分钟）：
- 先看 Introduction 里对“单调性假设”的提出与 28.8% 反例统计，这是整篇的立论支点。
- 重点看方法部分对 judge 评估对象（next-step action 的定义）、相对有效性如何映射到蒸馏权重、以及三种 regime 的实现细节。
- 再看理论部分的 teacher-anchored KL trust-region 推导，理解它在说“为什么缩放幅度合理”，而不是在给复杂新目标。
- 实验部分建议优先找：是否有对 amplification/attenuation 的消融、不同 judge/不同 teacher-student gap 的敏感性（这些决定方法能否稳定迁移到你的蒸馏管线）。

summary_en.core_problem: Trajectory-imitation reasoning distillation implicitly assumes a monotonicity property: a globally stronger teacher provides uniformly better local learning signals at every intermediate step. The paper shows this assumption is frequently violated in multi-step reasoning and proposes to reframe distillation as token-level learning-signal allocation based on local validity rather than strict path alignment.
summary_en.importance: Primarily a post-training/distillation contribution, with two broader implications relevant to pretraining-adjacent pipelines: (1) teacher strength does not translate into uniformly reliable token-level supervision, which matters when using synthetic CoT traces for mid-training or continual pretraining; (2) it offers a general credit-assignment view—calibrating update magnitude per decision point under a local validity signal—compatible with KL-regularized training and other trust-region style objectives.
summary_en.technical_approach:
Validity-Calibrated Reasoning Distillation (VCRD): at each prefix, both teacher and student propose a next-step continuation; an auxiliary judge scores their local validity under the same context; the relative validity then scales the distillation update magnitude. The supervision remains teacher-anchored in direction, but its strength is adaptively modulated.
- Regimes: parity (similar validity), attenuation (teacher locally stronger), amplification (student locally stronger).
- Theoretical justification: a teacher-anchored KL trust-region formulation motivates why relative validity should control the first-order scaling of the update, aligning learning pressure with local evidence rather than enforcing uniform imitation.
summary_en.experiments:
Diagnostic evidence: with a Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B student vs a Qwen2.5-Math-7B-Instruct teacher, 28.8% of decision points have student continuations achieving equal-or-higher local judge reward than the teacher under the same prefix (r_S/r_T ≥ 1), directly contradicting the monotonicity assumption.
Downstream results: consistent gains across math reasoning, code generation, and instruction following, with average improvements of 2.09%, 2.15%, and 2.35%. The paper attributes a meaningful portion of the gains to enabling the amplification regime rather than merely weakening distillation.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (30–45 minutes):
- Start with the Introduction’s monotonicity-assumption critique and the 28.8% statistic; that’s the core empirical motivation.
- Read the method section for: what exactly is judged (definition of “next-step action”), how relative validity maps to per-token weights, and how the three regimes are implemented.
- Then read the KL trust-region derivation to understand the intended guarantee: it’s about correct scaling, not a brand-new objective.
- In experiments, prioritize ablations on amplification vs attenuation, judge choice/robustness, and sensitivity to teacher–student gap—these determine whether VCRD is stable in real distillation pipelines.

recommendation.zh: 这个角度是对的：推理蒸馏不该把 CoT 当唯一真轨迹；先看方法定义和局部 validity 打分是否自洽，若 clean，值得并入内部 distill ablation。
recommendation.en: The premise is sound: CoT should not be treated as a unique gold trajectory; check whether the local-validity scoring is actually well-defined, and if the setup is clean, fold it into your internal distillation ablations.

paper.title: Turning the TIDE: Cross-Architecture Distillation for Diffusion Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) offer parallel decoding and bidirectional context, but state-of-the-art dLLMs require billions of parameters for competitive performance. While existing distillation methods for dLLMs reduce inference steps within a single architecture, none address cross-architecture knowledge transfer, in which the teacher and student differ in architecture, attention mechanism, and tokenizer. We present TIDE, the first framework for cross-architecture dLLM distillation,

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文处理的是 diffusion LLM 的跨架构蒸馏问题：如何把大规模 dLLM 教师的知识迁移到小 dLLM 学生上，同时允许二者在架构、注意力机制和 tokenizer 上都不一致。难点不只是常规的 teacher-student capacity gap，而是 diffusion timestep 会改变教师信号可靠性，高噪声下上下文严重不足，不同词表又让 token-level KL 这类标准蒸馏目标无法直接使用。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发在于，它把 dLLM 压缩从“同架构步数压缩”推进到“异构模型知识迁移”。这类问题会随着 LLaDA、Dream、LLaDA 2.0 等大规模 dLLM 出现而变得实际：训练一个小 dLLM 不一定只能从头预训练，也可以借助大 dLLM 的去噪分布。贡献量级偏方法框架，不是新训练范式；但它明确指出 dLLM 蒸馏和 AR 蒸馏的差异：教师质量随噪声水平变化，不能把所有 timestep 的 soft target 等价看待。
summary.technical_approach: Tide 由三个模块组成，对应时间、上下文和词表三个层面的不匹配。Tidal 是双轴蒸馏调度：一条轴是训练进度，另一条轴是 diffusion timestep。低噪声时教师看到更多上下文，预测更可靠；高噪声时教师更接近猜测，因此蒸馏权重需要随 timestep 调整。同时，学生在训练早期和后期吸收软标签的能力不同，所以还要随训练阶段调整蒸馏强度。CompDemo 解决高 mask ratio 下教师上下文不足的问题。它使用 complementary mask splitting，让教师在互补的 mask 视图上产生更有信息量的 demonstration-conditioned target，而不是只依赖一个重噪声输入的原始输出。Reverse Calm 处理 tokenizer 不一致。论文没有做脆弱的 token-to-token 对齐，而是使用反向的 chunk-level likelihood matching，把教师侧的上下文知识投影到学生输出空间，并通过有界梯度和双端噪声过滤降低跨词表匹配的不稳定性。三个模块的分工比较清楚：Tidal 决定什么时候学，CompDemo 改善学什么，Reverse Calm 决定不同词表之间怎么学。
summary.experiments: 实验设置覆盖两条异构蒸馏管线。第一条是 cross-tokenizer 蒸馏：用 16B MoE 的 LLaDA2 作为教师，蒸馏到 0.6B block diffusion student BD3LM。第二条是 shared-tokenizer 蒸馏：用 8B dense 的 WeDLM 作为教师，同样蒸馏到 0.6B BD3LM。八个 benchmark 的平均分中，最佳配置从非蒸馏 baseline 的 32.67 提升到 34.20，提升 +1.53。一个有意思的结果是代码生成：蒸馏后的 dLLM 在 HumanEval 上达到 48.78，而同尺寸 AR 模型为 32.3。消融显示不同蒸馏管线偏好的组件配置不同，说明 Tide 的模块化设计不是简单堆叠；cross-tokenizer 设置更依赖词表对齐策略，shared-tokenizer 设置中 timestep-aware 调度和上下文增强的影响更直接。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 30–45 分钟。优先看 Introduction 中对三类障碍的定义，因为这部分决定了后面方法是否成立。Method 中重点看 Tidal 的权重调度形式、CompDemo 的 complementary mask 构造方式、Reverse Calm 的 chunk-level likelihood matching；尤其要确认它们是否会显著增加训练成本。实验部分建议看两条 pipeline 的设置和 ablation，而不只看平均分。更适合关注 dLLM 训练、蒸馏和 tokenizer 对齐的人读；如果只关心 AR LLM 蒸馏，可重点吸收 timestep-dependent teacher reliability 这一点。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies cross-architecture distillation for diffusion LLMs: transferring knowledge from a large dLLM teacher to a small dLLM student when the two models may differ in backbone architecture, attention pattern, and tokenizer. The difficulty is specific to diffusion LMs. Teacher reliability changes with the diffusion timestep, heavily masked inputs provide weak context, and mismatched vocabularies make standard token-level distillation objectives ill-defined.
summary_en.importance: The main value for pretraining research is that it treats dLLM compression as heterogeneous knowledge transfer, not just step reduction within the same model family. This matters as large dLLMs such as LLaDA-style models become expensive to train and deploy. The paper also makes a useful modeling point: soft targets in diffusion LMs should not be trusted uniformly across timesteps, because the teacher’s prediction quality depends strongly on the noise level.
summary_en.technical_approach: Tide has three modules. Tidal is a dual-axis distillation schedule over training progress and diffusion timestep. The teacher is more reliable at low mask ratios and less reliable at high mask ratios, while the student’s ability to absorb teacher signals also changes during training. The distillation weight is therefore modulated along both axes. CompDemo addresses context starvation under heavy masking. It uses complementary mask splitting to give the teacher richer demonstration-conditioned views, rather than relying on a single highly corrupted input. Reverse Calm addresses tokenizer mismatch. Instead of fragile token-to-token mapping, it uses an inverted chunk-level likelihood matching objective to project teacher knowledge into the student vocabulary space, with bounded gradients and filtering on both ends to reduce noisy alignment. The modules play separate roles: Tidal controls when to distill, CompDemo improves the contextual signal, and Reverse Calm defines how to align outputs across vocabularies.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments cover two pipelines. The cross-tokenizer setting distills from a 16B MoE LLaDA2 teacher into a 0.6B BD3LM block-diffusion student. The shared-tokenizer setting distills from an 8B dense WeDLM teacher into the same 0.6B student family. On eight benchmarks, the best configuration improves the average score from 32.67 to 34.20, a gain of +1.53. The distilled dLLM also reports strong code generation behavior, reaching 48.78 on HumanEval versus 32.3 for a same-size AR model. Ablations indicate that the two pipelines prefer different module configurations, which supports the modular design rather than a single fixed recipe.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in 30–45 minutes. Start with the problem decomposition in the introduction: timestep reliability, context scarcity, and tokenizer mismatch. In the method section, focus on the exact weighting rule in Tidal, the construction of complementary masks in CompDemo, and the likelihood-matching direction in Reverse Calm. In the experiments, the ablation tables are more informative than the aggregate benchmark average. The paper is most useful for readers working on diffusion LM training, dLLM distillation, and tokenizer-heterogeneous transfer.

recommendation.zh: 跨架构dLLM蒸馏的首个可行方案，损失设计可直接复现用于内部dLLM小模型迭代，重点看§3.3的Reverse CALM部分
recommendation.en: First feasible cross-architecture dLLM distillation solution, loss design can be directly reproduced for internal small dLLM iteration, focus on §3.3 Reverse CALM

paper.title: Select to Think: Unlocking SLM Potential with Local Sufficiency
paper.abstract: Small language models (SLMs) offer computational efficiency for scalable deployment, yet they often fall short of the reasoning power exhibited by their larger counterparts (LLMs). To mitigate this gap, current approaches invoke an LLM to generate tokens at points of reasoning divergence, but these external calls introduce substantial latency and costs. Alternatively, standard distillation is often hindered by the capacity limitation, as SLMs struggle to accurately mimic the LLM's complex genera

summary.core_problem: 现有提升小语言模型推理能力的方法要么需要调用大模型引入额外延迟，要么蒸馏受限于SLM容量效果不佳
summary.importance: 方法创新，提出基于局部 sufficiency 假设的蒸馏范式，降低SLM对齐大模型的监督难度
summary.technical_approach: 提出SELECT TO THINK方法，将大模型的监督从开环生成改为对SLM top-K候选token的排名监督，简化监督信号复杂度
summary.experiments: 验证了局部sufficiency假设成立：推理分歧点的正确token通常在SLM的top-K预测中，基于该方法的SLM推理性能超过常规蒸馏方案
summary.authors_note: 慕尼黑工业大学、阿里云团队

summary_en.core_problem: Existing methods to improve small language model (SLM) reasoning either introduce extra latency via LLM calls or underperform due to SLM capacity limits in standard distillation
summary_en.importance: Method innovation, proposes a distillation paradigm based on local sufficiency assumption to reduce supervision complexity for SLM alignment
summary_en.technical_approach: SELECT TO THINK (S2T) framework reframes LLM supervision from open-ended generation to ranking of SLM's top-K candidate tokens, simplifying the supervision signal
summary_en.experiments: Verifies local sufficiency assumption: correct tokens at reasoning divergence points usually appear in SLM's top-K predictions, S2T outperforms standard distillation on SLM reasoning tasks
summary_en.authors_note: Team from Technical University of Munich, Alibaba Cloud

recommendation.zh: 局部sufficiency假设对SLM后训练蒸馏有参考价值，只看假设验证的Fig2即可
recommendation.en: Local sufficiency assumption is referenceable for SLM post-training distillation, only read Fig 2 for assumption validation

paper.title: S-SONDO: Self-Supervised Knowledge Distillation for General Audio Foundation Models
paper.abstract: General audio foundation models have recently achieved remarkable progress, enabling strong performance across diverse tasks. However, state-of-the-art models remain extremely large, often with hundreds of millions of parameters, leading to high inference costs and limited deployability on edge devices. Knowledge distillation is a proven strategy for model compression, but prior work in audio has mostly focused on supervised settings, relying on class logits, intermediate features, or architectu

summary.core_problem: 现有通用音频基座模型参数量大推理成本高，此前音频领域知识蒸馏方法依赖监督信号、模型logits或层级对齐，无法适配仅输出embedding的自监督音频模型
summary.importance: 首个仅用输出embedding实现通用音频模型蒸馏的框架，架构无关，适用范围广
summary.technical_approach: 提出S-SONDO自监督蒸馏框架，无需logits或层级对齐，仅基于教师模型输出的embedding完成蒸馏
summary.experiments: 摘要未披露完整实验设置，仅说明在多类音频任务上验证了方法有效性

summary_en.core_problem: Large general audio foundation models have high inference costs, existing audio knowledge distillation methods rely on supervised signals, logits or layer alignment, which do not work for embedding-only self-supervised audio models
summary_en.importance: First architecture-agnostic distillation framework for general audio models that only uses output embeddings
summary_en.technical_approach: Propose S-SONDO self-supervised distillation framework, no logits or layer alignment required, only uses teacher model output embeddings for distillation
summary_en.experiments: Full experiment setup not disclosed in abstract, only states effectiveness is verified on multiple audio tasks

recommendation.zh: 音频基座压缩的增量工作，仅作为文献备查，无需读正文
recommendation.en: Incremental work on audio foundation model compression, only for literature reference, no need to read full text

paper.title: Structural Pruning of Large Vision Language Models: A Comprehensive Study on Pruning Dynamics, Recovery, and Data Efficiency
paper.abstract: While Large Vision Language Models (LVLMs) demonstrate impressive capabilities, their substantial computational and memory requirements pose deployment challenges on resource-constrained edge devices. Current parameter reduction techniques primarily involve training LVLMs from small language models, but these methods offer limited flexibility and remain computationally intensive. We study a complementary route: compressing existing LVLMs by applying structured pruning to the language model backb

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作讨论的不是如何从小语言模型重新训练一个轻量 LVLM，而是另一路径：能否直接对现有 LVLM 的语言骨干做结构化剪枝，再用较轻量的恢复训练把性能拉回来。核心问题有三层。第一，LVLM 上哪些结构化剪枝方式更合适：删整层，还是缩宽度。第二，剪枝后性能下降主要来自语言能力受损，还是视觉-语言对齐被破坏。第三，在恢复阶段，SFT、logit distillation、hidden-state distillation 以及数据规模之间，哪种组合最划算。
summary.importance: 对纯预训练研究的直接相关性有限，因为它主要是压缩与恢复训练研究，不是新的基座建模范式。但它对多模态基座的训练后阶段有实用启发，尤其是两个方面。其一，文章把 LVLM 剪枝后的退化拆成“alignment 先坏”还是“language backbone 也坏”，这对理解多模态模型的脆弱部位有帮助。其二，它给出一个比较系统的经验结论：轻中度压缩时，问题往往先出在 projector / multimodal alignment，而不是整个语言模型都失效；因此恢复训练不一定要全量重训。这对做多模态 continual pretrain、mid-train 压缩、边缘部署版本蒸馏的人有参考价值。贡献类型主要是系统性 empirical study，而不是新 pruning 算法。
summary.technical_approach:
作者选了三类代表性 LVLM：LLaVA-v1.5-7B、Bunny-v1-3B、Mini-InternVL-Chat-4B。共同点是都由 vision encoder、multimodal projector 和 language backbone 组成，因此可以把压缩重点放在参数占比最大的语言骨干上。文章研究两种结构化剪枝范式。

第一种是 layerwise pruning，直接删除整个 transformer blocks。它继承了 LLM 剪层工作的思路，假设部分层存在冗余。优点是结构简单，硬件友好；缺点是对表示路径的破坏比较粗暴，尤其可能伤到跨模态信息在深层的整合。

第二种是 widthwise pruning，缩减每层内部宽度，包括 attention heads 和 MLP neurons。它不是删掉整层计算路径，而是在保留层级深度的前提下压缩每层容量。作者把这一路径视为更细粒度的结构化压缩，因此理论上更有机会保住多模态对齐链路。

剪枝之后，作者比较多种恢复策略。基础恢复是 supervised finetuning。其上再叠加两类蒸馏：logit distillation 和 hidden-state distillation（L2）。从文章给出的结论看，hidden-state distillation 比只蒸 logits 更稳定，因为 LVLM 剪枝后的问题不只是输出分布偏了，还包括中间表示和视觉-语言对齐被扰动。作者还专门分析了低压缩比与高压缩比下的 degradation dynamics：低压缩时主要是 multimodal alignment 受损，因此只调 projector 就能恢复不少；高压缩时语言 backbone 本身也明显退化，这时必须做更充分的全模型恢复。

另一个值得注意的设计是数据效率分析。作者把 calibration dataset size 和 recovery training data size 都做了系统扫描，试图回答“要不要拿回原始大规模多模态数据重训”这个实际问题。文章给出的答案偏务实：校准数据可以很少，恢复训练也不一定需要全量原始数据。
summary.experiments:
从摘要和正文可确认的实验主线有几部分。

1）模型与评测范围。作者在三类 LVLM family 上做实验：LLaVA-v1.5-7B、Bunny-v1-3B、Mini-InternVL-Chat-4B。评测不只看通用 VQA，还加入了更能暴露推理与结构理解退化的 benchmark，如 AI2D、MathVista、DocVQA。这个设计是合理的，因为剪枝后最容易先掉的往往不是简单感知，而是需要长链路整合的复杂推理。

2）剪枝范式比较。文章的主结论是：在低资源恢复设定下，widthwise pruning 普遍优于 layerwise pruning。原因不是单纯“参数保留更多”，而是 layerwise 删除会更明显破坏深层推理路径与跨模态融合，因此在 reasoning-heavy benchmark 上掉点更严重。作者特别指出，layerwise pruning 对复杂推理任务的伤害大于 widthwise pruning，这一点比只看平均分更有解释力。

3）退化机理分析。作者把性能下降拆成 modality alignment degradation 与 language capability degradation。结论是：低压缩比时，主要损伤发生在视觉-语言对齐，语言骨干相对还在；高压缩比时，两者都会明显受损。这直接导出恢复策略差异：轻度压缩时，只微调 projector 就可能足够；压缩更激进时，必须连 language backbone 一起恢复。

4）恢复训练策略。作者验证了 SFT + hidden-state distillation（L2）是最稳的组合，优于单独 SFT，也优于只做 logits distillation。这个结果符合多模态模型的特点：输出 logits 只能约束最终 token 分布，但 hidden-state 蒸馏能更直接地拉回被剪枝扰乱的中间表示与对齐空间。

5）数据效率。文章给出的一个实用结论是，calibration 对数据量并不敏感，所需数据很少；恢复训练在只用原始训练数据 5% 的情况下，仍能取得有效结果。这个结论对部署侧很重要，因为它意味着压缩现有 LVLM 并不一定需要重新拿到全量训练语料做高成本恢复。

由于给定全文片段没有完整表格数字，这里不硬填具体百分点。但从作者总结可明确把握三点：widthwise 在多数设定下更优；SFT+hidden-state distillation 是最佳恢复组合；5% 数据即可完成相当有效的 recovery。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇更像一篇系统实验手册，适合带着问题读。先看 Introduction 末尾列出的四条发现，再看 Methodology，弄清 layerwise 与 widthwise 的具体实现，以及 recovery 里 SFT、logit KD、hidden-state KD 的组合方式。然后重点看三类结果：一是不同 pruning ratio 下两种剪枝范式的性能曲线；二是 alignment vs language degradation 的分析图；三是 recovery data size 的敏感性实验。

如果你只关心结论，优先看 Fig.1 和主结果表，再看关于 reasoning benchmark 的分解结果，因为那部分最能说明为什么 layerwise 更伤。若你在做多模态模型压缩、蒸馏或边缘部署，建议把 projector-only recovery 与 full-model recovery 的对比也看完。预计 30–45 分钟可以抓住主线；若要复现实验或迁移到自家 LVLM，可能需要连附录中的剪枝细节和训练超参一起读。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a practical alternative to rebuilding compact LVLMs from small language models: structurally pruning an existing LVLM’s language backbone and then recovering performance with lightweight retraining. The core questions are threefold. Which structured pruning paradigm works better for LVLMs—removing layers or shrinking width? After pruning, is the main damage in language capability or in vision-language alignment? And during recovery, which combination of supervised finetuning, logit distillation, hidden-state distillation, and data budget gives the best trade-off?
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining-method paper in the narrow sense; it is mainly about compression and recovery. Still, it has useful implications for multimodal foundation models. The most valuable part is the diagnosis of where pruning hurts first. The paper argues that under mild compression, multimodal alignment degrades before the language backbone collapses, which means recovery can be targeted rather than fully retrained. That is relevant for multimodal continual pretraining, mid-training compression, distillation, and deployment-oriented model adaptation. The contribution is best viewed as a systematic empirical study rather than a new pruning algorithm.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The study covers three representative LVLM families: LLaVA-v1.5-7B, Bunny-v1-3B, and Mini-InternVL-Chat-4B. All share the standard decomposition into a vision encoder, a multimodal projector, and a language backbone, so the compression focus is placed on the language model, which dominates parameter count.

Two structured pruning paradigms are compared. The first is layerwise pruning, which removes entire transformer blocks. This follows prior LLM work that treats some layers as redundant. It is simple and hardware-friendly, but it is also coarse and may disrupt the pathways through which multimodal information is integrated at deeper layers. The second is widthwise pruning, which reduces internal width by pruning attention heads and MLP neurons while preserving depth. This is a finer-grained structural change and is hypothesized to preserve multimodal processing better.

After pruning, the authors evaluate several recovery strategies. The base recovery method is supervised finetuning. On top of that, they add knowledge distillation at two levels: output logits and hidden states, with hidden-state distillation implemented via an L2 objective. The paper’s main conclusion is that SFT plus hidden-state distillation is the most reliable combination. That makes sense for LVLMs, where pruning perturbs not only the final token distribution but also the intermediate representation space that supports vision-language alignment.

A particularly useful part of the paper is the degradation analysis. The authors separate performance loss into multimodal alignment degradation and language capability degradation. Their claim is that at low compression ratios, the main issue is alignment damage, so projector-only recovery can already help a lot. At higher compression ratios, both alignment and language capability degrade, so broader recovery becomes necessary. The paper also studies data efficiency by varying both calibration data size and recovery-training data size, addressing the practical question of whether one needs access to the full original multimodal corpus for effective recovery.
summary_en.experiments:
From the provided full-text content, the experimental story is clear even if not every table value is visible.

First, the evaluation spans three LVLM families—LLaVA-v1.5-7B, Bunny-v1-3B, and Mini-InternVL-Chat-4B—and includes not only standard multimodal benchmarks but also more reasoning-heavy ones such as AI2D, MathVista, and DocVQA. This matters because pruning often hurts structured reasoning before it hurts simple perception.

Second, the main pruning comparison shows that widthwise pruning consistently outperforms layerwise pruning in low-resource recovery settings. The paper emphasizes that the gap is especially visible on reasoning-oriented benchmarks. The interpretation is that removing whole layers damages deep reasoning paths and cross-modal integration more severely than shrinking width while preserving depth.

Third, the degradation-dynamics analysis is one of the most informative parts. At mild compression levels, the dominant failure mode is multimodal alignment degradation rather than a full collapse of the language backbone. At higher compression levels, both alignment and language capability deteriorate. This directly motivates different recovery strategies: projector-only finetuning can be sufficient under mild pruning, but more aggressive pruning requires broader recovery of the language backbone as well.

Fourth, among recovery methods, SFT combined with hidden-state distillation gives the best and most consistent recovery, outperforming plain SFT and SFT with only logit distillation. This result is plausible because hidden-state matching can restore internal representation geometry and cross-modal alignment more directly than output-level supervision alone.

Fifth, the data-efficiency study yields a practical result: calibration is highly data-efficient, and recovery training remains effective with as little as 5% of the original training data. That makes the pruning-and-recover route much more attractive for deployment scenarios where full retraining is too expensive.

The visible text does not include all exact benchmark numbers, so it would be misleading to invent deltas. But the qualitative findings are clear and central: widthwise pruning is generally the better structural choice, SFT plus hidden-state distillation is the strongest recovery recipe, and useful recovery is possible with a surprisingly small data budget.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Read this as a systems paper rather than a single-method paper. Start with the end of the Introduction, where the authors summarize the four main findings. Then go to the Methodology section to understand exactly how layerwise and widthwise pruning are instantiated and how SFT, logit KD, and hidden-state KD are combined.

For the results, focus on three parts. First, the performance curves across pruning ratios for the two pruning paradigms. Second, the analysis that separates alignment degradation from language degradation; that is where the paper becomes more than a benchmark table. Third, the sensitivity study on recovery data size, which is the most deployment-relevant section. If you only want the main conclusions, start with Fig. 1 and the main result tables, then read the breakdown on reasoning-heavy benchmarks because that section best explains why layerwise pruning is more damaging. Expect about 30–45 minutes for a solid skim; more if you want to reproduce the setup or transfer the recipe to another LVLM.

recommendation.zh: 对 VLM 剪枝的系统性实证研究，结论是 widthwise 剪枝在 low-data regime 下优于 layerwise，对做模型压缩的同学有参考价值。
recommendation.en: A systematic empirical study on VLM pruning, concluding that widthwise pruning outperforms layerwise in low-data regimes; valuable reference for model compression practitioners.

We further propose Hybrid Policy Distillation (HPD), which integrates the complementary adv

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文讨论的是 LLM 蒸馏里一个很实际但常被拆开看的问题：蒸馏效果不是只由“选 forward KL 还是 reverse KL”决定，而是由散度方向、优化方式、以及 on-policy / off-policy 数据来源共同决定。现有做法往往只固定其中一个轴，例如离线 SFT、离线 FKLD、或者先 SFT 再做 on-policy distillation，但这些组合各有明显缺陷：forward KL 覆盖模式多，却容易把学生拉向过平滑分布；reverse KL 更偏 mode-seeking，生成质量可能更好，但在 teacher-student 差距大时不稳定；纯离线训练有 train-test mismatch，纯 on-policy 又贵且容易把 teacher 评估预算耗在低质量 student rollout 上。论文要解决的核心问题，是如何在一个统一框架里同时利用 forward / reverse KL 的互补性，并把轻量 on-policy 信号并入蒸馏，而不失去 one-hot 监督的训练效率。
summary.importance: 这项工作更偏 post-train / distillation，而不是预训练本体，但它对基座研究仍有明确价值。第一，它把多种蒸馏目标统一成 token-level reweighted log-likelihood 视角，这有助于理解不同 KD 目标到底在改写什么梯度，而不是把它们当作彼此孤立的 recipe。第二，它针对 capacity-limited student 的多模态分布匹配问题给出了一种折中方案：既不过度追求 teacher 全分布覆盖，也不完全走高方差的 on-policy RL 路线。对于做模型压缩、teacher-student transfer、以及 post-train 反哺 pretrain 的研究者，这种统一视角是有启发的。贡献量级上，它不像新预训练目标那样基础，但在蒸馏设计空间的整理和可落地方法上做得比较完整。
summary.technical_approach:
论文先做了一件很重要的事：把 SFT、forward KL distillation、reverse KL distillation 放到统一的重加权对数似然框架里。直观上，标准 SFT 对每个位置只强化 ground-truth token；FKLD 用 teacher 全分布给 dense supervision，鼓励 student 覆盖 teacher 支持集；RKLD 更像让 student 对自己高概率区域负责，倾向收缩到少数高质量模式。作者把这些目标改写成 token-level 权重作用下的 log-likelihood，从而把“散度最小化”转成“对哪些 token 加强、对哪些 token 抑制”的问题。

在这个视角下，作者提出 Hybrid Policy Distillation。核心机制有两层。第一层是 forward / reverse KL 的混合。作者使用 negative K1 estimator 构造 token 级重权信号。对离线 expert token，如果权重为正，表示 student 低估了该 token，需要按 forward-KL 风格提升其概率；如果权重为负，则说明 student 对某些 token 过度自信，需要抑制。第二层是 off-policy 与轻量 on-policy 的混合。除了离线数据中的 expert token，方法还会从 student 进行近似、轻量的 on-policy 采样。对 student 采样出的 token，同样计算抑制信号，惩罚 student 在自己 rollout 中的过估计行为，并把被压下来的概率质量重新分配给离线 expert token。这样做的目的，是在不进行昂贵完整 OPD 的情况下，让训练看到一部分“学生真实会生成什么”，从而缓解纯离线蒸馏的行为偏移。

方法设计上有两个值得注意的取舍。其一，作者没有直接做全词表级别的精确 KL 优化，而是把 teacher 信息压缩成 token 级 reward / weight，再保留 one-hot supervision 的高效实现。这是为了兼顾密集教师信号和训练吞吐。其二，on-policy 部分被刻意做成 lightweight approximate sampling，而不是完整 rollout + teacher 逐步打分，说明作者更关心蒸馏阶段的性价比，而不是把方法推向 RL 化。
summary.experiments:
实验覆盖长生成数学推理，以及短生成对话和代码任务，说明作者希望验证方法既适用于高熵长链生成，也适用于常见 instruction-style 输出。作者声称 HPD 在优化稳定性、计算效率和最终性能上都优于或至少不差于标准 SFT + OPD pipeline，并且成本更低；同时，HPD 还能作为 OPD 的更好初始化，进一步提升后续 on-policy 蒸馏效果。

从正文可确认的关键信息包括：作者比较了不同散度方向、不同数据 regime、以及混合策略；并强调 HPD 在 diverse model families and scales 上都成立。由于给出的全文片段没有展开具体表格数字，能明确写出的定量结论有限，但实验重点很清楚：一是看 HPD 是否比单独 FKLD / RKLD 更稳，尤其在 teacher-student gap 较大时是否减少训练震荡；二是看轻量 on-policy 是否能以较小额外成本弥补离线蒸馏的分布偏移；三是看 HPD 初始化后再做 OPD，是否优于直接从 SFT 初始化做 OPD。若精读全文，建议重点记录每个任务上的 teacher / student 规模、采样预算、以及 wall-clock 或 token-level 训练成本，因为这决定了方法是否真的有部署价值。
summary.reading_guide: 这篇适合带着问题去读。先看 Problem Formulation 和 Preliminary，理解作者如何把 SFT、FKLD、RKLD 都写成 reweighted log-likelihood；这是全文最有信息量的部分，也是判断方法是否只是工程拼接的关键。然后看 HPD 主算法，重点弄清三件事：negative K1 estimator 具体如何形成正负权重；离线 token 和 student-sampled token 分别如何更新；概率质量“重新分配给 expert token”在实现上是显式项还是等价梯度效果。实验部分优先看数学长生成结果和训练曲线，因为那里最容易暴露稳定性差异。若时间有限，45 分钟可以读完核心内容。若要深挖，建议再看附录中的推导和复杂度分析，确认它相对标准 KL 蒸馏到底省了哪些计算。
summary.authors_note: 上海交通大学、上海创新研究院、腾讯；通讯作者包括 Rui Wang、Ruobing Xie、Pengfei Liu。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a practical issue in LLM distillation: performance is not determined by the KL direction alone, but by the interaction among divergence direction, optimization form, and data regime. Existing methods usually fix one corner of this design space, such as offline SFT, offline forward-KL distillation, or SFT followed by on-policy distillation. Each has a clear weakness. Forward KL encourages mode coverage but often produces overly smooth students. Reverse KL is more mode-seeking and can improve generation quality, but it becomes unstable when the student is much weaker than the teacher. Purely offline training suffers from train-inference mismatch, while fully on-policy distillation is expensive and spends teacher evaluation budget on low-quality student rollouts. The core problem is how to combine the complementary biases of forward and reverse KL, while injecting some on-policy signal, without giving up the efficiency of one-hot supervision.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily a post-training and compression paper rather than a pretraining paper, but it is still relevant to foundation-model research. First, it offers a unified token-level reweighted log-likelihood view of several distillation objectives. That is useful because it explains what these objectives are actually doing to the gradient, instead of treating them as disconnected recipes. Second, it targets a central issue in teacher-student transfer: a capacity-limited student cannot faithfully represent a highly multimodal teacher distribution. The proposed hybrid objective is an attempt to navigate between excessive mode coverage and brittle mode seeking. For researchers working on model compression, teacher-student transfer, or the interface between pretraining and post-training, the conceptual framing is arguably as valuable as the specific algorithm. The contribution is not foundational in the way a new pretraining objective would be, but it is a fairly complete treatment of an important distillation design space.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The paper first reframes SFT, forward-KL distillation, and reverse-KL distillation under a unified reweighted log-likelihood perspective. Intuitively, standard SFT only reinforces the ground-truth token at each step. Forward KL uses the teacher's full predictive distribution to provide dense supervision and encourages the student to cover the teacher's support. Reverse KL puts more pressure on the regions where the student already places mass, making it more mode-seeking. By rewriting these objectives as token-level weighted likelihood terms, the authors turn divergence minimization into a question of which tokens should be upweighted and which should be suppressed.

Based on this view, they propose Hybrid Policy Distillation (HPD). The method combines two kinds of hybridization. The first is forward/reverse KL hybridization. HPD uses a negative K1 estimator to construct token-level reweighting signals. For offline expert tokens, a positive signal means the student underestimates that token and should be pushed upward in a forward-KL-like manner. Negative values are used to suppress overestimation. The second is off-policy/on-policy hybridization. In addition to offline expert data, HPD draws lightweight approximate on-policy samples from the student. For these student-sampled tokens, the method also computes suppressive signals, penalizing tokens that the student overproduces in its own rollouts, while redistributing probability mass toward offline expert tokens. This gives the student some exposure to its own inference-time behavior without paying the full cost of standard on-policy distillation.

Two design choices matter here. First, the method does not optimize exact vocabulary-level KL in the most direct way. Instead, it compresses teacher information into token-level rewards or weights and keeps the efficient one-hot training path. That is a deliberate trade-off between dense teacher supervision and throughput. Second, the on-policy component is intentionally lightweight and approximate rather than a full RL-style rollout-and-score pipeline, which keeps the method closer to practical distillation than to expensive policy optimization.
summary_en.experiments:
The evaluation covers long-generation math reasoning and short-generation dialogue and code tasks. That choice is sensible: math exposes instability and compounding errors over long horizons, while dialogue and code test whether the method also works in more standard instruction-following settings. The paper reports that HPD improves optimization stability, computational efficiency, and final performance, and that it consistently matches or outperforms a standard SFT plus on-policy distillation pipeline at lower cost. It also serves as a stronger initialization for subsequent OPD, yielding further gains.

From the available full-text excerpt, the exact table values are not visible, so the quantitative summary has to stay conservative. Still, the intended experimental claims are clear. The paper compares different KL directions, different data regimes, and their hybrid combinations. The key questions are whether HPD is more stable than pure FKLD or RKLD when the teacher-student gap is large, whether lightweight on-policy sampling can reduce the behavior mismatch of offline distillation at modest extra cost, and whether HPD initialization improves downstream OPD relative to starting from a plain SFT student. When reading the full paper, the most important details to extract are teacher and student sizes, sampling budgets, and wall-clock or token-level training cost, because those determine whether the method is practically attractive.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read this one with a specific agenda. Start from the problem formulation and preliminary sections, where the authors derive the reweighted log-likelihood view of SFT, FKLD, and RKLD. That is the most informative part of the paper and the best place to judge whether HPD is a genuine unification or just a heuristic mixture. Then move to the HPD algorithm and clarify three implementation details: how the negative K1 estimator produces positive and negative token weights, how offline tokens and student-sampled tokens are updated differently, and whether the probability-mass redistribution toward expert tokens is implemented explicitly or only appears through an equivalent gradient form. In the experiments, prioritize the long-generation math results and training curves, since stability differences usually show up there first. A focused 45-minute read should be enough for the core ideas. If you want more depth, check the appendix for derivations and complexity analysis to see exactly where the computational savings come from relative to standard KL-based distillation.
summary_en.authors_note: Shanghai Jiao Tong University, Shanghai Innovation Institute, and Tencent. Corresponding authors include Rui Wang, Ruobing Xie, and Pengfei Liu.

recommendation.zh: 不是预训练主线，但统一 KD 目标这件事讲得比较干净；只看目标推导和长生成 ablation，能学到蒸馏里 forward/reverse KL 到底各自补什么坑。
recommendation.en: Not core pretraining, but the objective unification looks clean; read the derivation and long-generation ablations to see what forward vs. reverse KL is actually buying in distillation.

paper.title: Don't Retrieve, Navigate: Distilling Enterprise Knowledge into Navigable Agent Skills for QA and RAG
paper.abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) grounds LLM responses in external evidence but treats the model as a passive consumer of search results: it never sees how the corpus is organized or what it has not yet retrieved, limiting its ability to backtrack or combine scattered evidence. We present Corpus2Skill, which distills a document corpus into a hierarchical skill directory offline and lets an LLM agent navigate it at serve time. summary.core_problem: 如何解决传统 RAG 系统中 LLM 作为被动消费者无法感知语料库全局结构、难以回溯和组合分散证据的问题？
summary.importance: 系统工程创新。提出了一种将扁平检索转化为树状导航的 RAG 新范式，改善了长文本和复杂语料库的信息获取效率。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Corpus2Skill 框架，离线阶段将文档语料库迭代聚类并生成层级摘要，构建可导航的技能树；服务阶段让 Agent 从全局视角向下钻取主题分支，按需回溯或组合证据。
summary.experiments: 在企业客户支持 RAG 基准测试 WixQA 上进行了验证。

summary_en.core_problem: How to overcome the limitation of traditional RAG where the LLM is a passive consumer unaware of the corpus structure, making backtracking and evidence combination difficult?
summary_en.importance: System engineering innovation. Proposes a new RAG paradigm that shifts from flat retrieval to hierarchical navigation, improving information access in complex corpora.
summary_en.technical_approach: Introduces Corpus2Skill, an offline pipeline that iteratively clusters documents and generates hierarchical summaries to build a navigable skill tree. At serve time, the agent navigates this tree top-down, allowing backtracking and cross-branch evidence combination.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on WixQA, an enterprise customer-support benchmark for RAG.

recommendation.zh: 提出将 RAG 转化为树状导航的工程设计，对通用 Agent 记忆机制有一定启发，但属于纯下游系统工程，无需深入。
recommendation.en: An engineering approach converting flat RAG into hierarchical navigation; good for agent system design but marginal for pre-training.

paper.title: Rethinking On-Policy Distillation of Large Language Models: Phenomenology, Mechanism, and Recipe

summary.core_problem: 论文聚焦 OPD（On-Policy Distillation，学生自采样轨迹、教师提供逐 token log-prob 作为稠密监督）在大模型后训练中“有时极其有效、有时完全失效”的核心不确定性：为什么更强的 teacher 反而可能无法提升 student？OPD 成功/失败由哪些可观测条件决定？其 token 级训练动力学与梯度信号到底来自哪里？以及如何把这些机制总结成可复现的训练配方来修复失败配置。
summary.importance:
对预训练/持续学习/训练动态研究的影响主要体现在“机制与配方”层面：
1) 给出 OPD 成功的两个必要条件（思维模式一致性 + teacher 必须带来 student 未见的新能力），把以往“teacher 更强→更好蒸馏”的直觉拆解为可检验的分布条件，为后续做 scaling/数据配比/持续蒸馏提供了诊断指标。
2) 提供 token 级机制证据：OPD 的有效梯度主要集中在 student-teacher 的 top-k 重叠 token 集合上；并展示成功运行的统一动力学签名（overlap 上升、entropy gap 收敛、概率质量集中）。这对理解“稠密监督为何有效/为何会失效”很关键，也能指导更稳健的蒸馏目标设计（例如只监督重叠集、或显式提升初始重叠）。
3) 给出可操作的修复 recipe（off-policy cold start、teacher-aligned prompt selection）并分析稠密监督随轨迹深度退化的成本，直接服务工业后训练流水线。

从基座研究视角，它不是新的预训练目标，但它把 OPD 作为一种“持续学习/自举式改进”的核心算子进行机制化解释，对未来 RL-pretrain、长链路推理蒸馏、以及 agentic 轨迹学习的稳定性研究都有直接启发。
summary.technical_approach:
全文结构是“现象学→机制→配方→成本/局限”的闭环。

(1) 现象学：两条成功条件
- 条件 A：Thinking-pattern consistency（思维模式一致）。作者用 student 与 teacher 的 top-k token 分布重叠度（overlap ratio）来刻画：如果初始重叠很低，即便 teacher benchmark 更高，OPD 也可能无法把 student 拉到 teacher 分布附近。
- 条件 B：Higher scores ≠ 新知识。即使思维模式一致、teacher 分数更高，如果 teacher 与 student 来自同数据同训练配方、只是 scale 更大，那么从 student 视角看 teacher 分布可能“不可区分”（distributionally indistinguishable），teacher 并没有提供 student 未见过的可迁移信号，OPD 增益会很小。
- 通过 weak-to-strong 的 reverse distillation 进一步验证：OPD 学到的本质是“思维模式/分布形状”，而不是简单地追逐 benchmark 分数。

(2) token 级机制：梯度信号的主承载体是 overlap tokens
- 成功 OPD 的统一签名：在 student 访问到的状态上，student 与 teacher 分布逐步变得更相似：top-k overlap ratio 持续上升；两者 entropy gap 逐渐缩小；重叠 token 集合承载了 97–99% 的联合概率质量。
- 失败 OPD：overlap 停滞、entropy mismatch 从一开始就存在并持续。
- 关键验证：只对“重叠 token 集合”施加监督，效果可匹配完整 top-k 监督，说明 OPD 的有效梯度主要来自重叠集；非重叠部分对优化贡献小或噪声大。

(3) Recipe：两种互补的失败修复策略
- Off-policy cold start：先用 teacher 生成的 rollouts 做一段 SFT warmup，提高初始 overlap，缩小思维模式差距，再切换到 OPD。
- Teacher-aligned prompt selection：用 teacher 后训练数据分布中的 prompts 来做 OPD，使监督集中在 teacher 高概率 token 上，更易对齐；但会导致 student entropy 显著降低（更“尖”/更保守），因此需要与 out-of-distribution prompts 混合以避免过拟合/塌缩。

(4) 稠密监督的成本与长轨迹问题
- reward 质量随 trajectory depth 系统性下降；不稳定性往往从后段 token 开始并向前传播。
- 重要观察：即便“失败 teacher”，其 reward 与 rollout 正确性在全局上仍相关，失败更像是局部优化几何问题：更大的 teacher 可能让 student 附近的 reward landscape 局部变平，导致 token 级梯度虽“方向正确”但幅度/曲率不足以推动策略更新。

整体上，作者把 OPD 从经验技巧提升为可诊断、可修复、可解释的训练算子，并给出一套与 token 分布几何直接对应的指标体系（overlap、entropy gap、probability mass concentration）。
summary.experiments:
从你提供的全文片段（引言+部分机制结论）中可以确定的关键数字/结论包括：
- 成功 OPD 的 top-k overlap ratio：从 72% 上升到 91%。
- 重叠 top-k token 承载的联合概率质量：97–99%。
- 只监督 overlap tokens 的实验：性能可匹配完整 top-k 监督（定性结论，片段未给具体分数）。
- 失败运行的特征：overlap 与 entropy gap 基本不动。
- reverse distillation 结论：同家族 1.5B 与 7B teacher 在 student 视角“分布不可区分”，因此即便 teacher 更强也可能不给增益。
- 长轨迹分析：reward 质量随深度下降，后段 token 先不稳定并向前传播；失败并非 reward 全局无信息，而是局部几何导致梯度无效。

但当前片段缺失大量你可能关心的“可复现细节数字”：具体 benchmark（数学/代码/指令遵循？）、OPD 目标形式（KL/advantage 形式/温度/截断 top-k 的 k 值）、训练步数与学习率、prompt 数量与来源、cold start 的长度、以及不同 teacher/student 组合的完整表格。精读时应去 §3–§6 的图表中补齐这些信息。
summary.reading_guide:
精读建议（must_read，建议 2–3 小时，带着复现实验的目的读）：
1) §3 Phenomenology：重点找“两个条件”的量化定义与判据（thinking-pattern consistency 的具体指标、k 的选择、阈值/相关性），以及 reverse distillation 的实验设置（同数据同配方如何定义、为何导致 indistinguishable）。
2) §4 Mechanism：精读 token 级分析图（overlap ratio 曲线、entropy gap、probability mass concentration），以及“只监督 overlap tokens≈全 top-k”的对照实验——这是全文最关键的机制证据，直接影响你如何设计更稳的 OPD loss。
3) §5 Recipe：把 cold start 与 prompt selection 当成可落地配方读，关注：warmup 需要多长、prompt mixing 比例、entropy 下降的副作用如何监控。
4) §6 Cost/Instability：重点看“深度越长 reward 越差”的定量曲线与不稳定传播分析；如果你做 RL-pretrain/agent 轨迹蒸馏，这部分决定 OPD 的适用边界。

值得深挖的研究点：
- 能否把 overlap ratio 作为训练时的在线诊断/早停信号？
- 能否设计显式提升 overlap 的目标（例如对齐 logits 的低秩子空间、或对非重叠 token 做更强的温度/平滑）？
- “teacher 造成局部平坦”这一假设能否用 Hessian/梯度噪声尺度进一步验证，并导出更好的优化器/学习率策略？
- 长轨迹下稠密监督退化：是否需要分段蒸馏、信用分配重加权、或与 outcome reward 混合？

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies why On-Policy Distillation (OPD)—where the student samples its own rollouts and receives dense per-token supervision from a teacher—can be highly effective in some settings yet completely fail in others, sometimes even when the teacher is objectively stronger. It asks: what observable conditions govern OPD success vs failure, what is the token-level mechanism that actually drives learning, and what practical recipes can reliably recover OPD when it breaks.
summary_en.importance:
For foundation-model training research, the contribution is a rare mechanism-driven account of a widely used post-training primitive:
- It replaces the naive "stronger teacher helps" assumption with two testable distributional requirements (thinking-pattern compatibility and genuine novelty beyond the student’s training exposure), which is directly relevant to scaling, continual distillation, and data/recipe design.
- It identifies a concrete locus of effective gradients: the student–teacher top-k overlap tokens, supported by dynamics (overlap growth, entropy-gap closure, probability-mass concentration). This can inform more stable OPD objectives and diagnostics.
- It provides actionable recovery recipes (off-policy cold start; teacher-aligned prompt selection) and analyzes dense-supervision degradation with trajectory depth—highly relevant for long-horizon reasoning and agentic rollouts.

While not a new pretraining objective, it elevates OPD into a measurable, debuggable operator for continual improvement pipelines and potentially RL-pretrain-style self-bootstrapping.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The paper is organized as phenomenology → mechanism → recipe → cost/limits.

1) Phenomenology: two governing conditions.
(A) Thinking-pattern consistency: student and teacher must have compatible next-token distributions, quantified via top-k overlap ratio. If initial overlap is low, OPD often cannot recover even if the teacher scores higher.
(B) Higher benchmark scores do not imply new transferable knowledge: if teacher and student share the same data and training recipe (only scale differs), they may converge to distributions that are indistinguishable from the student’s perspective, leaving little signal for OPD.
Reverse distillation experiments are used to validate these claims and to argue OPD primarily learns "thinking patterns" (distributional behavior) rather than merely chasing benchmark metrics.

2) Token-level mechanism.
Successful OPD shows a consistent signature on student-visited states: increasing top-k overlap, shrinking entropy gap, and the overlap set capturing nearly all probability mass. Failing runs show stagnant overlap and persistent entropy mismatch.
A key test: supervising only the overlap tokens matches full top-k supervision, implying the overlap set is the main carrier of useful gradients.

3) Practical recipes.
- Off-policy cold start: warm up with SFT on teacher-generated rollouts to raise initial overlap, then switch to OPD.
- Teacher-aligned prompt selection: use prompts from the teacher’s post-training distribution to sharpen alignment on high-probability tokens; mitigate entropy collapse by mixing with out-of-distribution prompts.

4) Cost/instability with depth.
Reward quality degrades with trajectory depth; instability starts at later tokens and propagates backward. Even "failing" teachers provide globally informative reward, suggesting failure is due to local optimization geometry (e.g., a locally flat landscape around the student induced by a larger teacher), not purely reward noise.
summary_en.experiments:
From the provided full-text excerpt, the main quantitative/empirical anchors are:
- In successful OPD, top-k overlap ratio increases from 72% to 91%.
- The shared top-k overlap tokens account for 97–99% of the combined probability mass.
- Overlap-only supervision performs on par with full top-k supervision (qualitative claim in the excerpt).
- Failing runs exhibit stagnant overlap and persistent entropy mismatch.
- Reverse distillation indicates same-family 1.5B and 7B teachers can be distributionally indistinguishable to the student, explaining why a stronger teacher may not help.
- Dense supervision degrades with trajectory depth; instability originates at later tokens and propagates backward.

The excerpt does not include full benchmark tables, exact OPD loss details (k, temperature, weighting), training budgets, or prompt/data scales; those should be extracted from Sections 3–6 in the full paper for reproducibility.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Deep-read guide (2–3 hours, aiming to reuse the recipe):
- Section 3 (Phenomenology): focus on how thinking-pattern consistency is measured (top-k overlap definition, choice of k, thresholds) and how "new knowledge" is operationalized in reverse distillation.
- Section 4 (Mechanism): study the plots for overlap ratio, entropy gap, and probability-mass concentration; the overlap-only supervision experiment is the key mechanistic evidence.
- Section 5 (Recipe): treat as an implementation manual—how long the cold start is, how prompts are selected/mixed, and how entropy collapse is monitored.
- Section 6 (Cost/Instability): extract the depth-vs-reward degradation curves and the instability propagation analysis; this sets the boundary for long-horizon reasoning/agentic OPD.

Research angles worth probing: online overlap-based diagnostics/early stopping, objectives that explicitly increase overlap, verifying the "local flatness" hypothesis via curvature/gradient-noise analyses, and hybrid schemes for long trajectories (segmenting, reweighting, mixing outcome rewards).

recommendation.zh: 它改变我对 OPD 的 prior：teacher 更强不等于更好，先检查思维模式一致与 top-k overlap 动力学；建议立刻按其诊断指标复现实验。
recommendation.en: It updates my OPD prior: a stronger teacher isn’t automatically better—check reasoning-mode match and top-k overlap dynamics first; I’d replicate their diagnostics immediately.

paper.title: Revisiting the Capacity Gap in Chain-of-Thought Distillation from a Practical Perspective

summary.core_problem: 在Chain-of-Thought（CoT）蒸馏中，重新审视“教师-学生能力差距（capacity gap）”是否真的是失败主因，并指出常见评测设置会掩盖蒸馏后相对学生原始能力的退化问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型为原理/评测分析与实践指南：强调应与“学生蒸馏前基线”对比而非只做“蒸馏后不同方法/教师间对比”，并给出更贴近真实落地的评测协议与教师选择建议，能直接影响小模型对齐/蒸馏的实验范式。
summary.technical_approach: 主要是实验设置与评测协议的再设计与再分析：补充蒸馏前后对照、在不同任务/不同教师强弱差异下系统复现与对比，分析capacity gap效应在实践中是否稳定主导；并讨论教师选择（强教师未必总优）与学生退化风险。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型规模/数据规模细节；核心实验围绕CoT蒸馏在多任务、多教师候选下的对比，关键观察是：CoT蒸馏在不少设置下会相对学生预蒸馏基线“掉点”，且capacity gap并非在所有任务/设置中一致主导；当教师之间性能差异很大时，capacity gap影响不稳定。

summary_en.core_problem: Is the teacher–student capacity gap truly the main reason chain-of-thought (CoT) distillation fails, and do common evaluation practices obscure cases where distillation degrades a student relative to its pre-distillation baseline?
summary_en.importance: Reframes how CoT distillation should be evaluated in practice by insisting on pre/post student comparisons, and offers guidance on evaluation protocols and teacher selection, highlighting that stronger teachers do not always yield better distilled students and that degradation risk is often overlooked.
summary_en.technical_approach: Redesigns the experimental protocol to include student pre-distillation baselines and systematic comparisons across tasks and teachers of varying strength, analyzing when capacity gap effects appear and when other factors dominate, and discussing practical implications for choosing teachers and avoiding student regression.
summary_en.experiments: Across multiple tasks and multiple teacher candidates, the study finds that CoT distillation can reduce performance compared to the original student in many settings, and that the influence of capacity gap is not consistently dominant—especially when teacher performance differences are large. The abstract does not provide model sizes, datasets, or exact deltas.

recommendation.zh: 改变我对“capacity gap 是 CoT 蒸馏主因”的默认归因：强制用学生蒸馏前基线做对照；建议立刻把他们的评测协议搬进内部蒸馏实验。
recommendation.en: It updates the default blame on “capacity gap” in CoT distillation by insisting on student-pre-distill baselines; you should adopt their evaluation protocol in your own distillation runs.
